jobs.title: Senior Operator/Biotechnologist Ibex® m/f/d
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) is a modular build complex to develop and manufacture biological products. It enables companies to get access to a complete solution, gaining speed and achieving a simplified value chain.
The Ibex® Complex is our contribution to the medicine of tomorrow and possibly the next step in your career?

At our location in Visp, in the canton of Valais, we are constantly looking for Biotechnologists with a relevant background at all levels in Life Sciences in order to support our growth in several business units.

Key responsibilities:

• Assignment in various functions within the production facilities in compliance with safety regulations and consideration of cGMP quality requirements.

• Recognition, interpretation and elimination of deviations

• Execution of production steps incl. recording and calculations

• Support in training of new team members

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician etc

• Safety-conscious work

• Knowledge of process engineering

• Fluent English

• German language skills advantageous

• Willingness to work in shifts (e.g. 4-shift pattern) with flexible work scheduling

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) è un complesso modulare per lo sviluppo e la produzione di prodotti biologici. Consente alle aziende di accedere a una soluzione completa, di ottenere velocità e di raggiungere una catena di valori semplificata. Il complesso Ibex® è il nostro contributo alla medicina di domani e forse il prossimo passo nella tua carriera? Nella nostra posizione a Visp, nel cantone del Vallese, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di biotecnologi con un background rilevante a tutti i livelli in Scienze della Vita per sostenere la nostra crescita in diverse unità aziendali. Responsabilità chiave:
• Assegnazione in varie funzioni all'interno degli impianti di produzione in conformità alle normative di sicurezza e alla considerazione dei requisiti di qualità cGMP.
• Riconoscimento, interpretazione e eliminazione delle deviazioni
• Esecuzione delle fasi di produzione, comprese le registrazioni e i calcoli
• Supporto per la formazione di nuovi membri del team Requisiti chiave:
• Formazione chimica completa / biofarmaceutica
• Esperienza professionale nella produzione farmaceutica come operatore / tecnico di produzione ecc
• Lavoro sicuro
• Conoscenza dell'ingegneria dei processi
• Inglese fluido
• competenze linguistiche tedesche vantaggiose
• Volontà di lavoro a turni (ad esempio modello a 4 turni) con programmazione flessibile del lavoro Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) ist ein modularer Baukomplex zur Entwicklung und Herstellung biologischer Produkte. Es ermöglicht Unternehmen den Zugang zu einer Komplettlösung, gewinnt an Geschwindigkeit und erreicht eine vereinfachte Wertschöpfungskette. Der Ibex® Komplex ist unser Beitrag zur Medizin von morgen und möglicherweise der nächste Schritt in Ihrer Karriere? An unserem Standort in Visp, im Wallis, sind wir ständig auf der Suche nach Biotechnologen mit einem relevanten Hintergrund auf allen Ebenen der Life Sciences, um unser Wachstum in mehreren Geschäftsbereichen zu unterstützen. Hauptzuständigkeiten:
• Zuweisung in verschiedenen Funktionen innerhalb der Produktionsanlagen unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und unter Berücksichtigung der cGMP-Qualitätsanforderungen.
• Anerkennung, Interpretation und Beseitigung von Abweichungen
• Durchführung von Produktionsschritten inkl. Aufzeichnung und Berechnungen
• Unterstützung bei der Schulung neuer Teammitglieder Hauptanforderungen:
• Abgeschlossene chemische / biopharmazeutische Ausbildung
• Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion als Bediener/Produktionstechniker etc.
• Sicherheitsbewusstes Arbeiten
• Kenntnisse der Verfahrenstechnik
• fließendes Englisch
• Deutschkenntnisse vorteilhaft
• Bereitschaft, in Schichten zu arbeiten (z. B. 4-Schicht-Muster) mit flexibler Arbeitsplanung Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird. Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht. Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. Ibex® Solutions (www.ibex.lonza.com) est un complexe modulaire de fabrication de produits biologiques. Il permet aux entreprises d'accéder à une solution complète, de gagner en vitesse et de réaliser une chaîne de valeur simplifiée. Le Complexe Ibex® est notre contribution à la médecine de demain et peut-être la prochaine étape de votre carrière? Sur notre site à Viège, dans le canton du Valais, nous recherchons en permanence des biotechnologues ayant une formation pertinente à tous les niveaux en Sciences de la Vie afin de soutenir notre croissance dans plusieurs unités commerciales. Principales responsabilités :
• Attribution de diverses fonctions dans les installations de production conformément aux règles de sécurité et à la prise en compte des exigences de qualité des BPFc.
• Reconnaissance, interprétation et élimination des écarts
• Exécution des étapes de production incluant enregistrement et calculs
• Soutien à la formation des nouveaux membres de l'équipe Principales exigences:
• Formation chimique / biopharmaceutique terminée
• Expérience professionnelle dans la production pharmaceutique en tant qu'opérateur/technicien de production, etc.
• Travail soucieux de la sécurité
• Connaissance de l'ingénierie des procédés
• Anglais couramment
• Compétences linguistiques allemandes avantageuses
• Volonté de travailler par équipes (par exemple, 4 postes) avec un horaire de travail flexible Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: BIO Operator P1P2 4 Schicht (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Am Standort Visp suchen wir einen BIO Operator (m/w/d):

Aufgaben:

• Selbstständiges Fahren der ihm vertrauten Teile der Produktionsanlage gemäss Vorgabedokumenten (Herstellungsprotokolle/ Bedienungsanleitungen / Arbeitsanweisungen / SOP)

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung  vorausgesetzt

• Chemische oder pharmatechnologische Ausbildung sowie GMP und / oder BICO Ausbildung von Vorteil

• Akkurate Arbeits- und Dokumentationsweise

• Ausführung der Arbeiten mit hohem Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

• Completare i lavori di monitoraggio, manutenzione e pulizia, nonché segnalare e correggere i difetti e i difetti dell'impianto, compresa la loro documentazione

• Independent driving of the parts of the production plant familiar to him in accordance with specifications (production protocols/operating instructions/work instructions/SOP)
• Safe and correct work execution in compliance with safety regulations taking into account the cGMP quality requirements
• Responsibility for cleanliness and order in the workplace and the assigned rooms and warehouses
• Completing monitoring, maintenance and cleaning work as well as reporting and correcting defects and faults in the plant, including their documentation

• Vocational training completed subject to:
• Chemical or pharmatechnological training as well as GMP and/or BICO training beneficial
• Good knowledge of German in words, writing and understanding
• Accurate working and documentation methods
• Execution of work with high safety and quality awareness

• Examiner la documentation de production et les travaux sur les écarts, les demandes de changement et la mise en œuvre des CAPA afin de garantir des normes BPF de haute qualité

• Bonne connaissance des processus biotechnologiques dans le domaine de la culture microbienne et/ou mammifère ou dans le domaine de la purification des protéines
• Excellentes compétences en communication, joueur d'équipe, motivé et orienté vers la solution
• La maîtrise de l'anglais requise, la maîtrise de l'allemand est considérée comme un plus
• Ouvert au travail posté (4 postes)
• La compréhension de base des BPF est un plus Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• Responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects in therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for several Manufacturing Specialists for our Ibex-facility. In this role, you will be responsible for performing operational activities of assigned manufacturing projects in specific areas (Up-stream or Down-stream processing).

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will do:

• Perform upstream or downstream manufacturing activities following cGMP guidelines

• Troubleshoot equipment, evaluate test results, and recommend solutions

• Support safety, environmental monitoring, and cleaning risk assessments

• Prepare and maintain documentation such as batch records and SOPs

• Review production documents and support deviations, change requests, and CAPAs

• Contribute to capital investment projects and equipment commissioning

• Train manufacturing staff on equipment and standard operations

What we are looking for:

• Education or training in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering, or related field

• Experience in microbial or mammalian cultivation, or protein purification

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset

• Fluent in English; German is a plus

• Willingness to work in a 4-shift system

• Basic understanding of GMP is an advantage

What you will get:

• A dynamic and innovative work environment

• Opportunities to grow your career and develop new skills

• A chance to make a meaningful impact in life sciences

• Supportive team culture and inclusive workplace

• Relocation support for eligible candidates

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

A new production plant in the field of biotechnological production is being built at the Visp site. This is an exciting time to join our team. We’re seeking motivated and resilient individuals to play a key role in vaccine production—both during the project phase and as we transition to routine operations.
Join us as a Manufacturing Specialist – Opportunities for All Experience Levels!

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you’ll do:
during the project phase

• Support the project team in defining and setting up innovative vaccine production processes.

• Collaborate on the qualification and validation of new production areas and processes.

in routine production

• Execute manufacturing activities in either the Upstream Processing, the Downstream Processing or the Bioconjugates area according to cGMP and SOPs guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Support the preparation of SHE (Safety, Health, environment), EM (Environmental Monitoring), operation and cleaning risk assessment for the assigned products and the implementation and control of defined measures

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Review production documentation and work on deviations, change requests and implementation of CAPAs to ensure high-quality GMP standards

• Engage in Capital investment projects for building and commissioning of new manufacturing units as manufacturing expert. Responsible for delivering all input required for the specific set-up, commissioning and qualification of the manufacturing suites and equipment

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

jobs.description:
This position is located in Stein, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our successful and growing Drug Product focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Global MSAT DP Qualification & Validation Lead position.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

What you will do:

• Lead global process control strategy for drug product manufacturing

• Own global strategies for equipment qualification (PQ), process validation (PPQ), and continued process verification (CPV)

• Define and govern global SOPs, standards, templates, and tools aligned with regulations and best practice

• Own qualification strategy for key unit operations: thawing, compounding, filling, lyophilization, and crimping

• Guide Tech Transfer and local MSAT teams on validation strategies, scale‑up, and sampling plans

• Review and approve validation documentation; analyze production data using appropriate statistical methods

• Act as subject‑matter expert during health authority inspections on validation and CPV/OPV

What we are looking for:

• Ph.D. in pharmaceutical sciences, engineering, biochemistry, or related field; or equivalent experience

• Expertise in equipment qualification for aseptic drug product manufacturing

• Extensive experience in process validation for sterile biologics, including lyophilized and liquid formats

• Proven experience with regulatory submissions and pre‑approval inspections

• Strong statistical skills for qualification, validation, and CPV; Data Science certification or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt preferred

• Knowledge of risk assessment, deviation management, change control, and root cause analysis

• Excellent English communication, documentation, leadership, and cross‑functional collaboration skills

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or related fields is an advantage

• Sound knowledge of biotechnological processes either in the area of microbial and/or mammalian cultivation or protein purification

• Excellent communication skills, great teammate, driven and solution-oriented

• Fluency in English required, fluency in German is considered a plus

• Open to work in shift (4-shift system)

• Basic GMP understanding is a plus

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.
Lonza is a global leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. While we are driven by science, there is no magic formula for how we approach our work. Our most valuable scientific solution is our dedicated people who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies improve lives. In return, our employees manage their careers independently, as their ideas—whether big or small—make the world a better place. This is the kind of work we want to be part of.
A new production plant in the field of biotechnological production is being built at the Visp site. This is an exciting time to join our team, whether you’re a seasoned professional or just starting your career. We’re seeking motivated and resilient individuals to play a key role in vaccine production—both during the project phase and as we transition to routine operations.
Join us as an Operator – Opportunities for All Experience Levels!

What you’ll do:
during the project phase:

• Support the project team in defining and setting up innovative vaccine production processes.

• Collaborate on the qualification and validation of new production areas and processes.

in routine production

• Adhere to relevant SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and regulations (e.g., hygiene concept, safety regulations)

• Independently operate production plants and equipment, including preparation, operation, and post-processing, following SOPs.

• Perform microbiological environmental monitoring, in-process controls (IPC), and sample taking

• Monitor production processes, detect and report potential issues, and actively participate in continuous improvement processes

• Conduct GMP-compliant work and timely documentation of activities (e.g., computer systems (MES) or log books)

• Handle, clean, store, and inspect equipment

What we’re looking for:

• We welcome candidates from all experience levels, whether you’re a seasoned expert or a career changer with relevant qualifications. If you’re enthusiastic about contributing to cutting-edge vaccine production, we’d love to hear from you

• for Entry-Level Candidates: Completed apprenticeship in pharmaceutical, chemical, or biotechnological fields, or a relevant university degree

• for Experienced Professionals: Several years of experience in pharmaceutical production, particularly in GMP and cleanroom environments, is a plus.

• Safety awareness

• Fluent in German and/or English

• Willingness to work shifts (4 shifts)

• Ability to work in a team, reliability, and a high degree of personal responsibility

• Flexibility

Lonza's products and services positively impact millions of people every day. For us, this is not only a great honor but also a significant responsibility. How we achieve our business results is as important to us as the results themselves. At Lonza, respect is paramount, and we protect both our employees and our environment. For us, success means morally justifiable progress.
Lonza is joined by people who take on challenges.
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging (IDB)
Inclusion is one of Lonza’s four core values, alongside integrity, innovation and initiative. We understand the value of our differences and the benefits they bring to our company, community and culture. We also recognize the value of every person’s contribution, regardless of characteristics, preferences and beliefs – including race, color, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity and religion.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp , Switzerland, this role operates at the interface of Operations, Engineering and Strategic Growth Projects within the Advanced Synthesis network. In close collaboration with Global Engineering, MSAT, Quality and Strategy teams, the Associate Director, Asset Design and Innovation leads the development, evaluation and implementation of state-of-the-art and future-oriented asset and technology solutions with focus on growth-projects. This role is ideal for a self‑driven individual who proactively identifies opportunities to improve asset design, manufacturing performance and technology deployment. The position has a strong focus on enabling highly cost‑effective, compliant and reliable manufacturing by design, with particular emphasis on optimized lifecycle and OpEx performance. Beyond individual projects, the role actively shapes a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and innovation across the global network and may take key responsibilities in selected global strategic growth initiatives.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Proactively identify, evaluate and drive opportunities to improve asset design and manufacturing technologies, delivering measurable gains in cost, reliability and performance.

• Take full end-to-end ownership for innovation initiatives in growth projects – from idea generation and feasibility assessment through business case development, implementation oversight and benefit realization.

• Independently evaluate, propose and justify solutions that optimize operational expenditure (OpEx) and asset lifecycle costs by design.

• Actively integrate forward-looking, fit-for-purpose solutions into strategic growth projects while ensuring full cGMP compliance and adherence to safety standards.

• Continuously challenge the status quo, share best practices and actively contribute to building a sustainable manufacturing innovation platform across the Advanced Synthesis network.

• Support and constructively challenge by proactively contributing ideas, insights and execution power to strategic transformation initiatives.

What we are looking for:

• Master’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Biologics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Senior-level, self-driven leader with a proven track record of identifying opportunities and converting them into sustainable operational and business impact.

• Demonstrated ability to independently set direction, take full ownership and drive complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion in a global matrix environment.

• Deep manufacturing, engineering and technology expertise, combined with the confidence to challenge the status quo and influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to build, defend and execute robust business cases while delivering against demanding performance targets.

• Acts as a role model for accountability, execution excellence and continuous improvement, leading through actions rather than formal authority.

• Innovative mindset with the ability to think beyond traditional boundaries; experience with Lonza systems and processes is a plus.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, enabling alignment and momentum across functions and leadership levels.

• Fluent in English; German proficiency is a plus.

About Lonza

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Based in Visp , Switzerland, this role operates at the interface of Operations, Engineering and Strategic Growth Projects within the Advanced Synthesis network. In close collaboration with Global Engineering, MSAT, Quality and Strategy teams, the Associate Director, Asset Design and Innovation leads the development, evaluation and implementation of state-of-the-art and future-oriented asset and technology solutions with focus on growth-projects. This role is ideal for a self‑driven individual who proactively identifies opportunities to improve asset design, manufacturing performance and technology deployment. The position has a strong focus on enabling highly cost‑effective, compliant and reliable manufacturing by design, with particular emphasis on optimized lifecycle and OpEx performance. Beyond individual projects, the role actively shapes a culture of continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and innovation across the global network and may take key responsibilities in selected global strategic growth initiatives.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Proactively identify, evaluate and drive opportunities to improve asset design and manufacturing technologies, delivering measurable gains in cost, reliability and performance.

• Take full end-to-end ownership for innovation initiatives in growth projects – from idea generation and feasibility assessment through business case development, implementation oversight and benefit realization.

• Independently evaluate, propose and justify solutions that optimize operational expenditure (OpEx) and asset lifecycle costs by design.

• Actively integrate forward-looking, fit-for-purpose solutions into strategic growth projects while ensuring full cGMP compliance and adherence to safety standards.

• Continuously challenge the status quo, share best practices and actively contribute to building a sustainable manufacturing innovation platform across the Advanced Synthesis network.

• Support and constructively challenge by proactively contributing ideas, insights and execution power to strategic transformation initiatives.

What we are looking for:

• Master’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Biologics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Senior-level, self-driven leader with a proven track record of identifying opportunities and converting them into sustainable operational and business impact.

• Demonstrated ability to independently set direction, take full ownership and drive complex, cross-functional initiatives to successful completion in a global matrix environment.

• Deep manufacturing, engineering and technology expertise, combined with the confidence to challenge the status quo and influence senior stakeholders.

• Strong business and financial acumen, including the ability to build, defend and execute robust business cases while delivering against demanding performance targets.

• Acts as a role model for accountability, execution excellence and continuous improvement, leading through actions rather than formal authority.

• Innovative mindset with the ability to think beyond traditional boundaries; experience with Lonza systems and processes is a plus.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, enabling alignment and momentum across functions and leadership levels.

• Fluent in English; German proficiency is a plus.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our team at Lonza in Visp, Switzerland as a CQV Engineer / Qualification & Validation Engineer (m/f/d). Work alongside an outstanding team dedicated to maintaining flawless operations and premier standards. This role provides an exciting chance to contribute to our dynamic environment, directly improving the quality and efficiency of our processes. Take part in qualifying and validating brand-new process engineering equipment and facilities, promoting continuous improvement and innovation.

Your Career with Lonza in Visp, Switzerland

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

What you will do:

• Coordinate efforts between internal teams and external service providers and suppliers to ensure seamless project execution.

• Strong proficiency in MS Office; familiarity with COMOS, DMS, Kneat, TrackWise, and SAP is advantageous

• Proficient in both written and spoken German and/or English

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face increasing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.
In order to support our continued growth Lonza is seeking Bioprocess Engineers with a relevant background in Life Sciences and a passion for Biotechnology to join our talent community in Visp, Switzerland. Become part of this great opportunity and join our team by applying for the position as Bioprocess Engineer in Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing or BioConjugate Manufacturing.

Key responsibilities:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• Lead of one or more defined USP areas (e.g. seed train, main cultivation or harvest) for the production of therapeutic proteins with either mammalian or microbial expressions systems (Bioprocess Engineer USP)

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from either mammalian or microbial cells (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

• Responsible for entire processes or process units for clinical and commercial manufacturing projects in therapeutic BioConjugates like Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Key requirements:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Working experience in biomanufacturing would be an advantage

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Life Sciences, die auf drei Kontinenten tätig sind. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung ist engagierte Menschen, die zusammen arbeiten, Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Austausch, wir lassen unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, wirklich verbessern die Welt. Und das, die Art von Arbeit, die wir wollen, um Teil zu sein.

Als globaler Fertigungspartner für viele verschiedene Kunden steigern wir die Produktionskapazität. Da andere Unternehmen mit zunehmender wirtschaftlicher Unsicherheit konfrontiert sind, haben wir das Glück, Expansionsmöglichkeiten zu haben. Durch diese neue Zusammenarbeit wird unsere Arbeit einen signifikanten, direkten und langfristigen Einfluss auf das Management dieses globalen Pandemiens haben. Um unser weiteres Wachstum zu unterstützen, sucht Lonza Bioprozessingenieure mit einem relevanten Hintergrund in Life Sciences und einer Leidenschaft für Biotechnologie, sich unserer Talent-Community in Visp, Schweiz, anzuschließen.

Werden Sie Teil dieser großartigen Gelegenheit und schließen Sie sich unserem Team an, indem Sie sich für die Position als Bioprozessingenieur in der Upstream Processing oder Downstream Processing oder BioConjugate Manufacturing bewerben.

Verantwortungsbewusstsein - Gewährleistung, dass die operativen Tätigkeiten für die klinische und/oder kommerzielle Fertigung rechtzeitig und innerhalb der vorgegebenen Sicherheit und Qualitätsstandards durchgeführt werden - Gesetz als funktioneller Lead für die Vorbereitung, Herstellungsausführung, Reinigung und Umstellung im zugewiesenen Bereich - Blei eines oder mehrerer definierter USP-Bereiche (z.B. Saatgutzug, Hauptanbau oder Ernte) für die Produktion von therapeutischen Proteinen mit Säugetier- oder mikrobiellen Expressionssystemen (Bioprocess Engineer USP) - Verantwortlich für einen oder mehrere definierte DSP-Bereiche (z.B.

Verstärkung, Polieren oder Füllen) für die Reinigung von therapeutischen Proteinen aus Säugetierzellen oder mikrobiellen Zellen (Bioprocess Engineer DSP) - Verantwortlich für ganze Prozesse oder Prozesseinheiten für klinische und kommerzielle Fertigungsprojekte in therapeutischen BioKonjugate wie Antibody Drug Conjugates (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

- Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Biochemie oder verwandte Lebenswissenschaften (z.B. chromatographie) - Arbeitserfahrung in der Biomanufaktur - GMP-Erfahrung und -Verständnis der Bioprozesstechnik - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationskompetenzen in Englisch, gute deutsche Fähigkeiten von Vorteil

Was wir bieten Jeden Tag haben Lonza, seine Produkte und Dienstleistungen einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erreichen, ist kein Erfolg, wenn nicht ethisch erreicht.

Die Menschen kommen nach Lonza für die Herausforderung und Kreativität, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Lebenswissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt kommt.

gain, polissage ou remplissage) pour la purification des protéines thérapeutiques à partir de cellules mammifères ou microbiennes (Bioprocess Engineer DSP) - Responsable de processus ou d'unités de processus entiers pour des projets de fabrication clinique et commerciale dans des BioConjugates thérapeutiques comme les Conjugates Anticorps (ADC) (Bioprocess Engineer BioConjugates)

Exigences - Maîtrise, diplôme ou expérience équivalente en biotechnologie, génie biochimique, biochimie ou sujet connexe aux sciences de la vie, ou titulaire d'un baccalauréat, ayant une expérience en production de produits pharmaceutiques - Connaissances dans les unités de l'USP (comme les bioréacteurs) ou du DSP (comme la chromatographie) - Expérience de travail en bioproduction serait un avantage - Expérience de BPF et compréhension de la technologie des bioprocédés - Excellente capacité de communication en anglais, bonne compétence allemande d'avantage

Chez Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons nos gens et notre environnement.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec améliorer la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

• Complete manufacturing activities in either the Upstream Processing or Downstream Processing area according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Support the preparation of SHE (Safety, Health, environment), EM (Environmental Monitoring), operation and cleaning risk assessment for the assigned products and the implementation and control of defined measures

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

Key requirements:

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or corresponding training qualification, Bachelor / Master's degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biology, Biochemical Engineering or related fields is an advantage

• Sound knowledge of biotechnological processes either in the area of microbial and/or mammalian cultivation or protein purification

• Excellent communication skills, great teammate, driven and solution-oriented

• Fluency in English required, fluency in German is considered a plus

jobs.description:
Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Als CQV Ingenieur (m/w/d) bist Du für die Qualifizierung und Validierung von verfahrenstechnischem Equipment und Einrichtungen verantwortlich. Du trägst massgebend zur laufenden Optimierung von Prozessen, Anlagen und internen Abläufen bei. Du bist für die Sicherstellung des nötigen fachtechnischen Wissensstands des Anlagepersonals sowie der Engineering-Gruppen mitverantwortlich.

Deine Karriere bei Lonza in Visp

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Erstellen von Inbetriebnahme- und Qualifizierungsunterlagen für Neuanlagen, sowie die Betreuung von Umbau-, Ausbau- und Neubauprojekten; aufgegliedert wird dies in PQs auf Neubauprojekten für kritische Systeme und die SLC Betreuung aller Systeme nach der Produktivstellung

• Betreuung von Abweichungen, Änderungen (GEP und GMP), sowie CAPAs

• Koordination von internen Gruppen, sowie externen Dienstleistern und Lieferanten

• Verantwortung für die Präsentation der Qualifizierungsunterlagen bei Audits und Inspektionen

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung (ETH, FH, HF) ODER vergleichbare Berufserfahrung

• Gute Berufserfahrung im regulierten Umfeld bezüglich Inbetriebnahme, Qualifizierung und Validierung z.B. Kühl- und Gefrierschränke, Reinmedienräume, sowie verfahrenstechnischem Equipment - ein Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office werden vorausgesetzt, Kenntnisse in COMOS (Plant Engineering Softwarelösung), DMS, TrackWise und SAP sind von Vorteil

• Deutsch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift) und Englisch (verhandlungssicher)

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten mit gutem Kommunikationsstil, ausserdem strukturiertes, fokussiertes und gut organisiertes Arbeitsverhalten

​
Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

As a CQV engineer (m/w/d) you are responsible for the qualification and validation of process equipment and facilities. You contribute to the ongoing optimization of processes, plants and internal processes. You are responsible for ensuring the necessary technical knowledge of the plant staff and the engineering groups.

Your career at Lonza in Visp

What we offer you:

• A career in the company and a dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Remuneration programmes that recognise high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. You can also find the full list of our global services at https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your tasks:

• Creation of commissioning and qualification documents for new plants, as well as the supervision of conversion, expansion and new construction projects; this is divided into PQs into new construction projects for critical systems and the SLC supervision of all systems after production

• Support for deviations, changes (GEP and GMP), and CAPAs

• Coordination of internal groups, as well as external service providers and suppliers

• Responsibility for presenting the qualification documents during audits and inspections

Your requirement profile:

• Completed training (ETH, FH, HF) OR comparable professional experience

• Good professional experience in the regulated environment regarding commissioning, qualification and validation e.g. refrigerators and freezers, clean media rooms, as well as process engineering equipment - an advantage

• Good knowledge in Microsoft Office is provided that knowledge of COMOS (Plant Engineering Software Solution), DMS, TrackWise and SAP are beneficial

• German (in German and in German) and English (in English)

• Self-employed and flexible working with good communication style, as well as structured, focused and well-organised work behaviour

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. Our globally networked teams work together every day at over 30 locations on five continents to produce tomorrow's drugs. EMEA Associate Director, Business Development
Locations: Visp or Basel
Working Pattern: Remote with 50% regular travel involved

The role
We are seeking an EMEA Associate Director of Business Development to drive growth across Lonza’s Specialized Modalities platform, including cell therapy, viral vectors, exosomes, mRNA, and microbial development and manufacturing services.

In this role, you will build strong customer relationships across mainland Europe and develop new business opportunities. You will work closely with internal experts to deliver tailored solutions that meet customer needs and clearly demonstrate Lonza’s value.

* The role involves regular travel of up to 50% to meet customers and attend industry events.

What you will get

• An agile career in a dynamic and innovative working culture

• An inclusive, ethical, and safety‑first workplace

• Compensation programmes that recognise performance and contribution

• A range of benefits depending on role and location

• Access to our full global benefits offering: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Build and manage a strong pipeline by engaging customers and developing new opportunities

• Own the sales cycle from first contact through to negotiation and deal closure

• Understand customer needs and position Lonza’s Specialized Modalities solutions effectively

• Develop a broad network across the cell and gene therapy, mRNA and Microbial markets

• Plan for, organize and attend customer meetings, conferences, and industry events to generate new leads

• Share market insights and competitive intelligence to support commercial strategy

• Collaborate with internal teams to deliver tailored proposals and smooth account handovers

What we are looking for

• A BSc or MSc or PhD in a scientific discipline is preferred

• 5+ years of commercial experience in the CDMO space within the pharmaceutical industry

• Fluent written and spoken English; additional languages are an advantage

• Proven experience managing a full sales or project lifecycle

• Proven previous involvement in contract negotiations in a leading role and as part of negotiating contracts. Ability to proactively lead all stakeholders involved up to final close of a contract

• Ability to create customer‑focused presentations

• Knowledge of the drug development lifecycle

• Experience using CRM tools such as Salesforce is desirable

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With over 30 sites across five continents, our teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion, and Integrity guide how we work and succeed together.

• Strong analytical mindset with experience in ERP/SAP systems, BI tools, Excel, Power BI and a high affinity for data and KPIs

• Capability to deliver clear risk reporting, dashboards, and management presentations aligned with quality, regulatory and client expectations

• Skill in maintaining accurate risk insights reflecting changes in suppliers, materials or processes, combined with a proactive, solution‑oriented working style

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across functions; very good English and good German proficiency

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As a Supplies and Inventory Manager (m/f/d) at our Visp site, you play a key role in safeguarding supply security within a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment. You leverage master data to strengthen risk transparency, ensure robust reporting, and collaborate closely with Planning, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Project Management, Production and other stakeholders.
Your work enables early risk detection, structured evaluation, and effective mitigations supporting uninterrupted manufacturing and ultimately ensuring patient supply.

Additionally, you manage inventory performance, including warehouse–SAP data alignment, monthly reporting, and continuous optimization.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below:

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do

• Develop, maintain, and continuously improve a structured supply chain risk reporting landscape

• Identify, analyze, and assess key supply chain risks (e.g., sourcing constraints, long lead times, compliance risks)

• Define and monitor essential KPIs to drive transparency and improved sourcing decisions

• Conduct risk assessments for critical materials and optimize inventory availability

• Provide monthly inventory updates with detailed performance analytics

• Prepare scenario analyses and recommend effective mitigation actions for potential disruptions

• Collaborate cross‑functionally to collect, validate, and interpret risk‑related data

What we are looking for

• Academic background in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics or similar (Bachelor required; Master’s preferred)

• Professional experience in supply chain, risk management, planning, procurement or related fields, with strong understanding of end‑to‑end supply chain processes

• Ability to support and further develop risk catalogues, registers and escalation processes while driving master data quality improvements

• Strong analytical mindset with experience in ERP/SAP systems, BI tools, Excel, Power BI and a high affinity for data and KPIs

• Capability to deliver clear risk reporting, dashboards, and management presentations aligned with quality, regulatory and client expectations

• Skill in maintaining accurate risk insights reflecting changes in suppliers, materials or processes, combined with a proactive, solution‑oriented working style

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills across functions; very good English and good German proficiency

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now

Lonza is now a world leader in the Life Sciences business, which operates on three continents. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for how we work. • Identifying and setting the right priorities

• Completed vocational training (EFZ) or technical school (HF) in the field of pharmaceuticals/chemistry or in the sanitary/heating industry

• Very good German knowledge in word and writing; English skills are advantageous

Lonza's products and services have a daily positive impact on millions of people. This is not only a great honour for us, but also a great responsibility. Ready to help shape the future of Life Sciences? Then apply now!

jobs.description:
Ort: Visp

Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten!

Werden Sie Teil unseres QC 24/7 Analytical Services Teams – und übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle in der Biologics-Produktion am Standort Visp!

Unser Team ist die zentrale Drehscheibe für sämtliche analytischen Proben aus der Produktion – rund um die Uhr. Als Shift Team Lead übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für ein interdisziplinäres Team und stellen sicher, dass zeitkritische Analysen zuverlässig, effizient und GMP-konform durchgeführt werden. Sie verbinden operative Exzellenz mit Leadership und sind damit ein entscheidender Erfolgsfaktor für unsere Produktion.

Was macht diese Rolle so spannend?
Als Shift Team Lead steuern Sie nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft, sondern entwickeln Ihr Team aktiv weiter und treiben Qualität, Performance und Zusammenarbeit voran. Sie behalten den Überblick über alle Analysen, setzen Prioritäten und sorgen dafür, dass Ergebnisse termingerecht und in höchster Qualität geliefert werden – in einem dynamischen 24/7 Umfeld mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktion.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsrolle in einem hochmodernen, technologiegetriebenen Umfeld

• Unterstützung durch ein starkes Netzwerk aus Experten und Führungskräften

• Attraktive Weiterentwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten im Leadership-Bereich

• Arbeiten im 4-Schicht-Modell mit entsprechender Flexibilität im Alltag

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Fachliche und personelle Führung eines Schichtteams im 24/7 Betrieb

• Sicherstellung von Sicherheit, Qualität und termingerechter Durchführung aller Analysen

• Koordination und Priorisierung aller anfallenden Tätigkeiten im Team (Schichtsteuerung)

• Förderung und Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeitenden (Coaching, Training, Feedback)

• Sicherstellung von GMP-Compliance, Datenintegrität und ordnungsgemässer Dokumentation

• Enge Abstimmung und Kommunikation mit Produktion und anderen QC-Einheiten

• Leitung von Schicht-Huddles sowie Sicherstellung strukturierter Schichtübergaben

• Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen im Laboralltag

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld, idealerweise in der Analytik (QC)

• Erste Führungserfahrung oder ausgeprägtes Interesse an einer Führungsrolle

• Hohe Verantwortungsbereitschaft sowie strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit

• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Qualität, Datenintegrität und regulatorische Anforderungen

• Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse, Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (4-Schicht-Betrieb)

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich

Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Luogo Visp

Descrizione Se necessario, durante il trasferimento è disponibile un sostegno per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie.

Lonza è ora leader mondiale nel settore delle scienze della vita, che opera in tre continenti. Siamo attivi nella scienza, ma non c'è alcuna formula magica per il nostro lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è quella di dipendenti di talento che lavorano insieme e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti gestiscono la loro carriera indipendentemente. Perché le loro idee, grandi o piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo avere nelle nostre mani!

Entra a far parte del nostro team di servizi analitici QC 24/7 e assume un ruolo chiave nella produzione di Bio-Cens sul sito Visp!

Il nostro team è il centro di tutti i campioni analitici della produzione. 24 ore su 24. Come caposquadra Shift, ti assumerai la responsabilità di un team interdisciplinare e ti assicurerai che le analisi cronologiche siano effettuate in modo affidabile, efficiente e conforme alle norme GMP. Combinano eccellenza operativa con leadership e sono quindi un fattore chiave di successo per la nostra produzione.

Cosa rende questo ruolo così emozionante? Come capofila del team di turni, non solo gestisci il business quotidiano, ma sviluppi anche attivamente il tuo team e guidi in avanti qualità, prestazioni e collaborazione. Tieni traccia di tutte le analisi, fissi le priorità e assicurati che i risultati vengano consegnati in tempo e nella massima qualità. in un ambiente dinamico 24/7 con impatto diretto sulla produzione.

Cosa offriamo - Un ruolo di leadership responsabile in un ambiente all'avanguardia e tecnologicamente guidato - Supporto attraverso una forte rete di esperti e dirigenti - Opportunità di sviluppo e carriera interessanti nel settore del marchio - Lavorare nel modello a 4 turni con flessibilità adeguata nella vita quotidiana

I vostri compiti - Gestione professionale e personale di un gruppo di turni in funzionamento 24/7 - Garantire la sicurezza, la qualità e l'esecuzione tempestiva di tutte le analisi - Coordinamento e priorità di tutti i compiti pertinenti del gruppo (controllo dei turni) - Promozione e ulteriore sviluppo dei dipendenti (coaching, formazione, feedback) - Garantire la conformità GMP, l'integrità dei dati e la documentazione adeguata - Stretto coordinamento e comunicazione con la produzione e altre unità QC - Gestione del turno H-h-MJ e garanzia di trasferimenti strutturati dei turni -

Identificazione e attuazione di misure di miglioramento nella vita quotidiana di laboratorio

Il tuo profilo di esigenza - esperienza pluriennale in ambiente GMP, idealmente in analisi (QC) - Prima esperienza di leadership o forte interesse per il ruolo di leadership - Alta disponibilità ad assumersi responsabilità e metodi di lavoro strutturati e orientati alla soluzione - Alta capacità di comunicazione e di squadra - Ottima comprensione della qualità, integrità dei dati e requisiti normativi - Abilità tedesca a prova di trattativa, competenze inglesi sono un plus - disponibilità a lavorare a turni (4 turni-azienda)

Lonza, i prodotti e i servizi hanno un impatto positivo quotidiano su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungiamo i nostri risultati aziendali è importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una grande risorsa e proteggiamo i nostri dipendenti così come il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è dove le persone vengono ad affrontare le sfide e sviluppare nuove idee per questioni complesse con la loro creatività nel campo della scienza della vita. Insieme, contribuiamo a migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo, offrendo loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare una vera differenza con il loro lavoro.

Lonza è un gruppo di 3.7 persone nel settore farmaceutico e biotecnologico, e la società MEM maggiore PANORAMA F a Visp (Valais), Basilea, e Stein (Argovia), Svizzera.

Place Visp

Description If necessary, support for eligible candidates and their families is available during the move.

Lonza is now a world leader in the Life Sciences business, which operates on three continents. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for how we work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who work together and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees manage their careers independently. Because their ideas, whether large or small, improve the world. And this is the kind of work we want to have in our hands!

Become part of our QC 24/7 Analytical Services team – and take on a key role in Bio-Cens production at the Visp site!

Our team is the central hub for all analytical samples from production – around the clock. As a Shift Team Lead, you take responsibility for an interdisciplinary team and ensure that time-critical analyses are carried out reliably, efficiently and in compliance with GMP. They combine operational excellence with leadership and are thus a key success factor for our production.

What makes this role so exciting? As a Shift Team Lead, you not only manage the day-to-day business, but also actively develop your team and drive quality, performance and collaboration forward. You keep track of all analyses, set priorities and ensure that results are delivered on time and in the highest quality – in a dynamic 24/7 environment with direct impact on production.

What we offer you - A responsible leadership role in a state-of-the-art, technology-driven environment - Support through a strong network of experts and executives - Attractive development and career opportunities in the field of the brand - Working in the 4-shift model with appropriate flexibility in everyday life

Your tasks - Professional and personnel management of a shift team in 24/7 operation - Ensuring safety, quality and timely execution of all analyses - Coordination and prioritization of all relevant tasks in the team (shift control) - Promotion and further development of employees (coaching, training, feedback) - Ensuring GMP compliance, data integrity and proper documentation - Close coordination and communication with production and other QC units - Management of shift H-h-knives and ensuring structured shift transfers -

Identification and implementation of improvement measures in everyday laboratory life

Your requirement profile - multi-year experience in the GMP environment, ideally in analytics (QC) - First leadership experience or keen interest in leadership role - High willingness to take responsibility and structured and solution-oriented working methods - High communication and team skills - Very good understanding of quality, data integrity and regulatory requirements - Negotiation-proof German skills, English skills are a plus - readiness to shift work (4 shift-company)

Lonza, the products and services have a daily positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great honour, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important for us as our successes themselves. At Lonza, respect is a great asset and we protect our employees as well as our environment. Success for us means morally acceptable progress.

Lonza is where people come to meet challenges and develop new ideas for complex issues with their creativity in the field of life science. Together, we contribute to improving the lives of many people around the world, offering them the certainty and satisfaction of making a real difference with their work.

- Verwaltung von Compliance-Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit SOP-Bewertungen und CAPAs mit mehreren Vermögenswerten und Gewährleistung einer zeitnahen Schließung.
