jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of

The Visp site in Switzerland is growing rapidly, driven by our Advanced Synthesis Business Platform, which includes Bioconjugates and Small Molecules. Our teams specialize in developing and manufacturing drug substances under GMP, helping bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide.

We are hiring (Senior) Program Managers to join our Advanced Synthesis organization. In this role, you’ll be the main link between Lonza and our customers, leading cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from contract to GMP manufacturing and delivery.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead and deliver customer programs across their full lifecycle—from technology transfer to GMP manufacturing and project closure—ensuring quality, timeliness, and cost-effectiveness.

• Act as a trusted partner and main point of contact for customers, fostering transparent communication and long-term collaboration.

• Inspire and coordinate diverse, cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, promoting shared ownership and high performance.

• Drive program success by managing scope, timelines, and financials, while aligning with strategic business goals.

• Collaborate across functions to manage scope changes, support commercial strategies, and contribute to future opportunities.

• Identify and address risks proactively, ensuring smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.

• Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and professional development.

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field; PhD is a plus.

• Experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO.

• Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and organizational factors.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex programs.

• Knowledge of GMP manufacturing and drug substance development.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

• Fluent in English; German is a plus.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician Quality Control 80-100%

titleByLocale.fr: Technicien de Laboratoire Contrôle de Qualité 80-100%

jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Als Mitglied der Qualitätskontrolle (QC) sind sie verantwortlich für die praktische Durchführung eines breiten Spektrums von biologischen und biochemischen Methoden zur Charakterisierung von komplexen und hoch aktiven konjugierten Antikörperwirkstoffen (aber auch anderer Biomoleküle) unter ISO und GMP. Bei den Biokonjugaten handelt es sich um eine innovative Klasse an Wirkstoffen, in die u.a. in der Krebstherapie grosse Hoffnungen gesetzt werden.
Das ELISA Team arbeitet vorwiegend mit Bioconjugaten und gehört zur Abteilung QC-Biologics. Die QC-Biologics ist in die übergeordnete QC-Organisation am Standort Visp mit mehr als 400 Mitarbeitern integriert.

Aufgaben:

• Mitarbeit an der Entwicklung, Transfer und Validierung sowie der Routineanalytik von biologischen und biochemischen Methoden im ELISA Team (ELISA, Dot Blots und biochemischer Gehaltsbestimmungen)

• Durchführung der Methoden unter ISO- bzw. GMP-Bedingungen

• Aktive Mitarbeit an Untersuchungen durchgefallener Assays unter Anleitung mit Troubleshooting

• Kontrolle und Freigabe von Hilfsprotokollen anderer Teammitglieder

• Wartung und Kalibrierung von Laborgeräten

• Mitarbeit an der Erstellung GMP relevanter Dokumente

Ihr Augenmerk liegt bei ihrer Tätigkeit auf der sicheren und qualitätskonformen Bearbeitung der zugewiesenen Aufträge. Sie sind selbstständig im Rahmen von Studien und Projekten tätig und übernehmen Verantwortung für deren Erfolg.
Sehr gerne werden auch Lehrabgänger für diese Position berücksichtigt.

Qualifikationen:

• Sie haben eine passende Berufslehre (Biologielaborant/in oder vergleichbar) abgeschlossen

• Idealerweise haben sie  schon grundlegende Erfahrungen im GMP-Umfeld, bevorzugt in einem analytischen Labor, gesammelt

• Es macht Ihnen Spass, sich auf die wechselnden Herausforderungen der Projekte einzulassen und Ihre Umsetzung im Labor flexibel, eigenverantwortlich und sorgfältig anzugehen

• Neben Deutsch besitzen Sie sich auch grundlegende Englischkenntnisse (mindestens Leseverständnis)

• Eine flexible Persönlichkeit, Teamgeist,  Eigeninitiative, Lern- und Einsatzbereitschaft runden Ihr Profil ab

Was Sie erwartet:

Treten Sie Lonza bei und vereinen Sie das Beste zweier Welten. Sie bekommen die Gelegenheit, mit inspirierenden Kolleginnen und Kollegen an einem führenden wissenschaftlichen und technologischen Standort zu arbeiten. Dabei können Sie einen besonderen Lebensstil geniessen und das Zuhause mitten in den Alpen Ihr Eigen nennen.
Jetzt ist eine spannende Zeit, um unserem Lonza-Team in Visp beizutreten. Seit langem waren und sind wir ein Kompetenzzentrum in der Herstellung von chemischen und pharmazeutischen Produkten für die globalen Pharma- und Chemiemärkte. Der Start des Ibex™ Konzepts ist auch der Start eines neuen Kapitels der Lonza-Geschichte.
Im Wallis werden Sie alles finden, was sie für eine erfüllende Karriere und ein lebenswertes Leben brauchen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza

Lonza è ora un leader globale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Siamo nel campo della scienza, ma non esiste una formula magica per il modo in cui affrontiamo il lavoro. La nostra principale soluzione scientifica è costituita da persone di talento che lavorano insieme e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti gestiscono la propria carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, rendono il mondo un posto migliore. Ed è questo il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo prendere parte.

Compiti

- Partecipazione allo sviluppo, trasferimento e validazione nonché all'analisi di routine di metodi biologici e biochimici nel team ELISA (ELISA, dot blot e determinazioni del contenuto biochimico)
- Implementazione dei metodi in condizioni ISO o GMP
- Partecipazione attiva alle indagini sui test falliti sotto la guida della risoluzione dei problemi
- Controllo e approvazione dei registri di assistenza degli altri membri del team
- Manutenzione e calibrazione delle apparecchiature di laboratorio
- Partecipazione alla creazione dei documenti rilevanti per le GMP

Nel suo lavoro l'attenzione è rivolta all'elaborazione sicura e conforme alla qualità degli ordini assegnati. Lavori in modo indipendente in studi e progetti e ti assumi la responsabilità del loro successo.
Anche i diplomati in apprendistato sono benvenuti a essere presi in considerazione per questa posizione.

Qualifiche

- Aver completato un tirocinio professionale adeguato (assistente di laboratorio di biologia o equivalente).
- Idealmente, hai già acquisito esperienza di base nell'ambiente GMP, preferibilmente in un laboratorio di analisi
- Ti piace essere coinvolto nelle mutevoli sfide dei progetti e affrontare la loro implementazione in laboratorio in modo flessibile, indipendente e attento
- Oltre al tedesco, possiedi anche competenze di inglese di base (almeno comprensione della lettura)
- Personalità flessibile, spirito di squadra, iniziativa, volontà di apprendere e lavorare duro completano il tuo profilo

Cosa aspettarsi

Unisciti a Lonza e unisci il meglio di entrambi i mondi. Avrai l'opportunità di lavorare con colleghi stimolanti in una sede scientifica e tecnologica leader. Puoi goderti uno stile di vita speciale e chiamare la tua casa in mezzo alle Alpi la tua.
Ora è un momento entusiasmante per unirti al nostro team Lonza a Visp. Siamo da tempo e continuiamo ad essere un centro di eccellenza nella produzione di prodotti chimici e farmaceutici per i mercati farmaceutici e chimici globali. Il lancio del concetto Ibex™ è anche l'inizio di un nuovo capitolo nella storia di Lonza.
Nel Vallese troverete tutto ciò di cui avete bisogno per una carriera appagante e una vita degna di essere vissuta.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza

Lonza is now a world leader in the Life Sciences business, which operates on three continents. We are active in science, but there is no magic formula for how we work. Our most important scientific solution is to create talented employees who work together and develop ideas that help other companies to help people. In return, our employees manage their careers independently. Because their ideas, whether large or small, improve the world. And this is the kind of work we want to have part in.

Tasks

- Cooperation in the development, transfer and validation as well as routine analysis of biological and biochemical methods in the ELISA team (ELISA, Dot Blots and biochemical content regulations) - Implementation of methods under ISO or GMP conditions - Active cooperation in investigations of failed Assays under guidance with mercies of mercantiles - Control and release of auxiliary protocols of other team members - Maintenance and calibration of laboratory equipment - Cooperation in the preparation of GMP relevant documents

Your work focuses on the safe and quality-compliant processing of the assigned assignments. You are independent in the context of studies and projects and assume responsibility for their success. Also, apprentices are very happy to be taken into account for this position.

Qualifications

- You have completed a suitable professional apprenticeship (biology laboratory or comparable) - Ideally they have already gained basic experience in the GMP environment, preferably in an analytical laboratory - It is fun to get involved in the changing challenges of the projects and to tackle your implementation in the laboratory flexibly, independently and carefully - Besides German you also have basic English knowledge (at least reading comprehension) - A flexible personality, team spirit, initiative, willingness to learn and use complete your profile

What awaits you

Join Lonza and combine the best of two worlds. You will have the opportunity to work with inspiring colleagues at a leading scientific and technological location. The IbexTM concept is also the start of a new chapter in Lonza history. In Valais you will find everything you need for a fulfilling career and a life worth living.

- Idéalement, vous avez déjà acquis une expérience de base dans l'environnement GMP, de préférence dans un laboratoire d'analyse
- Vous aimez vous impliquer dans les défis changeants des projets et aborder leur mise en œuvre en laboratoire de manière flexible, indépendante et prudente.
- En plus de l'allemand, vous possédez également des compétences de base en anglais (au moins une compréhension écrite)
- Une personnalité flexible, un esprit d'équipe, une initiative, une volonté d'apprendre et de travailler dur complètent votre profil

À quoi s'attendre

Rejoignez Lonza et combinez le meilleur des deux mondes. Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler avec des collègues inspirants dans un site scientifique et technologique de premier plan. Vous pouvez profiter d’un style de vie particulier et faire de votre maison au milieu des Alpes la vôtre.
C’est maintenant une période passionnante pour rejoindre notre équipe Lonza à Viège. Nous sommes depuis longtemps et continuons d'être un centre d'excellence dans la production de produits chimiques et pharmaceutiques destinés aux marchés pharmaceutiques et chimiques mondiaux. Le lancement du concept Ibex™ marque également le début d'un nouveau chapitre dans l'histoire de Lonza.
En Valais, vous trouverez tout ce dont vous avez besoin pour une carrière épanouie et une vie digne d'être vécue.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland.

The Global Transformation Lead for Indirect Procurement acts as a strategic member for the Global Indirect Procurement organization, reporting directly to the Head of Global Indirect Procurement. In this stand-alone, individual contributor role, you are the architect behind the 5-year aspiration plan, ensuring that the setup and structure are optimized to deliver on global saving initiatives. You will lead the Spend Optimization Project, addressing approximately 800MCHF in spend across global categories and the top ten Lonza sites.

The role of this person is to serve as a high-level interface between procurement, finance, and business leadership to ensure that the strategic setup matches the long-term execution plans. You will be the Process Champion for Source to Contract (S2C), prioritizing and following up on Continuous Improvement (CPI) activities as part of Project Sky.

The hired candidate will be responsible for ensuring a solid plan and implementation for the Business Process Transition. You will establish governance for systematic ideation, identify risks early, and ensure timely escalation to senior leadership to maintain project quality and budget.

They will also act as an analytical lead, developing KPI dashboards to monitor global process performance and driving transformational change through professional change management.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.

What you will do:

• Establish the governance model and setup to successfully lead the 800MCHF Spend Optimization project and manage global targets.

• Analyze and interpret requirements to design improved business processes that support future demand plans.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with the CFO, BU Heads, and Site Heads to drive proactive communications and decision-making.

• Review progress against targets, identify obstacles, and implement mitigation solutions or timely escalations.

• Act as the application and process owner for consulting and S2C processes, ensuring standardized workflows across all target audiences.

• Manage KPI dashboards to monitor quality and customer satisfaction for continuous performance improvements.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or Supply Chain.

• 10+ years of experience in international matrix environments.

• Deep background in Indirect Procurement and Global Purchasing.

• Proven track record in procurement improvement, transformation, and team leadership within a matrix setup.

• Exceptional skills in managing complex interfaces and collaborating with senior stakeholders like the CFO and BU leads.

• Ability to manage ambiguity and use business knowledge to make correct and timely decisions.

• Business fluent in English; any other major language is a plus.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

• Bachelor’s in Supply Chain or related field (Master's is a plus); proven SC experience, ideally within Pharma or CDMO.

• Strong analytical abilities to track KPIs, conduct root-cause analysis, and align E2E supply planning with manufacturing strategy.

• Strong presentation skills with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and concisely.

• Exceptional communication, presentation, and networking skills to influence leaders and clients; fluent in English (German is a plus).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione La sede effettiva di questo lavoro è a Visp, Svizzera. L'assistenza per il trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Cosa otterrete - Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica. - Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico. - Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Cosa farete - Come leader centrale della Supply Chain (SC) e collegamento per i vostri progetti assegnati, potrete colmare il divario tra i clienti e i team interni per garantire un'esecuzione operativa impeccabile. - Agire come esperto SC "andare a" nelle riunioni interne e dei clienti, sostenendo le esigenze dei clienti e risolvendo le escalation. - Interfaccia tra PM, Procurement, Qualità, MSAT e Ops per mitigare i rischi E2E (disponibilità materiale, vincoli di magazzino, conflitti di consegna). - Previsione di 3,5 anni di necessità materiali, allineare i Master Production Schedules (MPS), e garantire l'accuratezza dei dati SAP/BOM.

- Superare le OP dei venditori, coordinare la logistica complessa in entrata/uscita e ottimizzare l'inventario E2E tramite SMOG e processi di magazzino di sicurezza. - Guidare lo sviluppo di strumenti SC locali e globali e mentore nuovi membri del team.

Ciò che cerchiamo - Bachelor.s in Supply Chain o relativo campo (Master's è un plus); comprovata esperienza SC, idealmente all'interno di Pharma o CDMO. - Forte capacità analitiche per tracciare KPI, condurre analisi delle cause radice, e allineare la pianificazione dell'offerta E2E con la strategia di produzione. - Forte capacità di presentazione con la capacità di articolare idee complesse in modo chiaro e conciso. - Track record di guida soluzioni cross-funzionali, anticipare i rischi di consegna, e la gestione delle operazioni E2E.

- Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione, presentazione e networking per influenzare leader e clienti; fluente in inglese (tedesco è un plus).

A Lonza I nostri uomini sono la nostra forza più grande. Con oltre 30 siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di 112azione, accountability, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di ognuno, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale per migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando persone di ogni provenienza portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo.

A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a contribuire a trasformare i nostri clienti. idee rivoluzionarie in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita?

Lonza è leader mondiale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti impianti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea, e Stein (Argovia), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Der eigentliche Standort dieses Jobs befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Umsiedlungshilfe ist für die förderungsberechtigten Kandidaten und deren Familien, falls erforderlich, verfügbar.

Was Sie bekommen - Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur. - Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz. - Kompensationsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen.

Was Sie tun werden - Als zentraler Anbieter von Supply Chain (SC) Leader und Verbindungsperson für Ihre zugewiesenen Projekte, werden Sie die Lücke zwischen Kunden und internen Teams zu schließen, um eine einwandfreie operative Ausführung zu gewährleisten. - Handeln Sie als "go-to" SC-Experte in internen und Kundentreffen, für Kundenbedürfnisse und Lösung Eskalationen. - Schnittstelle zwischen PM, Beschaffung, Qualität, MSAT, und Ops zur Minderung von E2E-Risiken (Materialverfügbarkeit, Warenhausbeschränkungen, Lieferkonflikte). - Prognose 3-5 Jahre Materialbedarf, Abstimmung Master Production Plans (MPS), und sicherzustellen SAP/BOM Datengenauigkeit.

- Überwachen Sie Lieferanten POs, koordinieren Sie komplexe Inbound/Outbound-Logistik und optimieren Sie E2E-Inventar über SMOG und Sicherheit Lagerprozesse. - Fahren Sie lokale und globale SC-Toolentwicklung und Mentor neue Teammitglieder.

Was wir suchen - Bachelor,s in Supply Chain oder verwandten Bereich (Master's ist ein Plus); bewährte SC-Erfahrung, ideal innerhalb Pharma oder CDMO. - Starke analytische Fähigkeiten, KPIs zu verfolgen, Durchführung von Wurzel-Ursache-Analysen, und richten E2E-Lieferplanung mit Fertigungsstrategie. - Starke Präsentation Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Ideen klar und prägnant artikulieren. - Spur Aufzeichnung von treibenden Cross-Funktional-Lösungen, Antizipation von Lieferrisiken und Management E2E-Operationen.

- Außergewöhnliche Kommunikation, Präsentation und Vernetzung Fähigkeiten, um Führungskräfte und Kunden zu beeinflussen; fließend Englisch (Deutsch ist ein Plus).

Über Lonza Unsere Mitarbeiter sind unsere größte Stärke. Mit mehr als 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Arzneimittel von morgen herzustellen. jobs.title: Labortechniker QC 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Your responsibilities:

• Perform analytical methods in QC biochemistry in compliance with GMP and safety regulations, with a focus on ELISA and qPCR.

• Independently carry out routine analyses and actively contribute to method implementation, validation and transfer activities.

• Ensure adherence to quality standards, including thorough documentation of results and preparation of standard operating procedures.

• Support daily laboratory operations, including responsibility for equipment, maintenance and ensuring cleanliness and organization.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and workflows.

Your profile:

• Completed trainings as a laboratory technician (chemistry or biology) or an equivalent qualification.

• Solid background in biochemistry, ideally with hands-on experience in ELISA and qPCR.

• Initial experience in quality control (QC) and familiarity with GMP environments is an advantage.

• Independent, structured and detail-oriented working style with strong sense of responsibility.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills with enthusiasm for cross-functional collaboration.

• Proactive, motivated and committed to contribute to a dynamic team environment.

• Fluent English language skills, German is a plus.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione La sede effettiva di questo lavoro è a Visp, Svizzera. L'assistenza per il trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

A proposito di Lonza Oggi Lozza è leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo in scienza, non c'è alcuna formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra soluzione scientifica più grande è persone di talento che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possiede la loro carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Le vostre responsabilità - Eseguire metodi analitici in biochimica QC in conformità con le norme GMP e di sicurezza, con un focus su ELISA e qPCR. - Effettuare indipendentemente analisi di routine e contribuire attivamente all'implementazione dei metodi, convalida e attività di trasferimento. - Garantire l'osservanza degli standard di qualità, compresa la documentazione completa dei risultati e la preparazione delle procedure operative standard. - Sostenere le operazioni quotidiane di laboratorio, compresa la responsabilità per le apparecchiature, manutenzione e garanzia di pulizia e organizzazione.

- Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi e dei flussi di lavoro.

Il tuo profilo - Formazione completa come tecnico di laboratorio (chimica o biologia) o una qualifica equivalente. - Solido background in biochimica, idealmente con esperienza pratica in ELISA e qPCR. - Esperienza iniziale in controllo qualità (QC) e la dermatite con ambienti GMP è un vantaggio. - Indipendente, strutturato e orientato al dettaglio stile di lavoro con forte senso di responsabilità. - Forte comunicazione e capacità di lavoro di squadra con entusiasmo per la collaborazione cross-funzionale. - Proattivo, motivato e impegnato a contribuire a un ambiente di squadra dinamico.

- Abilità fluenti in lingua inglese, il tedesco è un plus.

Quello che offriamo Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi Lonza.s hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungiamo i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante come i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo che raggiungiamo non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con il miglioramento della vita in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader mondiale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti impianti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea, e Stein (Argovia), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Your responsibilities:

• Perform analytical methods in QC biochemistry in compliance with GMP and safety regulations, with a focus on ELISA and qPCR.

• Independently carry out routine analyses and actively contribute to method implementation, validation and transfer activities.

• Ensure adherence to quality standards, including thorough documentation of results and preparation of standard operating procedures.

• Support daily laboratory operations, including responsibility for equipment, maintenance and ensuring cleanliness and organization.

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and workflows.

Your profile:

• Completed trainings as a laboratory technician (chemistry or biology) or an equivalent qualification.

• Solid background in biochemistry, ideally with hands-on experience in ELISA and qPCR.

• Initial experience in quality control (QC) and familiarity with GMP environments is an advantage.

• Independent, structured and detail-oriented working style with strong sense of responsibility.

• Strong communication and teamwork skills with enthusiasm for cross-functional collaboration.

• Proactive, motivated and committed to contribute to a dynamic team environment.

• Fluent English language skills, German is a plus.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammen arbeiten, Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. jobs.title: Internal Auditor/Internal Audit Manager (with experience in Operations and/or Project Management)

titleByLocale.en: Internal Auditor/Internal Audit Manager (with experience in Operations and/or Project Management)

jobs.description:
Internal Auditor/Internal Audit Manager
(with experience in Operations and/or Project Management)
Location – Basel, Switzerland.
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families if needed

For our small, but impactful internal audit team, we are looking for a highly motivated and talented auditor or audit manager. Your task will be to support or lead/execute internal audit assignments within the Lonza Group, while getting to know the business and developing your expertise for a line management career.

Lonza Audit Services (LAS) provides the board and management with independent, risk-based and objective assurance, advice, insight, and foresight. The function is independently positioned with direct accountability to the Board; it works with the management and reviews activities in the organization, reports observations, risks and recommendations to the audited parties, senior management, Executive Committee as well as to the Audit & Compliance Committee.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• A variety of benefits tailored to your localality.

• Access to global benefits via https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• As an auditor, prepare, execute and conduct assigned internal audit activities; as a manager, plan lead and deliver internal audit assignments, including coverage of occasional consulting / advisory engagements in any operational area or covering special projects and strategic initiatives of the company

• As an auditor, support and cooperate with the audit team; as a team lead, train, supervise and guide team member(s) and/or outsourced experts assigned to individual engagements

• Present audit results to stakeholders; prepare clear and concise audit reports that effectively communicate key findings, root causes, and associated risks.

• Cooperate with internal experts to optimize audit preparations and execution with data analytics and SAP configuration reviews; support corresponding activities related to ongoing improvements of audit programs and processes

• Participate in discussions with parts of the organization and global process owners, especially regarding best practices as well as standardization and harmonization of processes and controls

• Follow-up on audit recommendations’ implementation and support the reporting on open and overdue issues to top management

• Lead initiatives and/or contribute to other internal activities and projects constantly optimizing the Internal Audit function

What we are looking for:

• Master degree preferably in finance / accounting, degree in chemistry or similar also welcome

• 3+ years of internal audit experience, complemented by hands-on experience in operations or project delivery (e.g., project management experience, with a solid understanding of project lifecycles, governance, and execution risks)

• Very experienced in executing assignments in compliance with international auditing standards; excellent understanding of standard business processes like S2P, OTC, R2R with solid know-how of SAP

• Excellent command of written and spoken English

• Passionate about leveraging AI and digital tools; knowledge of ETL concepts and familiarity with SQL, Python programming and/or Power BI dashboards a plus

• Good analytical skills, risk focused, target and deadline oriented, result driven and solution developer, motivated self-starter

• Team player and very good communicator with leadership skills and potential to develop career further within the Lonza Group after 3-4 years in internal auditing

• Travel requirements approximately 10-20%

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

titleByLocale.fr: Technicien de laboratoire - Développement de purification 80-100% (m/f/d)

jobs.description:

For IbexTM Solutions, our unique biological manufacturing and development concept in Visp, Switzerland, we are looking for a Laboratory Technician (m/f/d) in Visp in our team in Mammalian Purification Development. jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Lead a high-impact MSAT team through a demanding CAPEX growth project ramp-up—driving Performance Qualifications (PPQs), aseptic process simulations (media fills), and equipment/process qualifications (PQs) for sterile fill & finish lines, supporting technology transfers, and ensuring successful operational readiness. Build accountability, manage performance, deliver under pressure, and shape a resilient, future-ready culture.
We are seeking an authentic leader with proven people leadership experience (including performance management and difficult conversations), strong resilience, and deep expertise in MSAT and sterile fill-finish manufacturing. Experience with lyophilization and/or ADCs is a strong advantage. You will lead the team through facility ramp-up, PPQ execution, aseptic process simulations, technology transfers, inspection readiness, and operational challenges while inspiring a diverse organization through growth and change.

Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead and develop a high-performing MSAT organization responsible for facility ramp-up, process implementation, technology transfers, aseptic process simulations (media fills), process performance qualifications (PPQs), and lifecycle process support. Provide full people leadership responsibility, including talent development, performance management, succession planning, and organizational design. Foster a culture of accountability, empowerment, innovation, resilience, and continuous improvement while ensuring effective utilization of personnel, equipment, materials, and facility resources.

• Own the technical implementation and qualification strategy for manufacturing processes within the facility, ensuring compliance with Lonza standards, customer requirements, GMP regulations, and industry best practices. Drive successful execution of process qualifications, validation activities, and operational readiness milestones to support commercial manufacturing.

• Ensure inspection readiness at all times and serve as a key representative during regulatory inspections, customer audits, and due diligence visits. Present technical strategies, validation approaches, process performance, and investigation outcomes to customers and health authorities with confidence and credibility.

• Partner with Operation and Engineering teams to define and deliver strategic priorities, operational objectives, and long-term capability development plans aligned with site, business unit, and corporate goals. Contribute actively to the overall leadership and performance of the site.

• Collaborate across functions and sites including Operations, Quality, Engineering, Validation, Process Development, Analytical Development, Regulatory Affairs, and Global MSAT to ensure seamless technology transfers, robust process control strategies, and successful commercialization of new products. Act as deputy to the Head of Drug Product Operations Stein as required.

• Establish and continuously improve MSAT standards, systems, and processes, including qualification and validation strategies, single-use technologies, process monitoring, continued process verification, and lifecycle management. Ensure application of scientific and risk-based approaches to process design, qualification, and optimization.

• Lead complex product and process investigations, deviations, CAPAs, complaints, and troubleshooting activities. Apply strong scientific, engineering, and statistical expertise to analyze data, identify root causes, assess process capability, and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

• Serve as technical authority for manufacturing science and technology, providing expert support and coaching to scientific, technical, and production teams. Drive knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement to enhance process robustness, operational excellence, and product quality.

What we are looking for:

• Proven team leadership experience, including conducting performance discussions and managing performance effectively (experience from MSAT, QA, or Manufacturing environments)

• Strong resilience, with the ability to stay composed and lead under pressure in a demanding and evolving environment

• Demonstrated expertise in sterile fill & finish manufacturing (essential)

• Ability to lead with authenticity and positivity, providing clear direction, perspective, and fostering accountability within the team

• Solid background in MSAT operations, with experience in technology transfer and process implementation (highly preferred)

• Scientific degree (natural sciences) preferred; additional expertise in lyophilization and/or ADC (antibody-drug conjugates) is a strong advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Contribuisci attivamente alla leadership generale e alle prestazioni del sito.
• Collaborare tra funzioni e siti tra cui operazioni, qualità, ingegneria, convalida, sviluppo dei processi, sviluppo analitico, affari regolamentari e MSAT globale per garantire trasferimenti tecnologici senza soluzione di continuità, strategie di controllo di processo robuste e una commercializzazione di successo di nuovi prodotti. Agire come vice al capo delle operazioni del prodotto della droga Stein come richiesto.
• Stabilire e migliorare continuamente gli standard, i sistemi e i processi MSAT, comprese le strategie di qualificazione e validazione, le tecnologie a uso singolo, il monitoraggio dei processi, la verifica dei processi e la gestione del ciclo di vita. Assicurare l'applicazione di approcci scientifici e basati sui rischi per la progettazione, la qualificazione e l'ottimizzazione del processo.
• condurre indagini complesse sui prodotti e sui processi, deviazioni, CAPAs, reclami e attività di risoluzione dei problemi. Applicare forti competenze scientifiche, ingegneristiche e statistiche per analizzare i dati, identificare le cause principali, valutare le capacità di processo e implementare azioni correttive e preventive sostenibili.
• Servire come autorità tecnica per la produzione di scienza e tecnologia, fornendo supporto esperto e coaching ai team scientifici, tecnici e produttivi. Guida la condivisione della conoscenza, l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo per migliorare la robustezza del processo, l'eccellenza operativa e la qualità del prodotto. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Provata esperienza di leadership del team, tra cui condurre discussioni sulle prestazioni e gestire efficacemente le prestazioni (esperienza da ambienti MSAT, QA o Manufacturing)
• Forte resilienza, con la capacità di rimanere composta e portare sotto pressione in un ambiente esigente ed in evoluzione
• Competenza dimostrata nella produzione sterile di riempimento e finitura (essenziale)
• Capacità di condurre con autenticità e positività, fornendo una chiara direzione, una prospettiva e una maggiore responsabilità all'interno del team
• Sfondo solido nelle operazioni MSAT, con esperienza nel trasferimento tecnologico e nell'implementazione del processo (molto preferito)
• Grado scientifico (scienze naturali) preferito; esperienza aggiuntiva nella liofilizzazione e/o ADC (congiunti anticorpo-droga) è un forte vantaggio Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.title: Scientist QC (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Am Standort Visp wird ein Scientist QC gesucht. Werde Teil eines jungen und dynamischen Teams.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Implementierung, Optimierung, Transfer und Validierung analytischer Methoden, mit Schwerpunkt in HPLC Analytik

• Planung und Mitverantwortung bei der Durchführung der Freigabeanalytik

• Fachliche Expertise bei technischen und analytischen Fragestellungen

• Extraktion und Auswertung von analytischen Daten wie auch Verfassen von Berichten und Präsentationen

• Bearbeitung von Untersuchungen, Änderungsanträgen und Abweichungen unter cGMP

• Erstellung, Überprüfung und Freigabe von Dokumenten zur Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der behördlichen Richtlinien

• Leitung von Innovationsprojekten

• Repräsentant für projektspezifische Anfragen in Audits und Inspektionen

• Bereitschaftsdienst mit vorab vereinbarten Einsätzen im Rahmen des Pikettdiensts

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (FH/BSc/MSc/Diplom) im Bereich Biochemie, Biologie oder Chemie

• Sie haben idealerweise Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Qualitätskontrolle und sind vertraut mit den entsprechenden Prozessen unter GMP und/oder in der Analytik von grossen Bio-Molekülen

• Sie sind selbständig, verantwortungsbewusst und besitzen eine gute Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

• Sie haben Spass daran, sich in ein junges, dynamisches Team einzubringen, sind engagiert und besitzen Eigeninitiative.

• Sichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab

Lonza’s Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits finden Sie hier:

jobs.title: Senior QA Specialist - QA Projects 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The role:
The Senior QA Specialist (f/m/d) for QA Projects specifies quality requirements for manufacturing processes and cGMP standards over their entire life cycle. As a Quality and Compliance representative he/she will be a key member in cross-functional project teams ensuring measures for product safety, product quality & cGMP compliance are implemented.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Own all quality related responsibilities for the manufacturing processes of biopharmaceutical products for clinical and commercial supply. Represent QA in project/tech transfer organizations for new biotech manufacturing processes.

• Responsible for review and final release of records like Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Master Manufacturing Batch Records, Material Specifications, Deviations, Change Requests, Effectiveness Checks, Testing Protocols & Reports etc.

• Perform assessments for all product-related changes, assesses relevance to regulatory filings, decide to implement and provide change controls for approval to customers where required.

• Ensure all deviations are appropriately investigated and recorded, direct the investigations of customer product complaints and assure the completion of the appropriate documentation.

• Identifie emerging QA relevant topics, communicate to the IBEX QA organization and work actively on their development into new or already established Quality and Compliance strategies and/or standards.

• Train and mentor junior Lonza employees to better accomplish and perform in their duties as Quality professionals. Support cGMP training programs to ensure staff is being trained.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Life Science or any related field.

• Solid experience in the GMP regulated pharmaceutical industry is required; preferably in a QA role.

• General knowledge of biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes and analytical methods.

• Experienced in the interaction with health authorities (Swissmedic, FDA etc.).

• Ability to oversee project execution to identify non-compliance from quality standards. Ability to prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.

• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude; open-minded for new ideas and suggestions; agile, highly motivated and dynamic drive.

• Strong team orientation with excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.

• Business fluent English is required, good German skills - an advantage

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Rôle : Le spécialiste principal de l'AQ (f/m/d) pour les projets d'AQ précise les exigences de qualité pour les procédés de fabrication et les normes CGMP tout au long de leur cycle de vie. En tant que représentant de la qualité et de la conformité, il sera un membre clé des équipes de projet interfonctionnelles assurant la mise en oeuvre de mesures pour la sécurité des produits, la qualité des produits et la conformité aux BPFc. Ce que vous obtiendrez :
• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique
• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique
• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé
• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut également être consultée à l'adresse https://www.lonza.com/careers/ benefits. Ce que vous ferez :
• Assumer toutes les responsabilités liées à la qualité pour les procédés de fabrication de produits biopharmaceutiques destinés à l'approvisionnement clinique et commercial. Représenter l'AQ dans les organismes de transfert de projets/technologies pour les nouveaux procédés de fabrication de biotechnologie.
• Responsable de l'examen et de la publication finale des documents tels que les procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON), les dossiers principaux des lots de fabrication, les spécifications du matériel, les écarts, les demandes de changement, les vérifications de l'efficacité, les protocoles d'essai et les rapports, etc.
• Effectuer des évaluations de tous les changements liés au produit, évaluer la pertinence pour les dépôts réglementaires, décider de mettre en oeuvre et fournir des contrôles de changement pour l'approbation des clients au besoin.
• S'assurer que tous les écarts sont adéquatement étudiés et enregistrés, diriger les enquêtes sur les plaintes relatives aux produits de la clientèle et assurer l'achèvement de la documentation appropriée.
• Identifier les nouveaux sujets pertinents de l'AQ, communiquer à l'organisation de l'AQ de l'IBEX et travailler activement à l'élaboration de stratégies ou de normes de qualité ou de conformité nouvelles ou déjà établies.
• Former et mentorer les employés subalternes de Lonza pour qu'ils puissent mieux s'acquitter de leurs fonctions de professionnels de la qualité. Appuyer les programmes de formation sur les BPFC pour s'assurer que le personnel est formé. Ce que nous cherchons :
• Diplôme universitaire en chimie, biotechnologie, sciences de la vie ou tout autre domaine connexe.
• Une solide expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique réglementée par les BPF est requise; de préférence dans un rôle d'AQ.
• Connaissance générale des procédés de fabrication biopharmaceutiques et des méthodes d'analyse.
• Expérience de l'interaction avec les autorités sanitaires (Swissmedic, FDA, etc.).
• Capacité de superviser l'exécution des projets afin de déceler la non-conformité aux normes de qualité. Capacité de prioriser et de gérer le travail jusqu'aux échéances critiques du projet dans un environnement accéléré.
• Une attitude de travail structurée, ciblée et bien organisée; une ouverture d'esprit pour de nouvelles idées et suggestions; une dynamique agile, très motivée et dynamique.
• Une forte orientation de l'équipe avec d'excellentes compétences en communication verbale, écrite et interpersonnelle.
• L'anglais des affaires est nécessaire, de bonnes compétences en allemand - un avantage À propos de Lonza À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. titleByLocale.it: Supply Chain & Inventory Lead, Sintesi avanzata 80-100% (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp or Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As part of Advanced Synthesis (ADS), the Supply Chain & Inventory Lead plays a critical role in driving Supply Chain performance across all ADS sites. This position is accountable for inventory management strategy, KPI definition, performance reporting, and cross‑site process improvement. The role is essential for ensuring operational efficiency, optimized inventory levels, and continuous improvement within the ADS Supply Chain organization.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here:  https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Develop and implement inventory management strategies to optimize stock levels and minimize excess inventory

• Lead platform forums to address cross‑site inventory topics (e.g., excess inventory, customer liability)

• Build and maintain dashboards and reporting tools for inventory projections, write‑offs, and provisions

• Monitor and analyze Supply Chain KPIs to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities

• Collaborate with cross‑functional and cross‑site teams to design and streamline Supply Chain processes

• Conduct regular performance assessments and provide insights and recommendations to ADS senior management

• Define and implement ADS‑wide processes (e.g., inventory reporting for S&OP) and ensure adherence across sites

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or related fields; Master’s degree preferred

• Proven experience in material and inventory management with a strong track record in SC KPI performance improvement

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with complex data sets

• Demonstrated leadership capabilities and experience in matrix organizations

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and platforms

• Fluency in English; German and Chinese are an advantage

• Ability to adapt global standards to ADS‑specific needs with a strong process‑focused mindset

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali e cross-site per progettare e ottimizzare i processi Supply Chain
• Condurre valutazioni regolari delle prestazioni e fornire informazioni e raccomandazioni alla gestione senior ADS
• Definire e implementare i processi ADS-wide (ad esempio, la segnalazione di inventario per S&OP) e garantire l'adesione di siti Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Corso di laurea in Gestione della Supply Chain, Business Administration, Ingegneria, o campi correlati; Master’s laurea preferito
• Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione del materiale e dell'inventario con un forte record nel miglioramento delle prestazioni SC KPI

• Capacità di leadership dimostrate e l'esperienza nelle organizzazioni di matrice

• Fluency in inglese; tedesco e cinese sono un vantaggio
• Possibilità di adattare gli standard globali alle esigenze specifiche di ADS con una forte mentalità focalizzata sul processo Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza as an Associate Director, Technology Transfer (Global MSAT) and play a pivotal role in bringing complex drug products from development to commercial reality. You’ll lead end-to-end technology transfers—from process scale-up and PPQ to regulatory filings, inspection readiness, and successful launch with a focus on aseptic fill&finish processes.
Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza !

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Manage, drive and guide high‑complexity and high-impact drug product commercial transfers from New Product Introduction to PPQ, regulatory filing, pre-approval health authority inspections and first commercial launch.

• Act as global Subject Matter Expert for Process Technology Transfer, shaping technical strategy, ensuring global standard alignment, and driving customer‑centric excellence across sites and product lifecycles.

• Provide technical authority and act as senior escalation point for complex technical challenges, provide tech transfer leadership for late‑phase and commercial programs.

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for all technology‑transfer‑related manufacturing topic of assigned projects within internal and customer project teams. Define and monitor project scope, timing and progress of assigned stages.

• Lead process setup, scale‑up, and implementation activities at GMP drug product manufacturing sites, including on‑site technical support during batch execution.

• Responsible for new product introduction, process implementation, process control strategy and technical transfer and process validation documentation of assigned projects, including review of dossier modules for regulatory filing.

• Drive GMP change management strategy of assigned projects as well as initiate and manage GMP change control in system. Lead and support critical GMP product / process deviations and corresponding implementation of corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs).

• Ensure all activities are performed according to current standards (Good Manufacturing Practice, Health Safety Environment, Regulatory etc.).

What we are looking for:

• Industry-leading expertise in biotech/pharma/CDMO environments, with strong experience in drug product development, tech transfer especially within aseptic fill&finish processes (e.g. lyophilization, prefilled syringes). Proven ability to translate scientific depth into strategic decision‑making.

• Deep knowledge of GMP, regulatory, and CMC requirements, with the ability to translate strategy into robust manufacturing execution

• Proven ability to influence and lead complex manufacturing strategies and resolve high-impact technical challenges across global, cross-site operations

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, influencing senior leaders and navigating complex decision-making environments

• University degree in Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Science or similar field (PhD preferred)

• Excellent project, risk, and data management capabilities, paired with clear technical writing; fluent in English (German is a plus)

What you will do:

• Manage, drive and guide high‑complexity and high-impact drug product commercial transfers from New Product Introduction to PPQ, regulatory filing, pre-approval health authority inspections and first commercial launch.

• Act as global Subject Matter Expert for Process Technology Transfer, shaping technical strategy, ensuring global standard alignment, and driving customer‑centric excellence across sites and product lifecycles.

• Provide technical authority and act as senior escalation point for complex technical challenges, provide tech transfer leadership for late‑phase and commercial programs.

• Serve as the primary technical point of contact for all technology‑transfer‑related manufacturing topic of assigned projects within internal and customer project teams. Define and monitor project scope, timing and progress of assigned stages.

• Drive GMP change management strategy of assigned projects as well as initiate and manage GMP change control in system. Lead and support critical GMP product / process deviations and corresponding implementation of corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs).

• Ensure all activities are performed according to current standards (Good Manufacturing Practice, Health Safety Environment, Regulatory etc.).

What we are looking for:

• Industry-leading expertise in biotech/pharma/CDMO environments, with strong experience in drug product development, tech transfer especially within aseptic fill&finish processes (e.g. lyophilization, prefilled syringes). Proven ability to translate scientific depth into strategic decision‑making.

• Deep knowledge of GMP, regulatory, and CMC requirements, with the ability to translate strategy into robust manufacturing execution

• Proven ability to influence and lead complex manufacturing strategies and resolve high-impact technical challenges across global, cross-site operations

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, influencing senior leaders and navigating complex decision-making environments

You will be based at our Visp site, supporting global warehouse and supply chain operations through SAP EWM solutions in a regulated GMP/GxP environment. This role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact on critical systems that enable reliable and compliant manufacturing.

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Support testing, validation, and audit readiness in a GMP/GxP environment

• Drive continuous improvement by identifying optimization and innovation opportunities

• Proven experience with SAP EWM and solid knowledge of SAP WM and SAP MM

• Identify opportunities for optimization of operational procedures in order to improve quality and efficiency within area of responsibility

• Eligible to work as as deputy for Qualified Person/FvP in Switzerland or EU as well as extensive work experience in a senior QA role in the GMP controlled pharmaceutical manufacturing environment (e.g. QA Operations), preferably experience in aseptic fill&finish processes

• Excellent working knowledge of current ICH, PIC/S, EU and US regulatory requirements and their implementation

• Experience in managing customer audits and inspections such as Swissmedic, USFDA, EMA, MHRA Audits

jobs.description:
Der Standort dieser Position ist in Visp, Schweiz. Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lebensstil, Familie und Freizeit erwarten. Die vollständige Liste unserer lokal zugeschnittenen Benefits finden Sie unten.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Einhaltung der relevanten SOPs (Standardarbeitsanweisungen) und Vorschriften (z.B. Hygienekonzept, Sicherheitsvorschriften)

• Selbstständiges Bedienen von Produktionsanlagen und -geräten, einschliesslich Vorbereitung, Betrieb und Nachbereitung gemäss SOPs

• Durchführung von Herstellungsaktivitäten gemäss cGMP-Richtlinien in der BioAtrium AG im Bereich der Puffer- und Medienvorbereitung für die Herstellung mit Säugetierzellen, einschliesslich Bedienung von Kleinteilewaschanlage und Autoklav

• Überwachung der Produktionsprozesse, Erkennen und Melden potenzieller Probleme sowie aktive Mitwirkung an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen

• GMP-konformes Arbeiten und zeitgerechte Dokumentation der Tätigkeiten (z.B. in Computersystemen (MES) oder Logbüchern)

• Probenahmen, Durchführung von In-Prozess-Kontrollen (IPC) und Auswertung von Testergebnissen

• Verantwortung für die Schulung des Produktionspersonals zu spezifischen Geräten oder Standardprozessen (betrifft Senior Operatoren)

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:
Wir heissen KandidatInnen aus allen Erfahrungsstufen willkommen. Ob Sie bereits Expertise in der pharmazeutischen Produktion haben oder als QuereinsteigerIn mit relevanten Qualifikationen starten möchten - wenn Sie motiviert sind, an der Herstellung modernster Wirkstoffe mitzuwirken, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

• Berufseinsteiger: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Pharma-, Chemie- oder Biotechnologiebranche oder ein entsprechender Hochschulabschluss

• Erfahrene Fachkräfte: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion, idealerweise mit GMP- und Reinraumerfahrung

• Sicherheits- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Deutsch erforderlich, Englisch von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im Schichtbetrieb (4-Schicht-System)

• Teamfähigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Flexibilität

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. Mit über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Jede Idee, ob gross oder klein, hat das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern – und genau an dieser Arbeit möchten wir Sie beteiligen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in umsetzbare Therapien zu verwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord zu begrüssen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

English Version:

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

What you will do:

• Compliance with relevant SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and regulations (e.g., hygiene concept, safety regulations)

• Independent operation of production systems and equipment, including preparation, operation, and follow-up according to SOPs

• Execution of manufacturing activities according to cGMP guidelines at BioAtrium AG in the area of buffer and media preparation for mammalian cell production, including operation of the small‑parts washer and autoclave

• Monitoring of production processes, identifying and reporting potential issues, and actively contributing to continuous improvement initiatives

• Performing GMP-compliant work and timely documentation of activities (e.g., in computer systems such as MES or in logbooks)

• Sampling, performing in-process controls (IPC), and evaluating test results

• Responsibility for training production staff on specific equipment or standard processes (applies to Senior Operators)

What we are looking for:

We welcome candidates from all experience levels. Whether you already have expertise in pharmaceutical production or are entering from another field with relevant qualifications — if you are motivated to contribute to the manufacture of state‑of‑the‑art active ingredients, we look forward to your application.

• Entry-level candidates: Completed vocational training in the pharmaceutical, chemical, or biotechnology sector, or a relevant university degree

• Experienced professionals: Several years of experience in pharmaceutical production, ideally with GMP and cleanroom experience

• Strong safety awareness and sense of responsibility

• German required; English is an advantage

• Willingness to work in shift operations (4‑shift system)

• Team spirit, reliability, and flexibility

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
