jobs.description:
Director Operational Excellence & PMO – Microbial Operations

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This role is based at our Visp manufacturing site and plays a critical role in driving operational excellence and strategic project delivery across the Microbial Operations network, directly impacting performance, innovation, and scalability.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Define and execute the Operational Excellence strategy across Microbial Operations to drive performance and competitiveness

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Six Sigma, delivering measurable business impact across assets

• Establish and run a robust PMO framework, ensuring strong governance, prioritization, and execution of strategic initiatives

• Oversee the full project portfolio, ensuring clarity of scope, milestones, risks, resources, and benefits realization

• Partner with senior leadership to enable alignment, decision-making, and execution of cross-functional priorities

• Drive governance and planning processes including OE roadmaps, business reviews, and business continuity planning

• Build organizational capability by coaching leaders and embedding a culture of continuous improvement and accountability

What we are looking for

• Significant experience in manufacturing operations, operational excellence, or project/program management in a complex environment

• Strong expertise in Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Black Belt certification preferred)

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence without formal authority

• Excellent project portfolio management and governance capabilities

• Strong strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution mindset

• Advanced communication and stakeholder management skills across senior leadership levels

• Degree in a relevant field (e.g., engineering, life sciences); postgraduate qualification preferred

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Operations Support Manufacturing Specialist
jobs.description:
Operations Support: Manufacturing Specialist, Operations Support, Large Scale Mammalian

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula for how we do it. Our greatest scientific solutions are dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

Due to the growth at our site in Visp, we are currently looking for Operations Support and Manufacturing Specialists for our 6 x 20K Large Scale Mammalian Facility. In this role, you will be responsible for performing operational support activities within the Operations Support Team in partnership with Buffer Media Supply, USP, and DSP.

What you’ll do:

• Assignments within the Operations Support team focused on receipt and management of raw materials, single use materials, dispensing of small volume and large-scale medias and buffers to meet production demands and adherence to schedule.

• Processing of parts in washers and autoclaves

• Transport and storage of materials within temperature-controlled requirements

• Execution of tasks in compliance with safety regulations and cGMP quality requirements.

• Execution of production steps including interaction with HMIs and automated systems

Key responsibilities:

• Complete manufacturing activities in Operations Support area according to cGMP guidelines, ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, resolving issues, troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and make recommendations for resolution

• Assist document preparation (e.g. electronic batch records, SOPs) specific to the assigned production area

• Recognition, interpretation, and elimination of deviations

• Review production documentation and work on deviations, change requests and implementation of CAPAs to ensure high-quality GMP standards

• Responsible for the training of the manufacturing staff on specific equipment or standard operations

• Serve as deputy for Team Lead when needed

Key requirements:

• Fluent English with German language skills advantageous

• GMP operations experience a must

• Completed chemical / biopharmaceutical education or vocational training preferred

• Professional experience in pharmaceutical production as an operator/production technician in a GMP environment is a plus

• Must be open to work in shift (2 or 3 shift system)

What we’re looking for:

• Motivated, self-starter with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset, ability to work independently, oversee the daily coordination of operational activities, and execute operations as part of team deliverables.

• Ideally, you have trained as an EFZ logistician / EFZ chemical and pharmaceutical technologist / EFZ laboratory technician specializing in chemistry or biology.

• Safety mindset; forklift and/or electric pallet truck training will be required

• Continuous improvement mindset with attention to detail and support of 6S standards

• Day shift schedule to start during training period and establishment of the Operations Support Department.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

• Deve essere aperto al lavoro a turno (2 o 3 turni) Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Idealmente, si è formato come un EFZ logistico / EFZ chimico e farmaceutico technologist / EFZ laboratorio tecnico specializzato in chimica o biologia.
• Attenzione di sicurezza; carrello elevatore e/o addestramento del carrello elettrico
• Mindset di miglioramento continuo con attenzione ai dettagli e supporto agli standard 6S
• Programma di turni di giorno per iniziare durante il periodo di formazione e l'istituzione del Dipartimento di Supporto Operazioni. Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente. La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa. Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, status veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Compléter les activités de fabrication dans la zone de soutien des opérations conformément aux lignes directrices du GMPc, assurer l'exécution des lots, évaluer les résultats des essais, résoudre les problèmes, dépanner l'équipement de fabrication et faire des recommandations pour la résolution
• Aider à la préparation des documents (p. ex. registres électroniques des lots, PON) propres à la zone de production attribuée
• Reconnaissance, interprétation et élimination des écarts
• Examiner la documentation de production et les travaux sur les écarts, les demandes de changement et la mise en oeuvre des APC afin d'assurer des normes BPF de haute qualité
• Responsable de la formation du personnel de fabrication sur des équipements spécifiques ou des opérations standard
• Servir comme adjoint au chef d'équipe au besoin Principales exigences:
• Anglais fluide avec des compétences en langue allemande avantageux
• L'expérience des BPF
• Achevé l'enseignement chimique / biopharmaceutique ou la formation professionnelle préféré
• Expérience professionnelle dans la production pharmaceutique en tant qu'opérateur/technicien de production dans un environnement BPF est un plus
• Doit être ouvert au travail posté (2 ou 3 postes) Ce que nous recherchons:
• Motivé, auto-démarrant avec une mentalité collaborative et axée sur l'équipe, la capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, superviser la coordination quotidienne des activités opérationnelles et exécuter les opérations dans le cadre des produits livrables de l'équipe.
• Idéalement, vous avez été formé comme logisticien EFZ / technologue chimique et pharmaceutique EFZ / technicien de laboratoire EFZ spécialisé en chimie ou en biologie.
• L'état d'esprit de sécurité; une formation sur le chariot élévateur et/ou sur les palettes électriques sera nécessaire
• Amélioration continue de l'état d'esprit avec une attention au détail et le soutien des normes 6S
• L'horaire des quarts de jour doit commencer pendant la période de formation et la création du Département de l'appui aux opérations. Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique. Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons une satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence importante. Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront considérés pour un emploi sans égard à la race, à la religion, à la couleur, à l'origine nationale, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité de genre, à l'âge, au statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, au statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou à toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Bioprocess Engineer (DSP)

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our manufacturing team where you will lead and optimize GMP production processes while contributing to impactful projects from tech transfer through clinical production. This role offers the opportunity to drive operational excellence and work at the forefront of biopharmaceutical manufacturing.

Site-based
This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location

• Learn more: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Schedule, supervise, and document manufacturing activities in compliance with cGMP guidelines

• Act as a manufacturing expert within a multidisciplinary project team, supporting projects from tech transfer through clinical production

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality, cost, efficiency, and safety using operational excellence methodologies

• Represent the Lonza manufacturing unit during customer audits and site visits

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including QA, MSAT, and Engineering

• Support knowledge transfer, mentoring, and leadership within the production environment

• Ensure adherence to regulatory and quality standards in all production activities

What we are looking for

• Bachelor or Master’s or PhD degree in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Chemical Engineering, or a related field

• Strong leadership skills with the ability to guide teams in a GMP-regulated environment

• Experience in GMP manufacturing (preferred but not mandatory)

• Fluency in German and English

• Strong communication and collaboration skills across functions and stakeholders

• Continuous improvement mindset with focus on operational excellence

• Ability to work in complex, fast-paced project environments

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our site in Visp we are currently looking for a Senior Quality Excellence Manager (m/f/d), who will become part of our Quality Excellence team. In this role, you will drive operational excellence at its best and contribute as a strong influential LEAN specialist within a matrix organization to support our Quality organization on its way to best in class performance.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Drive process standardization and efficiency in line with Lonza’s LBMS standards

• Support the implementation of a Lean Batch Release program on site

• Establish Quality Excellence CoE and PMO structures, supporting the standardization, simplification and digitalization of our key quality processes

• Facilitate to embed a LEAN culture of continuous improvement and ideation within Quality

• Monitor and enable reporting of Quality performance KPIs for our site in Visp and initiate necessary activities to enable target achievement by the departments in scope

• Support multi-disciplinary project teams and hold team members accountable to achieve the project goals within given timelines

• Share best practice within the Visp Site as well as with the wider Lonza Pharma network

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in a scientific area OR an absolved apprenticeship in a pharmaceutical environment (e.g. Lab Technician, CPT, etc)

• Profound experience in a GMP regulated environment; preferably within QA/QC

• Experience with Lean / Six Sigma, within a Quality related environment

• Certified Green Belt or higher is required

• PowerBI and/or Minitab knowledge would be an advantage

• Fluent German (written and verbal) and good English language skills are required

• Strong ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different functions

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. • Guidare e sostenere iniziative di sourcing, di gestione, di negoziazione e di contrazione, mentre guida l'adozione di strumenti innovativi come le e-auzioni e i cataloghi online.

• Gestisci le relazioni dei fornitori end-to-end, promuovendo partnership forti, monitorando le prestazioni e guidando l'innovazione garantendo al contempo la conformità e la mitigazione dei rischi di approvvigionamento.
• Ottimizzare l'efficienza degli appalti standardizzando le specifiche, la condivisione delle migliori pratiche tra i siti, l'individuazione delle opportunità di risparmio, dei rischi e delle sinergie all'interno di un portafoglio di spesa di CHF 35–60M. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Esperienza comprovata nell'approvvigionamento con una forte attenzione al sourcing strategico, alla negoziazione e alla creazione di valore oltre i compiti transazionali
• Dimostrata capacità di pensare strategicamente, influenzando e collaborando con le parti interessate attraverso le funzioni per guidare risultati di approvvigionamento
• Esperienza nel settore farmaceutico preferita con la conoscenza GMP considerato un forte vantaggio
• Forte capacità di comunicazione con fluenza in inglese; il tedesco è un plus
• La familiarità con gli strumenti di approvvigionamento e l'analisi (ad esempio, SAP Ariba, Power BI) e l'esperienza che implementa le strategie di categoria è altamente auspicabile Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Bioprocess Engineer (m/w/d) 80%-100%

Der tatsächliche Ort dieser Stelle befindet sich in Visp, Schweiz. Berechtigten Bewerbern und ihren Familien steht bei Bedarf Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Als Bioprocess Engineer übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Planung, Durchführung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer GMP-Bioprozesse. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, MSAT, Quality und Engineering stellen Sie eine zuverlässige, effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Produktion sicher und tragen damit direkt zur Herstellung lebensverändernder Therapien für Patienten weltweit bei.

Diese Position ist eine vollständig standortgebundene Rolle. Die enge persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort ermöglicht eine direkte Abstimmung in Echtzeit und unterstützt die technische Präzision, die für die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards erforderlich ist.

Was auf Sie wartet

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

• Die Möglichkeit, komplexe GMP-Bioprozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und zu optimieren.

• Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams in einem internationalen Umfeld.

• Vielfältige Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

• Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Vorteile finden Sie hier: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Ihre Aufgaben

• Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von GMP-Produktionskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Operations.

• Betriebstechnische und organisatorische Betreuung der GMP-Produktion sowie Schulung und Unterstützung des Produktionspersonals.

• Erstellung, Optimierung und Kontrolle von GMP-relevanten Produktionsdokumenten (z. B. EBRs, SOPs und Arbeitsanweisungen).

• Sicherstellung einer qualitativ hochwertigen und termingerechten Bearbeitung von Deviations (DRs), Change Requests (CRs) und CAPAs nach dem First-Time-Right-Prinzip.

• Überwachung, Trending und Reporting operativer Prozesskennzahlen sowie Identifikation und Implementierung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen mittels Lean, Six Sigma, 6S und Kaizen.

• Sicherstellung eines technisch einwandfreien, sauberen und qualifizierten Zustands der Produktionsanlagen und -bereiche sowie Durchführung von Troubleshooting und Pikettdienst.

jobs.title: (Senior) Scientist QC 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Be part of an exciting growth project where you’ll contribute to set up a new QC lab! Routine analysis of a large variety of release and stability tests will be the majority of the work. However, besides the routine analysis you will also execute method validation and transfer activities of various physico-chemical methods in order to facilitate implementation. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Ensuring the release of life saving medicines by executing, coordinating and reviewing  physico-chemical and biochemical Drug Product release and stability testing under cGMP according to existing method SOPs (e.g. compendial testing/content/identity/purity for biologics/large molecules) – methods used: ELISA, HPLC, iCIEF, UV-VIS, CE-SDS and many others.

• Responsible  to  document  assay  execution  under  cGMP  following  Good  Documentation Practices (GDP) and flag relevant observations to the supervisor for further assessment

• Accountable  for  execution  of  operational  tasks  in  the  lab,  e.g.  mobile  phase  preparations, calibration of equipment, adherence to and maintenance of 6S, consumable management and support of equipment maintenance.

• Support of validation and transfer activities in frame of new project introductions.

• Contribution to investigation/troubleshooting for assigned tasks

• Support in authoring of cGMP documents e.g. procedures (SOPs) or quality records (e.g. OOE/OOS records, CAPA`s)

What we are looking for:

• Solid work experience in Quality Control in the GMP controlled environment

• Solid hands-on experience with either ELISA or HPLC or iCIEF is a must (experience with multiple methods is preferred)

• Experience in analytical method validation and method transfer is a plus

• Apprenticeship as Lab technician, Bachelor, Master or equivalent in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field

• Knowledge of lab quality systems like LIMS, Tiamo or CDS like Empower/Chromeleon

• Fluency in written and spoken English is a must, German is an asset

• Ability to work independently and in a dynamic & fast-pacing project environment. Proactive attitude

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Check out Your Career in Drug Product Services at Lonza!

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

What you will do:

• Solid work experience in Quality Control in the GMP controlled environment

• Solid hands-on experience with either ELISA or HPLC or iCIEF is a must (experience with multiple methods is preferred)

• Apprenticeship as Lab technician, Bachelor, Master or equivalent in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences or related field

• Knowledge of lab quality systems like LIMS, Tiamo or CDS like Empower/Chromeleon

Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

We are currently looking for a Senior QA Specialist (f/m/d) Process Validation for the expansion of our team here at our site in Visp. In this role, you will be QA responsible for the compliance of process validation with main focus on Small Molecules including validation activities at scale, continued process verification and Product Quality Reviews (PQRs).

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Ensure the manufacturing processes: APIs and Intermediates are in a validated state during their whole lifetime according to Lonza procedures, and in compliance with regulatory guidance

• Preparation of comprehensive process specific Validation Master Plans, describing the individual studies required for process validation

• Leading the process validation teams including communication with customers

• Preparation of the validation protocols and reports for the studies performed at manufacturing scale

• Assessment of changes and deviations during manufacturing for their impact on validation

• Preparation and maintenance of a documented continued process verification plan

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Chemistry or any related field

• Significant experience in the area of small molecules manufacturing, preferably in a validation function as well as strong background in cGMP

• Broad knowledge of manufacturing processes in GMP environment

• Experience in interacting with all kind of interfaces within the organization as well as with regulatory agencies (Swissmedic, FDA etc.)

• Fluency in English language is required; good German language skills are preferred

• Managing internal and external customer relations professionally and effectively

The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

You will lead the development, qualification, validation, and implementation of automated and semi-automated inspection and container closure integrity testing processes, ensuring robust defect detection and product quality from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity for someone who thrives in a pioneering environment, enjoys building processes from scratch with limited guidance, and wants to help shape the future of a growing Drug Product manufacturing site. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Support the production staff on the shopfloor by providing scientific expertise

• Support the GMP compliant qualification and validation activities of automated visual inspection system from an Operations perspective

• Prepare readiness for operative takeover of the automated, semi-automated, manual visual inspection and container closure integrity testing

• Accountable for safety, compliance and regulatory aspects. Preparation of risk analysis and all relevant procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and achieve business goals.

• Technical improvement execution: Execute improvements, Drive process related trouble shooting

• Leading/participate in change controls and deviations: using scientific and statistical knowledge to analyze data to provide process understanding, and to identify root causes of product and process failures.

• Represent the VI and CCIT during regulatory inspections and audits.

What we are looking for:

• Proven hands-on experience in pharmaceutical visual inspection for drug product in vials or syringes, in EITHER manual visual inspection, semi-automated, and/or fully automated visual inspection machines (AVI); experience across multiple inspection technologies is highly preferred.

• Knowledge of qualification of visual inspection machines, product validation and ideally with Container Closure Integrity Testing (CCIT) is preferred.

• Ability to work independently in a dynamic environment, building processes, standards, and solutions from the ground up with limited guidance and a strong continuous improvement mindset.

• Fluent in EITHER English OR German is required (fluency in both languages is an advantage)

• A relevant scientific or engineering degree is preferred, although equivalent technical training combined with substantial industry experience will also be considered.

Relocation support: Available for eligible candidates and their families.

For Drug Product Services (DPS), our successful branch within an international Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), we offer you an exciting and responsible position at the Stein location.
Become part of a dedicated automation team and actively contribute to supporting our customers in tackling key challenges in modern patient care.

As an automation technician, you are the central interface between production and engineering. You are responsible for all automation tasks in the context of reactive, proactive and preventive maintenance and thus make a decisive contribution to plant availability, quality and compliance at the Stein site.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Find our full list of local benefits You below:

• You take over the first level support as well as the troubleshooting at production and infrastructure facilities

• You monitor and control automated production processes and ensure their stable operation

• You support production quickly and solution-oriented for disruptions and GxP-relevant issues

• You work closely with the mechanics and support them in troubleshooting and troubleshooting

• You manage spare parts in the area MSR/E and coordinate their procurement

• You are involved in reactive, proactive and preventive maintenance in the automation environment

• You implement the existing maintenance strategy and develop it further, taking into account availability and efficiency

• You have completed technical vocational training (e.g. automatic, mechatronics or similar)

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a Laboratory Technician (all genders) to join our Biochemistry team in Quality Control. As a member of our team, you will be responsible for carrying out analytical protein analysis, with a focus on biochemical analysis, in compliance with GMP and safety guidelines (mainly Elisa and qPCR).

Key responsibilities:

• Carrying out routine analysis with a focus on ELISA and qPCR (sometimes also gel electrophoresis), in compliance with GMP and safety guidelines

• Method implementation, validation and method transfer

• Administrative activities, such as documenting the results and creating work instructions

• Support laboratory maintenance (responsibility for equipment) and ensure that the laboratory is clean and tidy

• Close cooperation with shift workers and apprentices as well as on-call duty

Key requirements

• Apprenticeship as a Laboratory Technician, BTA or BSc in Biology

• First experience with ELISA is a must (experience with qPCR is a plus)

• Experience in the field of Quality Control and GMP is a plus

• You are independent, responsible and have a very precise way of working. You have good communication and teamwork skills and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration

• You enjoy being part of a young, dynamic team, are committed and have initiative

• Fluent in either German or English (language skills in the respective other language is a plus)

At the Visp site, an apprentice production mechanic is sought. As a production mechanic at Lonza, you work in workshops and production facilities. You work metal components and assemble them into devices, apparatuses and machines. The production mechanics perform maintenance work on the chemical and biological production plants. You complete the orders and projects exactly and independently, partly in a team and together with other specialists. You mainly do planned maintenance work.

Your education
The teaching lasts three years. Production mechanics* are trained in the teaching company and attend the vocational school for a maximum of one day per week. In the second half of the apprenticeship, the focus training for the operational maintenance works follows. In this training phase, the trainees deepen their knowledge and skills through exemplary learning on production contracts and projects.

• Good practical and technical understanding

• Strong craftsmanship

• Accurate and careful work

• Good spatial imagination

• Joy at work by hand and with machines

Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a student polymechanic is sought. As a polymechanic at Lonza, you produce workpieces as well as devices and tools for production. From different materials, but mainly from metals, you produce individual components or entire production plants. When manufacturing individual parts or building prototypes, you work on lathes, milling, drilling and grinding machines. With high-precision measuring and testing instruments, you finally check the quality of the workpieces. Polymechanics are responsible for the assembly, maintenance and commissioning of devices, apparatuses, machines and plants. New orders are discussed in the team and new ideas are developed together.

Your education
The teaching lasts four years. Polymechanics are trained in the teaching establishment and attend vocational school for a maximum of two days per week. During the first half of teaching, a broad foundation of knowledge and skills is laid in basic training. The focus is on working techniques such as manual and mechanical production technology, assembly technology, joining technology,
Commissioning, maintenance and technical safety at work. In the second half of the apprenticeship, the focus training follows in operational areas of activity. In this training phase, the trainees deepen their knowledge and skills through exemplary learning on production contracts and projects.

Your profile

• Interest in technical relationships and mechanics

• Precise and careful working methods

• Good spatial imagination

• Concentration, patience and endurance

• Teamwork

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, we are looking for an apprentice logistician EFZ. As a logistics specialist, you coordinate the transport, storage and distribution of goods. In the warehouse you take goods, check and book them computer-aided. You manage delivery documents and storage data, ensure proper storage, check stocks, count and carry out relocations. You pick goods according to customer orders, transport them through the warehouse and prepare them for delivery. You pack, load and secure the goods according to the regulations in trucks or train cars.

Your education
The three-year training combines practical experience in operation with theoretical knowledge in vocational schools and courses. for activities in this area, from order processing to warehouse management.

• Self-employment

• Endurance and concentration

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, we are looking for an apprentice laboratory technician in EFZ Chemie. As a laboratory technician EFZ Chemie, you work in laboratories in various fields such as research and development, analytics, synthesis and partly also in biology. Your job as a laboratory technician in EFZ Chemie is to carry out laboratory tests. In these trials, you make new products and analyze them. Your tasks also include quality control / analysis of products from the companies. You create a work plan, get the materials and chemicals you need, and decide which appliances are best for work.

Your education
The teaching lasts three years. At the beginning of the apprenticeship, you will complete an introductory course in the modern Lonza training laboratory for 5 months. Then you go on rotation in the various laboratories of Lonza. In four internships, each lasting five to seven months, you will work in the various departments such as Research & Development, Synthesis, Analytics and Biology. Vocational education is attended for one and a half days per week.

Your profile

• Enthusiasm for chemistry, physics and mathematics

• Initiative and creativity

• Structured thinking

• Precise work

• Good technical understanding

• High reliability and persistence

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

We offer
At Lonza, we firmly believe that in addition to learning a profession, personal development from day one is important. We therefore train our learners not only as qualified professionals, but also as independent personalities. This enables you to make a promising start to your career.

Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés dirigent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Sur le site de Visp, un constructeur d'apprenants est recherché. En tant que concepteur, vous développez, modélisez et concevez des pièces et des assemblages individuels pour appareils, machines ou installations ainsi que des outils et des dispositifs de production en collaboration avec d'autres experts. Pour le fonctionnement et la maintenance des produits, vous créez des instructions et de la documentation. En tant que constructeur, vous créez des modèles et des assemblages 3D sur l'ordinateur avec des programmes CAO ainsi que leurs dessins de conception 2D. Vous faites les calculs nécessaires et gardez sur les plans des formes géométriques, des masses et des tolérances ainsi que des informations sur la composition de surface et les matériaux. Sur la base de ces documents, la pièce ou l'assemblage est ensuite produit dans l'atelier.

Votre éducation
L'enseignement dure quatre ans. La formation pratique est complétée par des concepteurs de l'entreprise enseignante. Il est complété par des cours interentreprises. Les stages dans d'autres domaines professionnels sont courants. L'école professionnelle est créée en première et deuxième année d'apprentissage pour deux jours et en troisième et quatrième années. Année d'étude pendant un jour par semaine.

Votre profil

• Intérêt pour les relations techniques et la mécanique

• Bonne imagination spatiale

• Méthodes de travail précises et prudentes

• Patience, endurance et concentration

• Joy du travail informatique

• Bonnes compétences en équipe et en communication

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau minimum B2)

Nous offrons
Chez Lonza, nous croyons fermement qu'en plus d'apprendre une profession, le développement personnel dès le premier jour est important. Nous formons donc nos apprenants non seulement en tant que professionnels qualifiés, mais aussi en tant que personnalités indépendantes. Cela vous permet de faire un début prometteur à votre carrière.

À Lonza, le respect est une priorité et nous protégeons nos employés et notre environnement. Le succès pour nous signifie des progrès moralement acceptables.

Life Science développe de nouvelles idées pour des problèmes complexes. Ensemble, nous apportons une contribution qui peut améliorer la vie de nombreuses personnes dans le monde. Cela leur offre la certitude et la satisfaction de faire vraiment une différence avec leur propre travail.

Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, a learner electrical installer EFZ is sought As an electrical installer at Lonza, you wire residential, work and industrial plants and lay electrical lines in pipes and cable channels. You mount switch cabinets and connect them. But also works such as programming of small controls and building automation systems are included. During your training, you will learn how to control electrical installations and put them into operation. In maintenance, you use your troubleshooting skills and repair faulty equipment.

Your education
The training lasts four years in the teaching company. Vocational school on average takes about one day a week. During the first half of teaching, a broad foundation of knowledge and skills is laid in basic training. The focus is on manufacturing technology, circuitry and measurement technology and microcomputer technology. In the second half of the apprenticeship, the focus training follows in operational areas of activity. In this training phase, the trainees deepen their knowledge and skills through exemplary learning on production contracts and projects.

Your profile

• Fine motor skills and craft skills

• Careful and accurate working methods

• Strong technical understanding

• Self-employment

• Normal colour vision

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

Daneben bearbeitest du Kunststoff- und Metallgehäuse, lötest Bauteile auf Platinen und erstellst Kabel zur Verbindung von Laborgeräten und Steuerungen. Im Zentrum stehen die mechanische und elektrische Fertigungstechnik, Module der Automatisierung mit Themen wie Messtechnik, Schaltungstechnik, elektrische Maschinen, Mess- und Steuerungstechnik sowie die fachspezifische Arbeitssicherheit.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Lonza est aujourd'hui un leader mondial des sciences de la vie, opérant sur trois continents. Nous travaillons dans la science, mais il n'y a pas de formule magique pour notre approche du travail. Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés dirigent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

À l'emplacement de Viège, on recherche un apprenant*r technicien automatique*. En tant qu'ingénieur automatique, vous développez des commandes électriques et pneumatiques. Vous assemblez et filez des armoires de commutation, effectuez des travaux de mise en service et de maintenance des commandes et des systèmes. En outre, vous traitez les boîtiers en plastique et en métal, les composants de soudure sur les planches et créez des câbles pour connecter les équipements de laboratoire et les systèmes de contrôle. La réparation d'appareils défectueux fait également partie de votre travail. Vous travaillez sur des missions et des projets avec d'autres experts.

Votre éducation
L'enseignement dure quatre ans. La formation pratique est complétée par des automatistes de l'entreprise enseignante. Il est complété par des cours interentreprises. Vous fréquentez l'école professionnelle pour un maximum de deux jours par semaine. Au cours de la première moitié de l'enseignement, un large socle de connaissances et de compétences est posé dans la formation de base. L'accent est mis sur la technologie de production mécanique et électrique, les modules d'automatisation avec des sujets tels que la technologie de mesure, la technologie de circuit, les machines électriques, la technologie de mesure et de contrôle ainsi que la sécurité professionnelle spécifique.

Votre profil

• Enthousiasme pour l'expérimentation et le bricolage

• Compréhension technique

• Pensée analytique et imagination spatiale

• Intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et le génie électrique

• Aptitudes motrices pour un travail précis

• Patience, persévérance et concentration

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau minimum B2)

Nous offrons
Chez Lonza, nous croyons fermement qu'en plus d'apprendre une profession, le développement personnel dès le premier jour est important. Nous formons donc nos apprenants non seulement en tant que professionnels qualifiés, mais aussi en tant que personnalités indépendantes. Cela vous permet de faire un début prometteur à votre carrière.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Lonza is today a world leader in life sciences, operating on three continents. We work in science, but there is no magic formula for how we approach work. Our most important scientific solution is talented employees who collaborate and develop ideas that help other companies help people. In return, our employees steer their career independently. Because their ideas, big and small, improve the world. And that's the kind of work we want to be part of.

At the Visp site, an apprentice plant and apparatus manufacturer is sought. As a plant and apparatus manufacturer at Lonza, you produce different products based on technical drawings. You mainly process various sheets, profiles and pipes. You combine them into components, containers, pipe systems or apparatus, which are then integrated into systems and plants. In addition, you take over the associated assembly, repair and repair work.
In the training workshop, the different techniques can be practiced on the different materials in order to later prepare the product correctly for the respective customer from production.

Your education
Plant and apparatus manufacturers* are trained for 4 years in teaching and specialist workshops with up to two days of vocational school visit per week.
During the basic training in the first half, knowledge and skills with a focus on sheet metal, metal profile and pipe processing will be applied through traditional tools as well as training on computer-controlled bending machines, welding robots and laser cutting equipment.
In the second half, there will be a focus training in operational areas of activity and specialist workshops, with deepening of expertise through practical learning projects for Lonza.

From the third year of apprenticeship, you will specialize in one of the different disciplines:

• Design technology

• Tube construction technology

• Welding technique

Your profile

• Interest in technical contexts and craftsmanship

• Good spatial imagination

• Good technical understanding

• Reliable, independent work

• No allergies to metals, fats and oils

• Teamwork

• Very good knowledge of German (minimum B2 level)

Notre solution scientifique la plus importante est les employés talentueux qui collaborent et développent des idées qui aident d'autres entreprises à aider les gens. En retour, nos employés dirigent leur carrière de façon indépendante. Parce que leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Sur le site de Visp, un apprenti fabricant d'usines et d'appareils est recherché. En tant que fabricant d'installations et d'appareils chez Lonza, vous produisez différents produits à partir de dessins techniques. Vous traitez principalement différentes feuilles, profils et tuyaux. Vous les combinez en composants, conteneurs, systèmes de tuyauterie ou appareils, qui sont ensuite intégrés dans les systèmes et les installations. De plus, vous prenez en charge les travaux d'assemblage, de réparation et de réparation associés.
Dans l'atelier de formation, les différentes techniques peuvent être pratiquées sur les différents matériaux afin de préparer plus tard le produit correctement pour le client respectif de la production.

Votre éducation
Les fabricants d'installations et d'appareils* sont formés pendant 4 ans à des ateliers d'enseignement et de spécialisation avec jusqu'à deux jours de visites d'écoles professionnelles par semaine.
Au cours de la formation de base de la première moitié, les connaissances et les compétences axées sur la tôle, le profil métallique et le traitement des tuyaux seront appliquées par des outils traditionnels ainsi que la formation sur les machines à cintrer contrôlées par ordinateur, les robots de soudage et les équipements de découpe laser.
Au cours de la seconde moitié, il y aura une formation ciblée dans les domaines opérationnels d'activités et des ateliers spécialisés, avec l'approfondissement de l'expertise par des projets d'apprentissage pratique pour Lonza.

Dès la troisième année d'apprentissage, vous vous spécialiserez dans l'une des disciplines suivantes :

• Technologie de conception

• Technologie de construction de tubes

• Technique de soudage

Votre profil

• Intérêt pour les contextes techniques et l'artisanat

• Bonne imagination spatiale

• Bonne compréhension technique

• Travail fiable et indépendant

• Pas d'allergie aux métaux, aux graisses et aux huiles

• Travail d'équipe

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand (niveau minimum B2)

Nous offrons
Chez Lonza, nous croyons fermement qu'en plus d'apprendre une profession, le développement personnel dès le premier jour est important. Nous formons donc nos apprenants non seulement en tant que professionnels qualifiés, mais aussi en tant que personnalités indépendantes. Cela vous permet de faire un début prometteur à votre carrière.

• La formation moderne dans nos propres entreprises d'enseignement

• Formateurs professionnels*

• GA pour CHF 1.- par jour

• Enseignement plus 1

• AFS – Année à l'étranger

• Groupe de travail sur l ' apprentissage

• Enseignement adapté aux sports de performance

• 6 semaines de vacances par an

• Matériel informatique personnel

Veuillez nous envoyer les documents suivants avec votre demande :

• Lettre de motivation

• CVC

• Copies des certificats scolaires des deux dernières années

• Vérification multiple (si disponible)

• Procès-verbal d ' essai (le cas échéant)

Les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes chaque jour. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand honneur, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante pour nous que nos succès eux-mêmes. À Lonza, le respect est une priorité et nous protégeons nos employés et notre environnement. Le succès pour nous signifie des progrès moralement acceptables.

Lonza est rejoint par des gens qui acceptent les défis et avec leur créativité dans le domaine
Life Science développe de nouvelles idées pour des problèmes complexes. Ensemble, nous apportons une contribution qui peut améliorer la vie de nombreuses personnes dans le monde. Cela leur offre la certitude et la satisfaction de faire vraiment une différence avec leur propre travail.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Location: Stein (Switzerland)
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our antibody drug conjugate (ADC) manufacturing team as a Process Expert, where you will lead technical troubleshooting on an aseptic filling and lyophilization line, drive process improvements, train Operators on the line, manage deviations and technical changes, and help shape the future of a state-of-the-art production environment. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in ramping up a brand-new line—from PQ and qualification through to Swissmedic approval—with significant autonomy, decision-making responsibility, and the chance to define the processes that will set the standard for years to come. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

​What you’ll do:

• Act as the technical expert to ensure that the production line runs efficiently and effectively

• Coordinate and support the qualification of the manufacturing line, ensuring they meet strict industry standards

• Identify weaknesses in the production line and determine solutions to fix or investigate issues

• Establish, drive and maintain good cleanroom management practices

• Collaborate with team members and various internal functions (e.g. MSAT, QA, Engineering) to successfully implement improvements and new processes

What we’re looking for:

• Degree or equivalent experience in Life Science or Engineering

• Proven experience in EITHER aseptic filling or aseptic manufacturing in the GMP controlled environment is a must, additional experience in the qualification of manufacturing equipment is highly preferred

• Experience with lyophilization processes is highly preferred

• Proficiency in English is a must; German is a plus

• Ability to agilely move between various tasks during this dynamic and exciting project phase. You demonstrates strong collaboration skills and actively support your team members

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Unisciti al nostro team di produzione di farmaci anticorpo congiunto (ADC) come esperto di processo, dove guiderai la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici su una linea di riempimento asettico e liyophilization, migliorie del processo di azionamento, allenatori sulla linea, gestisci deviazioni e cambiamenti tecnici, e aiuta a plasmare il futuro di un ambiente di produzione all'avanguardia. Si tratta di un'occasione unica per svolgere un ruolo chiave nell'arricchire una nuova linea – dal PQ e dalla qualificazione fino all'approvazione svizzeramedica – con una significativa autonomia, responsabilità decisionale e la possibilità di definire i processi che stabiliranno lo standard per gli anni a venire. Scopri il tuo Career in Drug Product Services a Lonza!

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero.
L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Cosa farai:

• Agire come esperto tecnico per garantire che la linea di produzione funzioni in modo efficiente ed efficace

• Coordinare e sostenere la qualificazione della linea di produzione, assicurando loro di soddisfare rigidi standard industriali

• Identificare le debolezze della linea di produzione e determinare le soluzioni per risolvere o indagare i problemi

• Stabilire, guidare e mantenere buone pratiche di gestione delle cleanroom

• Collabora con i membri del team e varie funzioni interne (ad esempio MSAT, QA, Engineering) per implementare con successo miglioramenti e nuovi processi

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea o equivalente esperienza in Scienze della Vita o Ingegneria

• Esperienza comprovata nel riempimento asettico EITHER o nella produzione asettica nell'ambiente controllato GMP è un must, l'esperienza aggiuntiva nella qualificazione delle attrezzature di produzione è altamente preferita

• L'esperienza con i processi di liofilizzazione è molto preferita

• La competenza in inglese è un must; il tedesco è un plus

• Capacità di muoversi agile tra i vari compiti durante questa fase dinamica ed emozionante del progetto. Lei dimostra forti capacità di collaborazione e sostiene attivamente i membri del suo team

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.
Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Rejoignez notre équipe de fabrication d'anticorps conjugués (ADC) en tant qu'expert en procédés, où vous dirigerez le dépannage technique sur une ligne de remplissage et de lyophilisation aseptique, les améliorations du processus d'entraînement, les opérateurs de train sur la ligne, gérerez les déviations et les changements techniques, et aider à façonner l'avenir d'un environnement de production de pointe. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de jouer un rôle clé dans la montée en puissance d'une toute nouvelle ligne, depuis le PQ et la qualification jusqu'à l'approbation médicale suisse, avec une autonomie significative, une responsabilité décisionnelle et la possibilité de définir les processus qui fixeront la norme pour les années à venir. Découvrez votre carrière dans les services de médicaments à Lonza!

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs.
La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices

Ce que vous allez faire:

• Agir en tant qu'expert technique pour s'assurer que la chaîne de production fonctionne efficacement

• Coordonner et soutenir la qualification de la chaîne de fabrication, en veillant à ce qu'elle réponde aux normes strictes de l'industrie

• Identifier les faiblesses de la chaîne de production et trouver des solutions pour résoudre ou étudier les problèmes

• Établir, diriger et maintenir de bonnes pratiques de gestion des salles propres

• Collaborer avec les membres de l'équipe et diverses fonctions internes (p. ex. MSAT, QA, génie) pour mettre en oeuvre avec succès les améliorations et les nouveaux processus

Ce que nous recherchons:

• Diplôme ou expérience équivalente en sciences de la vie ou en génie

• Expérience éprouvée dans le remplissage aseptique EITHER ou la fabrication aseptique dans l'environnement contrôlé par les BPF est un must, une expérience supplémentaire dans la qualification de l'équipement de fabrication est hautement préféré

• L'expérience des processus de lyophilisation est très privilégiée

• L'allemand est un plus

• Capacité de se déplacer agilement entre différentes tâches pendant cette phase dynamique et passionnante du projet. Vous démontrez de solides compétences en collaboration et soutenez activement les membres de votre équipe

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

We are hiring (Senior) Program Managers to join our Integrated Biologics organization. In this role, you’ll be the main link between Lonza and our customers, leading cross-functional teams through the full project lifecycle—from contract to GMP manufacturing and delivery.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Lead and deliver customer programs across their full lifecycle—from technology transfer to GMP manufacturing and project closure—ensuring quality, timelines, and cost-effectiveness.

• Act as a trusted partner and main point of contact for customers, fostering transparent communication and long-term collaboration.

• Inspire and coordinate diverse, cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, promoting shared ownership and high performance.

• Drive program success by managing scope, timelines, and financials, while aligning with strategic business goals.

• Collaborate across functions to manage scope changes, support commercial strategies, and contribute to future opportunities.

• Identify and address risks proactively, ensuring smooth issue resolution and continuous improvement.

• Mentor and support team members, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and professional development.

What we are looking for:

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, or a related field; PhD is a plus.

• Experience in project or program management, ideally in pharma or CDMO.

• Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and organizational factors.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and deliver complex programs.

• Knowledge of GMP manufacturing and drug substance development.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills.

• Fluent in English; German is a plus.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de:

Wir stellen (Senior) Program Manager ein, um unserer Integrated Biologics Organisation beizutreten. In dieser Rolle sind Sie das wichtigste Bindeglied zwischen Lonza und unseren Kunden und führen funktionsübergreifende Teams durch den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus – vom Vertrag bis zur GMP-Herstellung und -Lieferung.

Was Sie bekommen werden:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen

Was Sie tun werden:

• Führen und liefern Sie Kundenprogramme über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg - vom Technologietransfer bis zur GMP-Fertigung und zum Projektabschluss - und gewährleisten Sie Qualität, Zeitpläne und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Partner und Hauptansprechpartner für Kunden und fördern Sie eine transparente Kommunikation und langfristige Zusammenarbeit.

• Inspirieren und koordinieren Sie verschiedene, funktionsübergreifende Teams in einer Matrixumgebung und fördern Sie gemeinsames Eigentum und hohe Leistung.

• Fördern Sie den Programmerfolg, indem Sie Umfang, Zeitpläne und Finanzen verwalten und gleichzeitig strategische Geschäftsziele verfolgen.

• Arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend zusammen, um Umfangsänderungen zu verwalten, kommerzielle Strategien zu unterstützen und zu zukünftigen Chancen beizutragen.

• Identifizieren und adressieren Sie Risiken proaktiv, um eine reibungslose Problemlösung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zu gewährleisten.

• Mentor und Support-Teammitglieder, die eine Kultur des Lernens, der Inklusion und der beruflichen Entwicklung fördern.

Was wir suchen:

• Abschluss in Chemie, Biologie, Biotechnologie oder einem verwandten Bereich; PhD ist ein Plus.

• Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement, idealerweise in Pharma oder CDMO.

• Starkes Verständnis von technischen, kommerziellen und organisatorischen Faktoren.

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams zu führen und komplexe Programme zu liefern.

• Kenntnisse der GMP-Herstellung und Wirkstoffentwicklung.

• Hervorragende Kommunikation, Zusammenarbeit und Führungsqualitäten.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.
