jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.
While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

At Lonza, we are looking for an Executive Director, IT Business Partner – Advanced Synthesis to serve as the strategic interface between our business platform and IT, translating business priorities into technology-enabled solutions that accelerate growth, innovation, and operational excellence. This highly visible leadership role will shape the platform's digital strategy, technology roadmap, and investment priorities while ensuring IT capabilities deliver measurable business outcomes.

Working closely with business leaders, Digital & Data, Enterprise Solutions, Infrastructure, and Security teams, you will drive the end-to-end delivery of digital products, technology programmes, and platform transformation initiatives. Acting as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, you will ensure technology investments are aligned with business strategy, enabling scalable, compliant, and future-ready operations across Lonza's global manufacturing network.

Key Responsibilities

• Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to business platform leadership, aligning technology strategy with business priorities, operational objectives, and long-term growth plans

• Shape and execute the platform's multi-year technology roadmap, identifying digital transformation opportunities and enabling business value through data, automation, AI, and enterprise technologies

• Own the end-to-end demand management, prioritization, and delivery of platform-specific digital products and IT initiatives, ensuring alignment with business strategy and cross-platform standards

• Lead the platform IT portfolio, including business case development, investment prioritization, resource allocation, and execution governance

• Partner with Enterprise Solutions, Digital & Data, Infrastructure, Security, and Site IT teams to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant technology solutions across manufacturing, quality, ERP/MES, automation, and data platforms

• Support major platform expansion initiatives, capital projects, and M&A activities by ensuring technology readiness and successful IT integration

• Build trusted relationships across business leadership, manufacturing sites, quality, supply chain, and other key stakeholders, acting as the primary advisor on technology strategy and digital innovation

• Ensure compliance with IT governance, cybersecurity, GxP, regulatory, and data integrity requirements while supporting audits and platform governance activities

• Monitor portfolio performance through KPIs, value realization metrics, and operational performance reviews, driving continuous improvement across IT services and digital capabilities

• Lead and develop platform IT teams, including Site IT Leaders and Product Owners, fostering capability development, collaboration, and a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Required qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in IT leadership, IT Business Partnering, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications, or Technology Strategy within global organizations

• Proven experience partnering with senior business leaders to define technology strategy and deliver measurable business outcomes

• Strong understanding of manufacturing IT, enterprise platforms, digital products, automation, data, AI, ERP/MES environments, and technology-enabled business transformation

• Experience leading complex technology portfolios, digital product delivery, and cross-functional programmes within matrixed organizations

• Strong knowledge of regulated industries such as life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, or advanced manufacturing

• Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive strategic decisions without direct authority

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, consulting, and executive presentation skills with the ability to translate complex technology topics into business value

• Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities, with experience building business cases and driving value realization

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred

• Passion for innovation, digital transformation, and building high-performing teams in a fast-paced, global environment

Every day, Lonza's products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in cinque continenti.
Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda la propria carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

A Lonza, stiamo cercando un Direttore Esecutivo, IT Business Partner – Advanced Sintesi per servire come interfaccia strategica tra la nostra piattaforma aziendale e IT, traducendo le priorità aziendali in soluzioni tecnologicamente abilitate che accelerano la crescita, l'innovazione e l'eccellenza operativa. Questo ruolo di leadership altamente visibile sarà modellare la strategia digitale della piattaforma, la roadmap della tecnologia e le priorità di investimento, assicurando le capacità IT di fornire risultati aziendali misurabili.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con i leader aziendali, Digital & Data, Enterprise Solutions, Infrastructure e Security team, guiderete la consegna end-to-end di prodotti digitali, programmi tecnologici e iniziative di trasformazione delle piattaforme. Essendo un consulente di fiducia per le parti interessate esecutive, garantirai che gli investimenti tecnologici siano allineati alla strategia aziendale, consentendo operazioni scalabili, conformi e future in tutta la rete di produzione globale di Lonza.

Principali responsabilità

• Servire come principale partner strategico IT alla leadership della piattaforma aziendale, allineare la strategia tecnologica con priorità aziendali, obiettivi operativi e piani di crescita a lungo termine

• Formare ed eseguire la roadmap tecnologica pluriennale della piattaforma, identificare le opportunità di trasformazione digitale e consentire il valore aziendale attraverso dati, automazione, AI e tecnologie aziendali

• Possiede la gestione della domanda end-to-end, la priorità e la consegna di prodotti digitali specifici della piattaforma e iniziative IT, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia aziendale e gli standard cross-platform

• Guidare il portafoglio IT della piattaforma, tra cui lo sviluppo dei casi aziendali, la priorità degli investimenti, l'allocazione delle risorse e la governance dell'esecuzione

• Partner di Enterprise Solutions, Digital & Data, Infrastructure, Security e Site IT team per fornire soluzioni tecnologiche scalabili, sicure e conformi a tutte le piattaforme di produzione, qualità, ERP/MES, automazione e dati

• Sostenere importanti iniziative di espansione della piattaforma, progetti di capitale e attività M&A assicurando la disponibilità della tecnologia e l'integrazione IT di successo

• Costruire relazioni di fiducia tra leadership aziendale, siti di produzione, qualità, supply chain e altri stakeholder chiave, agendo come consulente primario sulla strategia tecnologica e l'innovazione digitale

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti di governance IT, sicurezza informatica, GxP, regolamentazione e integrità dei dati, supportando le attività di audit e governance delle piattaforme

• Monitorare le prestazioni del portafoglio attraverso KPI, metriche di realizzazione del valore e recensioni delle prestazioni operative, guidando il miglioramento continuo tra servizi IT e capacità digitali

• Guidare e sviluppare i team IT della piattaforma, tra cui Site IT Leaders e Product Owners, promuovere lo sviluppo delle capacità, la collaborazione e una cultura dell'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo

qualifiche richieste:

• 10+ anni di esperienza nella leadership IT, IT Business Partnering, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Applications o Technology Strategy all'interno di organizzazioni globali

• Esperienza comprovata con i leader di business senior per definire la strategia tecnologica e fornire risultati aziendali misurabili

• Forte comprensione della produzione IT, piattaforme aziendali, prodotti digitali, automazione, dati, ambienti AI, ambienti ERP/MES e trasformazione aziendale tecnologica

• Esperienza leader complessi portafogli tecnologici, consegna prodotti digitali e programmi cross-funzionali all'interno di organizzazioni matrici

• Forte conoscenza delle industrie regolamentate come le scienze della vita, i farmaci, le biotecnologie, i dispositivi medici, o la produzione avanzata

• Dimostrata capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder senior, gestire le priorità concorrenti e guidare decisioni strategiche senza autorità diretta

• Ottima comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate, consulenza e capacità di presentazione executive con la capacità di tradurre argomenti tecnologici complessi in valore aziendale

• Forte capacità analitiche, strategiche e di problem solving, con esperienza costruzione di casi di business e realizzazione del valore di guida

• Corso di laurea in Informatica, Informatica, Ingegneria, Business o un campo correlato richiesto; Master's Degree preferito

• Passione per l'innovazione, la trasformazione digitale e la costruzione di team ad alto rendimento in un ambiente veloce e globale

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo — la soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, stato veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Vorgeschriebene Qualifikationen:

Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht - die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten eine Gegenleistung für eine Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Status als qualifizierte Person mit Behinderung, geschützter Veteranenstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents.
Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Chez Lonza, nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur exécutif, IT Business Partner – Advanced Synthesis, qui servira d'interface stratégique entre notre plateforme d'affaires et l'informatique, transformant les priorités commerciales en solutions technologiques qui accélèrent la croissance, l'innovation et l'excellence opérationnelle. Ce rôle de leadership très visible façonnera la stratégie numérique, la feuille de route technologique et les priorités d'investissement de la plateforme, tout en veillant à ce que les capacités de TI produisent des résultats opérationnels mesurables.

En étroite collaboration avec les chefs d'entreprise, les équipes Digital & Data, Enterprise Solutions, Infrastructure et Sécurité, vous dirigerez la livraison de bout en bout de produits numériques, de programmes technologiques et d'initiatives de transformation des plateformes. En tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des intervenants exécutifs, vous veillerez à ce que les investissements technologiques soient alignés sur la stratégie commerciale, ce qui permettra des opérations évolutives, conformes et prêtes à l'avenir dans le réseau mondial de fabrication de Lonza.

Principales responsabilités

• Servir de principal partenaire stratégique de la TI au leadership des plateformes d'affaires, en alignant la stratégie technologique sur les priorités opérationnelles, les objectifs opérationnels et les plans de croissance à long terme

• Former et exécuter la feuille de route technologique pluriannuelle de la plateforme, en identifiant les possibilités de transformation numérique et en permettant la valeur commerciale grâce aux technologies de données, d'automatisation, d'IA et d'entreprise

• Posséder la gestion de la demande de bout en bout, la hiérarchisation et la livraison de produits numériques et d'initiatives informatiques spécifiques à la plateforme, en assurant l'alignement sur la stratégie opérationnelle et les normes multiplateformes

• Diriger le portefeuille de TI de la plateforme, y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation, la hiérarchisation des investissements, l'affectation des ressources et la gouvernance de l'exécution

• Partenaire avec les équipes Enterprise Solutions, Digital & Data, Infrastructure, Sécurité et Site IT pour fournir des solutions technologiques évolutives, sécurisées et conformes à toutes les plateformes de fabrication, de qualité, ERP/MES, d'automatisation et de données

• Appuyer les principales initiatives d'expansion de la plateforme, les projets d'immobilisations et les activités de fusion-acquisition en assurant la disponibilité technologique et l'intégration réussie des TI

• Établir des relations de confiance entre les chefs d'entreprise, les sites de fabrication, la qualité, la chaîne d'approvisionnement et d'autres intervenants clés, agissant à titre de conseiller principal sur la stratégie technologique et l'innovation numérique

• Assurer la conformité avec les exigences en matière de gouvernance des TI, de cybersécurité, de GxP, de réglementation et d'intégrité des données tout en appuyant les vérifications et les activités de gouvernance des plateformes

• Surveiller la performance du portefeuille à l'aide des ICR, des indicateurs de réalisation de la valeur et des examens de la performance opérationnelle, en favorisant l'amélioration continue des services informatiques et des capacités numériques

• Diriger et mettre au point des équipes de TI, y compris des dirigeants de TI sur place et des propriétaires de produits, en favorisant le développement des capacités, la collaboration et une culture d'innovation et d'amélioration continue

Compétences requises:

• 10 ans et plus d'expérience en leadership informatique, partenariat d'affaires en TI, transformation numérique, applications d'entreprise ou stratégie technologique au sein des organisations mondiales

• Expérience éprouvée en partenariat avec des chefs d'entreprise principaux pour définir la stratégie technologique et obtenir des résultats mesurables

• Forte compréhension de la fabrication de l'informatique, des plateformes d'entreprise, des produits numériques, de l'automatisation, des données, de l'IA, des environnements ERP/MES et de la transformation des activités grâce à la technologie

• Expérience de portefeuilles technologiques complexes de premier plan, de livraison de produits numériques et de programmes interfonctionnels au sein des organisations matricielles

• Forte connaissance des industries réglementées comme les sciences de la vie, les produits pharmaceutiques, la biotechnologie, les dispositifs médicaux ou la fabrication avancée

• Capacité démontrée d'influencer les principaux intervenants, de gérer des priorités concurrentes et de diriger les décisions stratégiques sans pouvoir direct

• Excellente capacité de communication, de gestion des intervenants, de consultation et de présentation des cadres avec la capacité de traduire des sujets technologiques complexes en valeur opérationnelle

• Forte capacité d'analyse, de réflexion stratégique et de résolution de problèmes, avec l'expérience de la création d'analyses de rentabilisation et la réalisation de valeurs motrices

• Baccalauréat en technologie de l'information, informatique, ingénierie, affaires ou un domaine connexe requis; diplôme de maîtrise préféré

• Passion pour l'innovation, la transformation numérique et la constitution d'équipes performantes dans un environnement mondial rapide

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès, sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration des vies partout dans le monde - la satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi sans égard à la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'âge, le statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, le statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

Umzugsunterstützung: Verfügbar für berechtigte Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten sowie deren Familien.

Als Mechanical Technician (m/w/d) an unserem sterilen Produktionsstandort in Stein, Kanton Aargau, wirst du Teil unseres Produktionsteams und trägst massgeblich zur zuverlässigen und regelkonformen Herstellung von sterilen Flüssig- und Gefriertrocknungsprodukten bei. In dieser Rolle leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zu technischer Exzellenz, betrieblicher Stabilität und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung, während du stets die Einhaltung aller GMP- und regulatorischen Anforderungen sicherstellst.

Was auf Dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Herstellung steriler Produkte (flüssige und lyophilisierte Vials) unter GMP-konformen und aseptischen Bedingungen, inklusive selbständiger aseptischer Abriebe

• Aufbau, Abbau und Qualifizierung von Füll- und Produktionsequipment, inklusive mechanischer Tätigkeiten unter Reinraumbedingungen

• Sicherstellung der technischen Überwachung des Produktionsequipments, Prozessmonitoring, Unterstützung beim Troubleshooting und Funktion als Spezialist für komplexe Themen an der Fülllinie

• Ausführung mechanischer Aufgaben wie Installation und De‑Installation von beweglichem Equipment, Be‑ und Entladen von Gefriertrocknern sowie Durchführung von Filterintegritätstests

• GMP‑konforme Dokumentation in MES, Logbüchern und Formularen, inklusive Meldung von Abweichungen und Mitarbeit bei Root‑Cause‑Analysen

• Unterstützung bei vorbeugender Instandhaltung, ungeplanten Reparaturen sowie Mitwirkung an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen

• Durchführung mikrobiologischer Umgebungsmonitorings, In‑Process‑Kontrollen sowie Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Teammitglieder

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene mechanische oder technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Mechatronik, Gebäudetechnik, Polymechanik) oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation mit ausgeprägtem technischem Verständnis

• Erfahrung in der sterilen Produktion sowie fundiertes Prozessverständnis, z. B. in Batchherstellung, Füllung oder visueller Inspektion

• Fähigkeit zur Bedienung komplexer automatisierter Systeme; Kenntnisse in MES und SAP sind von Vorteil

• Sorgfältige, zuverlässige und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise kombiniert mit hoher Eigeninitiative und Teamfähigkeit

• Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Schichtbetrieb und Teilnahme am Pikettdienst

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind erwünscht

• Ausgeprägtes Bewusstsein für GMP‑, EHS‑ und Compliance‑Anforderungen

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

• Costruzione, smontaggio e qualificazione di attrezzature di riempimento e produzione, comprese le attività meccaniche in condizioni di camera pulita

• Capacità di operare sistemi automatizzati complessi; La conoscenza di MES e SAP è un vantaggio

• Metodo di lavoro attento, affidabile e orientato alla qualità combinato con un alto livello di iniziativa e lavoro di squadra

• Volontà di lavorare ore flessibili, turni e partecipazione al servizio pikett

• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco; Le competenze in inglese sono desiderate

• Forte consapevolezza di GMP, EHS e requisiti di conformità

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è esattamente ciò che vogliamo che tu condivida.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Relocation support: Available for eligible candidates and their families.

As a Mechanical Technician (m/f/d) at our sterile production site in Stein, Canton Aargau, you will become part of our production team and contribute significantly to the reliable and compliant production of sterile liquid and freeze-drying products. In this role, you make an important contribution to technical excellence, operational stability and continuous improvement while always ensuring compliance with all GMP and regulatory requirements.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Find our full list of local benefits You below:

• Benefits in stone: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Your tasks:

• Production of sterile products (liquid and lyophilized vials) under GMP-compliant and aseptic conditions, including independent aseptic abrasion

• Construction, dismantling and qualification of filling and production equipment, including mechanical activities under clean room conditions

• Ensuring technical monitoring of production equipment, process monitoring, support during troubleshooting and function as a specialist for complex topics on the filling line

• Execution of mechanical tasks such as installation and de-installation of mobile equipment, loading and unloading of freeze dryers and carrying out filter integrity tests

• GMP-compliant documentation in MES, logbooks and forms, including reporting of deviations and cooperation in root-cause analyses

• Support for preventive maintenance, unplanned repairs and participation in continuous improvement initiatives

• Implementation of microbiological environmental monitoring, in-process controls and support for the training of new team members

Your requirement profile:

• Completed mechanical or technical vocational training (e.g. mechatronics, building technology, polymechanics) or equivalent qualification with a strong technical understanding

• Experience in sterile production as well as sound process understanding, e.g. in batch production, filling or visual inspection

• Ability to operate complex automated systems; Knowledge of MES and SAP is an advantage

• Careful, reliable and quality-oriented working method combined with a high level of initiative and teamwork

• Willingness to work flexible hours, shifts and participation in the pikett service

• Very good knowledge of German; English skills are desired

• Strong awareness of GMP, EHS and compliance requirements

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s exactly what we want you to share.
Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents.
While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

At Lonza, we are looking for a Senior Director, Lonza Capability Centers (LCC) Design & Technology Transformation Lead to shape the future of our global Capability Center network by defining the operating model, technology strategy, and transformation roadmap that will enable scalable, efficient, and future-ready global service delivery.

Working closely with the Global Head of LCC, executive leadership, functional leaders, Enterprise IT, and global transformation teams, you will define how our Capability Centers operate, interact, and evolve across multiple geographies. You will drive the design of the multi-site operating model while ensuring the technology platforms, digital capabilities, and enterprise architecture are in place to support business growth, automation, AI enablement, and long-term operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and drive the global operating model, site strategy, and design principles for Lonza's Capability Center network, ensuring clear accountability, scalability, and alignment across all locations.

• Develop the long-term multi-site transformation roadmap, defining migration sequencing, capability deployment, operating model evolution, and readiness milestones across all Capability Centers.

• Serve as the enterprise design authority for Capability Center strategy, providing governance, resolving cross-site design challenges, and ensuring consistency across functions and geographies.

• Design and operationalize the Capability Center Centre of Excellence (CoE) framework, establishing governance, knowledge-sharing mechanisms, innovation practices, and continuous improvement capabilities across the network.

• Lead the end-to-end technology strategy for the Capability Center organization, ensuring digital platforms, workflow solutions, integrations, and service management technologies enable the target operating model.

• Partner closely with Enterprise IT, ERP programme teams, and external technology partners to align technology roadmaps, manage dependencies, and ensure successful delivery across multiple transformation waves.

• Ensure technology platforms are designed to support future automation, AI, analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining scalability and operational resilience.

• Drive alignment between SAP S/4HANA, enterprise architecture, service management platforms, and business workflows to enable seamless end-to-end operations across the Capability Center ecosystem.

• Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture standards, cybersecurity, data governance, and regulatory requirements across global operations.

• Lead cross-functional design workshops and influence senior business leaders to build alignment around strategic decisions, operating model evolution, and technology priorities.

• Manage key technology partners and external consulting organizations to ensure successful delivery, quality, and execution of strategic transformation initiatives.

• Build and lead a high-performing team, fostering collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement while supporting the long-term maturity of Lonza's global Capability Center model.

Required qualifications:

• 15+ years of experience leading technology transformation, operating model design, or Global Business Services (GBS)/Global Capability Center (GCC) programmes within complex multinational organizations.

• Proven experience designing and implementing Global Capability Center operating models, shared service organizations, or enterprise service delivery transformations, preferably with hands-on experience in India.

• Strong understanding of target operating model design, governance frameworks, service delivery architecture, organizational design, and multi-site transformation.

• Demonstrated experience leading enterprise technology programmes, digital platform implementations, and complex ERP-enabled transformations, including SAP S/4HANA.

• Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, system integration, workflow platforms, service management technologies, automation, AI, cybersecurity, and data governance.

• Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and lead complex cross-functional transformation programmes across multiple functions, geographies, and cultures.

• Strong consulting, facilitation, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable operating models and technology solutions.

• Experience managing external consulting partners, technology vendors, and large-scale implementation programmes with measurable business outcomes.

• Experience within life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, CDMO, or other highly regulated industries is strongly preferred.

• Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Organizational Design, or a related field required. TOGAF, ITIL, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent certifications are an advantage.

Every day, Lonza's products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world—the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in cinque continenti.
Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda la propria carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

A Lonza, stiamo cercando un Senior Director, Lonza Capability Centers (LCC) Design & Technology Transformation Lead per plasmare il futuro della nostra rete globale Capability Center definendo il modello operativo, la strategia tecnologica e la roadmap di trasformazione che consentirà la distribuzione globale di servizi scalabili, efficienti e futuri.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con il Global Head of LCC, la leadership esecutiva, i leader funzionali, Enterprise IT e i team di trasformazione globale, definirete come i nostri Centri di Capability operano, interagiscono e si evolvono in più geografie. Potrai guidare la progettazione del modello operativo multi-sito, assicurando le piattaforme tecnologiche, le capacità digitali e l'architettura aziendale sono in atto per supportare la crescita aziendale, l'automazione, l'attivazione AI e l'eccellenza operativa a lungo termine.

Principali responsabilità

• Definire e guidare il modello operativo globale, la strategia del sito e i principi di progettazione per la rete di Lonza Capability Center, garantendo una chiara responsabilitÃ, scalabilitÃ e allineamento in tutte le posizioni.

• Sviluppare la roadmap di trasformazione multi-sito a lungo termine, definendo il sequenziamento delle migrazioni, la distribuzione delle capacità, l'evoluzione del modello operativo e le pietre miliari di prontezza in tutti i Centri di Capability.

• Servire come autorità di progettazione aziendale per la strategia di Capability Center, fornire governance, risolvere le sfide di progettazione cross-site, e garantire la coerenza tra funzioni e geografie.

• Progettazione e operativizzazione del framework Capability Center of Excellence (CoE), creazione di meccanismi di governance, condivisione delle conoscenze, pratiche di innovazione e funzionalità di miglioramento continuo in tutta la rete.

• Guida la strategia tecnologica end-to-end per l'organizzazione Capability Center, assicurando piattaforme digitali, soluzioni di workflow, integrazioni e tecnologie di gestione dei servizi che consentono il modello operativo target.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Enterprise IT, team di programma ERP e partner tecnologici esterni per allineare le roadmap tecnologiche, gestire le dipendenze e garantire la consegna di successo attraverso diverse onde di trasformazione.

• Garantire che le piattaforme tecnologiche siano progettate per supportare future iniziative di automazione, AI, analytics e miglioramento continuo, mantenendo al contempo scalabilità e resilienza operativa.

• Allineamento dell'unità tra SAP S/4HANA, architettura aziendale, piattaforme di gestione dei servizi e flussi di lavoro aziendali per consentire operazioni end-to-end senza soluzione di continuità attraverso l'ecosistema Capability Center.

• Assicurare il rispetto degli standard di architettura aziendale, della sicurezza informatica, della governance dei dati e dei requisiti normativi in tutte le operazioni globali.

• Condurre workshop di progettazione interfunzionali e influenzare i dirigenti aziendali senior per costruire l'allineamento intorno alle decisioni strategiche, l'evoluzione del modello operativo e le priorità tecnologiche.

• Gestisci partner tecnologici chiave e organizzazioni di consulenza esterne per garantire la consegna, la qualità e l'esecuzione di iniziative di trasformazione strategica.

• Costruire e guidare un team altamente performante, promuovendo la collaborazione, l'innovazione e il miglioramento continuo, supportando la maturità a lungo termine del modello globale Capability Center di Lonza.

qualifiche richieste:

• 15+ anni di esperienza leader tecnologia trasformazione, progettazione del modello operativo, o Global Business Services (GBS)/Global Capability Center (GCC) programmi all'interno di organizzazioni multinazionali complesse.

• Prove esperienze progettando e implementando modelli operativi del Global Capability Center, organizzazioni di servizio condivise, o trasformazioni di consegna di servizi aziendali, preferibilmente con esperienza pratica in India.

• Forte comprensione del design del modello operativo di destinazione, framework di governance, architettura di fornitura di servizi, progettazione organizzativa e trasformazione multi-sito.

• Esperienza dimostrata leader di programmi di tecnologia aziendale, implementazioni di piattaforme digitali e complesse trasformazioni ERP, tra cui SAP S/4HANA.

• Profonda comprensione dell'architettura aziendale, integrazione di sistema, piattaforme di flusso di lavoro, tecnologie di gestione dei servizi, automazione, AI, sicurezza informatica e governance dei dati.

• Prova capacità di influenzare le parti interessate esecutive e condurre complessi programmi di trasformazione interfunzionale attraverso molteplici funzioni, geografie e culture.

• Forte consulenza, facilitazione, gestione degli stakeholder e capacità di comunicazione, con la capacità di tradurre requisiti aziendali complessi in modelli operativi scalabili e soluzioni tecnologiche.

• Esperienza di gestione di partner di consulenza esterni, fornitori di tecnologia e programmi di implementazione su larga scala con risultati aziendali misurabili.

• L'esperienza all'interno di scienze della vita, farmaci, sanità, CDMO, o altre industrie altamente regolamentate è fortemente preferito.

• Laurea magistrale in Business Administration, Information Technology, Ingegneria, Progettazione organizzativa, o un campo correlato richiesto. TOGAF, ITIL, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, o le certificazioni equivalenti sono un vantaggio.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con il miglioramento delle vite in tutto il mondo – la soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, religione, colore, origine nazionale, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, età, stato come individuo qualificato con disabilità, stato veterano protetto, o qualsiasi altra caratteristica protetta dalla legge.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist.
Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine Zauberformel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Bei Lonza suchen wir einen Senior Director, Lonza Capability Centers (LCC) Design & Technology Transformation Lead, um die Zukunft unseres globalen Capability Center-Netzwerks zu gestalten, indem wir das Betriebsmodell, die Technologiestrategie und die Transformations-Roadmap definieren, die eine skalierbare, effiziente und zukunftsfähige globale Servicebereitstellung ermöglichen.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Global Head of LCC, Executive Leadership, Functional Leader, Enterprise IT und globalen Transformationsteams definieren Sie, wie unsere Capability Center in mehreren Regionen operieren, interagieren und sich weiterentwickeln. Sie werden das Design des Multi-Site-Betriebsmodells vorantreiben und gleichzeitig sicherstellen, dass die Technologieplattformen, digitalen Fähigkeiten und die Unternehmensarchitektur vorhanden sind, um Geschäftswachstum, Automatisierung, KI-Enablement und langfristige operative Exzellenz zu unterstützen.

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Definieren und steuern Sie das globale Betriebsmodell, die Standortstrategie und die Gestaltungsprinzipien für Lonzas Capability Center-Netzwerk, um eine klare Rechenschaftspflicht, Skalierbarkeit und Ausrichtung an allen Standorten zu gewährleisten.

• Entwickeln Sie die langfristige Multi-Site-Transformations-Roadmap, die Migrationssequenzierung, die Bereitstellung von Fähigkeiten, die Entwicklung des Betriebsmodells und Meilensteine für die Bereitschaft in allen Capability Centern definiert.

• Dienen Sie als Enterprise Design Authority für die Capability Center-Strategie, bieten Sie Governance, lösen Sie standortübergreifende Designherausforderungen und gewährleisten Sie Konsistenz über Funktionen und Regionen hinweg.

• Konzipieren und operationalisieren Sie das Capability Center Centre of Excellence (CoE) Framework, indem Sie Governance, Wissensaustauschmechanismen, Innovationspraktiken und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten im gesamten Netzwerk etablieren.

• Führen Sie die End-to-End-Technologiestrategie für die Capability Center-Organisation und stellen Sie sicher, dass digitale Plattformen, Workflow-Lösungen, Integrationen und Service-Management-Technologien das Zielbetriebsmodell ermöglichen.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Enterprise IT, ERP-Programmteams und externen Technologiepartnern, um Technologie-Roadmaps auszurichten, Abhängigkeiten zu verwalten und eine erfolgreiche Lieferung über mehrere Transformationswellen hinweg sicherzustellen.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Technologieplattformen so konzipiert sind, dass sie zukünftige Automatisierungs-, KI-, Analyse- und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen unterstützen und gleichzeitig Skalierbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit gewährleisten.

• Die Abstimmung zwischen SAP S/4HANA, Enterprise-Architektur, Service-Management-Plattformen und Business-Workflows soll nahtlose End-to-End-Operationen im gesamten Capability Center-Ökosystem ermöglichen.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Enterprise-Architekturstandards, Cybersicherheit, Data Governance und regulatorischen Anforderungen im gesamten globalen Betrieb.

• Leiten Sie funktionsübergreifende Design-Workshops und beeinflussen Sie Führungskräfte, um eine Ausrichtung auf strategische Entscheidungen, die Entwicklung von Betriebsmodellen und Technologieprioritäten aufzubauen.

• Verwalten Sie wichtige Technologiepartner und externe Beratungsorganisationen, um die erfolgreiche Bereitstellung, Qualität und Durchführung strategischer Transformationsinitiativen sicherzustellen.

• Aufbau und Leitung eines leistungsstarken Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und kontinuierliche Verbesserung fördert und gleichzeitig die langfristige Reife des globalen Capability Center-Modells von Lonza unterstützt.

• 15+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Leitung von Technologietransformation, Operating Model Design oder Global Business Services (GBS) / Global Capability Center (GCC) Programmen in komplexen multinationalen Organisationen.

• Bewährte Erfahrung beim Entwerfen und Implementieren von Global Capability Center-Betriebsmodellen, Shared-Service-Organisationen oder Transformationen von Unternehmensdienstleistungen, vorzugsweise mit praktischer Erfahrung in Indien.

• Starkes Verständnis des Designs von Zielbetriebsmodellen, Governance-Frameworks, Servicebereitstellungsarchitektur, Organisationsdesign und Multi-Site-Transformation.

• Demonstrierte Erfahrung mit führenden Enterprise-Technologieprogrammen, Implementierungen digitaler Plattformen und komplexen ERP-fähigen Transformationen, einschließlich SAP S/4HANA.

• Tiefes Verständnis für Unternehmensarchitektur, Systemintegration, Workflow-Plattformen, Service-Management-Technologien, Automatisierung, KI, Cybersicherheit und Data Governance.

• Starke Beratung, Erleichterung, Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare Betriebsmodelle und Technologielösungen zu übersetzen.

• Erfahrung im Management externer Beratungspartner, Technologieanbieter und groß angelegter Implementierungsprogramme mit messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen.

• Erfahrung in Life Sciences, Pharmazeutika, Gesundheitswesen, CDMO oder anderen stark regulierten Branchen wird stark bevorzugt.

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht - die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten eine Gegenleistung für eine Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Religion, Hautfarbe, nationale Herkunft, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Geschlechtsidentität, Alter, Status als qualifizierte Person mit Behinderung, geschützter Veteranenstatus oder andere gesetzlich geschützte Merkmale.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents.
Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Chez Lonza, nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur principal, Lonza Capacity Centers (LCC) Design & Technology Transformation Dirigez l'avenir de notre réseau mondial Capacity Center en définissant le modèle d'exploitation, la stratégie technologique et la feuille de route de transformation qui permettront une prestation de services mondiale évolutive, efficace et prête à l'avenir.

En étroite collaboration avec le responsable mondial de LCC, les dirigeants exécutifs, les dirigeants fonctionnels, les TI d'entreprise et les équipes de transformation mondiales, vous définirez comment nos centres de capacités fonctionnent, interagissent et évoluent à travers plusieurs géographies. Vous piloterez la conception du modèle opérationnel multi-site tout en assurant la mise en place des plateformes technologiques, des capacités numériques et de l'architecture d'entreprise pour soutenir la croissance des entreprises, l'automatisation, l'activation de l'IA et l'excellence opérationnelle à long terme.

Principales responsabilités

• Définir et piloter le modèle d'exploitation global, la stratégie du site et les principes de conception du réseau du Centre de capacités de Lonza, en assurant une responsabilisation claire, l'évolutivité et l'alignement sur tous les sites.

• Élaborer la feuille de route à long terme pour la transformation à plusieurs sites, définir le séquençage de la migration, le déploiement des capacités, l'évolution du modèle opérationnel et les étapes de préparation dans tous les centres de capacités.

• Servir d'autorité de conception d'entreprise pour la stratégie du Centre des capacités, fournir la gouvernance, résoudre les défis de conception inter-site, et assurer la cohérence entre les fonctions et les géographies.

• Concevoir et rendre opérationnel le cadre du Centre d'excellence du Centre de capacités (CdE), établir des mécanismes de gouvernance, de partage des connaissances, des pratiques d'innovation et des capacités d'amélioration continue dans l'ensemble du réseau.

• Diriger la stratégie technologique de bout en bout pour l'organisation du Centre de capacités, en veillant à ce que les plateformes numériques, les solutions de flux de travail, les intégrations et les technologies de gestion des services permettent le modèle opérationnel cible.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de programme Enterprise IT, ERP et les partenaires technologiques externes afin d'aligner les feuilles de route technologiques, de gérer les dépendances et d'assurer une prestation réussie à travers de multiples vagues de transformation.

• Veiller à ce que les plateformes technologiques soient conçues pour soutenir les futures initiatives d'automatisation, d'IA, d'analyse et d'amélioration continue tout en maintenant l'évolutivité et la résilience opérationnelle.

• Conduisez l'alignement entre SAP S/4HANA, l'architecture d'entreprise, les plates-formes de gestion de services et les workflows d'affaires afin de permettre des opérations de bout en bout sans faille dans l'écosystème du Centre de capacités.

• Assurer le respect des normes d'architecture d'entreprise, de la cybersécurité, de la gouvernance des données et des exigences réglementaires dans toutes les opérations mondiales.

• Diriger des ateliers de conception interfonctionnels et influencer les chefs d'entreprise supérieurs afin qu'ils s'alignent sur les décisions stratégiques, l'évolution des modèles d'exploitation et les priorités technologiques.

• Gérer les principaux partenaires technologiques et les organismes de consultation externes afin d'assurer la prestation, la qualité et l'exécution des initiatives de transformation stratégique.

• Construisez et dirigez une équipe hautement performante, favorisant la collaboration, l'innovation et l'amélioration continue tout en soutenant la maturité à long terme du modèle de centre de capacités mondial de Lonza.

Compétences requises:

• 15 ans et plus d'expérience en matière de transformation technologique, de conception de modèles d'exploitation ou de programmes Global Business Services (GBS)/Global Capacity Center (GCC) au sein d'organisations multinationales complexes.

• Expérience éprouvée en matière de conception et de mise en oeuvre de modèles d'exploitation du Global Capacity Center, d'organisations de services partagés ou de transformations de la prestation de services aux entreprises, de préférence avec une expérience pratique en Inde.

• Une bonne compréhension de la conception des modèles opérationnels cibles, des cadres de gouvernance, de l'architecture de prestation des services, de la conception organisationnelle et de la transformation à plusieurs sites.

• Expérience démontrée des programmes technologiques d'entreprise, des mises en place de plateformes numériques et des transformations complexes grâce aux ERP, y compris SAP S/4HANA.

• Connaissance approfondie de l'architecture d'entreprise, de l'intégration des systèmes, des plates-formes de flux de travail, des technologies de gestion des services, de l'automatisation, de l'IA, de la cybersécurité et de la gouvernance des données.

• Capacité éprouvée d'influencer les parties prenantes exécutives et de diriger des programmes complexes de transformation interfonctionnelle dans plusieurs fonctions, géographies et cultures.

• Forte capacité de consultation, de facilitation, de gestion des intervenants et de communication, avec la capacité de traduire des exigences opérationnelles complexes en modèles d'exploitation évolutives et en solutions technologiques.

• Expérience dans la gestion de partenaires de consultants externes, de fournisseurs de technologie et de programmes de mise en œuvre à grande échelle avec des résultats opérationnels mesurables.

• L'expérience dans les sciences de la vie, les produits pharmaceutiques, les soins de santé, l'OCMO ou d'autres industries hautement réglementées est fortement préférée.

• Maîtrise en administration des affaires, technologie de l'information, génie, conception organisationnelle ou un domaine connexe requis. TOGAF, ITIL, PMP, Lean Six Sigma ou des certifications équivalentes sont un avantage.

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès, sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde – la satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un employeur à chances égales. Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi sans égard à la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, l'âge, le statut d'individu qualifié handicapé, le statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: MSAT Bioconjugates Process Expert (f/m/d) - 80% -100%
jobs.description:
MSAT Bioconjugates Process Expert (f/m/d) - 80% -100%

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland.

Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Bioconjugation Manufacturing team in Visp and play a key role in delivering innovative biopharma manufacturing solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to combine scientific expertise, process excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to support the production of life-changing therapies.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Deliver process know-how, scientific expertise and operational excellence for biopharma API manufacturing.

• Ensure successful process technology transfer and manufacturability by collaborating with cross-functional teams including Process Development, Operations, QA and QC.

• Own and support change control activities to maintain compliant and efficient manufacturing processes.

• Provide manufacturing support during production campaigns and lead process troubleshooting activities on the shop floor.

• Drive process optimization through data analysis and preparation of CPV and APQR documentation in partnership with data management teams.

• Identify and implement workflow, process and asset improvements through innovation and continuous improvement projects.

• Act as a technical subject matter expert, supporting operational excellence and knowledge sharing across the organization.

What we are looking for:

• Master’s degree or PhD (preferred) in Bioconjugation, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific discipline, with a focus on organic chemistry.

• Significant industry experience in bioconjugation methodologies, biopharma manufacturing and/or process development, ideally within bioconjugates.

• Hands-on experience with downstream processing, including chromatography and filtration technologies.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make sound technical decisions.

• In-depth understanding of bioprocess technologies and practical cGMP manufacturing experience.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

• Fluent English language skills; German language knowledge is an advantage. Creative, agile and open-minded approach to challenges.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera.

L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.

Unisciti al nostro team di Bioconjugation Manufacturing di Visp e gioca un ruolo chiave nella fornitura di soluzioni innovative per la produzione di biofarmaci. Questa è un'opportunità emozionante per combinare competenze scientifiche, eccellenza di processo e collaborazione interfunzionale per supportare la produzione di terapie che cambiano la vita.

Questo ruolo si basa principalmente sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di medicinali ai massimi standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Una varietà di vantaggi dipende dal ruolo e dalla posizione.

L'elenco completo dei nostri benefici globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

Cosa farai:

• Fornire know-how di processo, competenze scientifiche e eccellenza operativa per la produzione di API biofarmaci.

• Assicurare il trasferimento e la manufacturability della tecnologia di processo di successo collaborando con team interfunzionali tra cui Sviluppo di processo, Operazioni, QA e QC.

• Possedere e sostenere le attività di controllo dei cambiamenti per mantenere i processi di produzione conformi ed efficienti.

• Fornire il supporto di produzione durante le campagne di produzione e le attività di risoluzione dei problemi del processo di piombo sul pavimento del negozio.

• Ottimizzazione del processo di trasmissione attraverso l'analisi dei dati e la preparazione della documentazione CPV e APQR in collaborazione con i team di gestione dei dati.

• Identificare e implementare il flusso di lavoro, il processo e il miglioramento delle risorse attraverso progetti di innovazione e miglioramento continuo.

• Agire come esperto di materia tecnica, sostenere l'eccellenza operativa e la condivisione delle conoscenze in tutta l'organizzazione.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea magistrale o PhD (preferito) in Bioconiugazione, Biotecnologia, Ingegneria Chimica o una disciplina scientifica correlata, con un focus sulla chimica organica.

• Esperienza industriale significativa nelle metodologie di bioconiugazione, produzione di biofarmaci e/o sviluppo di processi, idealmente all'interno di biocongiunti.

• Esperienza a mano con lavorazione a valle, comprese le tecnologie di cromatografia e filtrazione.

• Forte capacità analitiche e problem solving con la capacità di interpretare i dati complessi e prendere decisioni tecniche sonore.

• Comprensione approfondita delle tecnologie di bioprocesso e dell'esperienza di produzione cGMP pratica.

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team interfunzionali.

• Conoscenza della lingua inglese fluida; la conoscenza della lingua tedesca è un vantaggio. Un approccio creativo, agile e aperto alle sfide.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Diriger l'optimisation des processus par l'analyse des données et la préparation de la documentation CPV et APQR en partenariat avec les équipes de gestion des données.

• Identifier et mettre en oeuvre les améliorations des flux de travail, des processus et des biens grâce à des projets d'innovation et d'amélioration continue.

• Agir à titre d'expert technique, en appuyant l'excellence opérationnelle et le partage des connaissances dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Ce que nous cherchons :

• Maîtrise ou doctorat (préféré) en bioconjugaison, biotechnologie, génie chimique ou une discipline scientifique connexe, avec un accent sur la chimie organique.

• Expérience importante de l'industrie en matière de méthodologies de bioconjugaison, de fabrication de produits biopharmaceutiques et/ou de développement de procédés, idéalement dans les bioconjugaisons.

• Expérience pratique du traitement en aval, y compris la chromatographie et les technologies de filtration.

• De solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes avec la capacité d'interpréter des données complexes et de prendre des décisions techniques judicieuses.

• Compréhension approfondie des technologies de bioprocédés et de l'expérience pratique en matière de fabrication cGMP.

• Excellente communication et aptitudes interpersonnelles avec la capacité de travailler efficacement dans des équipes interfonctionnelles.

• Compétences linguistiques en anglais; la connaissance de l'allemand est un avantage. Une approche créative, agile et ouverte des défis.

À propos de Lonza

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et ça, c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez. L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Senior Bioprocess Engineer (m/f/d) 80%–100%

The actual location of this position is Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As a Senior Bioprocess Engineer – Senior Expert Biotechnologist Manufacturing, you will play a key role in the successful execution of GMP manufacturing campaigns and drive the technical advancement of biotechnological manufacturing processes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, promote continuous improvement, and support the professional development of employees in a dynamic production environment.

This is a fully site-based position. Close in-person collaboration enables direct real-time alignment and supports the technical precision required to manufacture pharmaceuticals according to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career path and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical working environment.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• An expert role with high technical responsibility and visibility within the organization.

• The opportunity to actively shape manufacturing processes and technical strategies.

• Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality, and Engineering.

For the full list of our global benefits, visit: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Responsible for the GMP-compliant execution and technical oversight of manufacturing campaigns in upstream and downstream operations.

• Create, review, and implement risk assessments and track resulting action items.

• Ensure successful batch execution, including data analysis, evaluation of test results, troubleshooting, and development of sustainable solutions.

• Ensure complete and high-quality GMP documentation and maintain process knowledge documentation.

• Identify and implement improvements to processes, equipment, and workflows in close collaboration with MSAT and other stakeholders.

• Lead product-specific campaign training and support cross-functional employee development initiatives.

• Promote technical development within the team through coaching, workshops, presentations, and support during audits and inspections.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Chemical Engineering, or a related scientific/technical field.

• At least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing with a strong understanding of GMP requirements.

• Experience supporting and optimizing biotechnological manufacturing processes, ideally in USP and/or DSP environments.

• Solid knowledge of deviation management, risk assessments, process improvement, and GMP documentation.

• Strong analytical skills combined with a structured and solution-oriented approach to work.

• Demonstrated cross-functional leadership capabilities and potential to assume direct people-management responsibilities.

• Fluent German and English language skills, along with excellent communication and training abilities.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. Across more than 30 sites on five continents, our globally connected teams collaborate every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values—Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion, and Integrity—reflect who we are and how we work together. Join us as a Supply Chain Coordinator, where you will manage end-to-end material and shipment coordination, ensuring drug substance, raw materials, and customer-supplied components are delivered, received, released, and available in SAP on time to support seamless manufacturing operations. Acting as the central interface between customers, suppliers, logistics, QA, QC, planning, and production teams, you will drive supply chain excellence through proactive coordination, process optimization, and flawless execution of inbound and outbound shipments. Check out your Career at Lonza!
This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Coordinate end-to-end material and shipment activities, ensuring customer-supplied materials, drug substance, and finished products are available, received, released, and delivered on time to support uninterrupted manufacturing operations.

• Manage demand planning and SAP master data, maintaining independent demand, material records, purchase orders, and shipment-related transactions to enable accurate planning and seamless supply chain execution.

• Partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders including Logistics, QA, QC, Production Planning, and Supply Chain teams to align material availability, shipping schedules, quality releases, and customer requirements.

• Oversee inbound and outbound shipments, tracking delivery performance, coordinating goods receipt and storage readiness, confirming shipment milestones, and ensuring all documentation and processes are completed accurately and on schedule.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience in Supply Chain, Material Coordination, or a related field is required, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and ensure timely material availability in a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong organizational and planning skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to coordinating shipments, materials, master data, and stakeholder activities from end to end.

• Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills, able to build effective partnerships across customers, logistics, quality, planning, and manufacturing teams to achieve shared objectives.

• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry is highly preferred, with a good understanding of GMP requirements and quality-driven supply chain processes.

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset, comfortable working in a dynamic and sometimes challenging environment, with a willingness to drive process improvements, implement new ways of working, and continuously enhance operational efficiency.
