The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join us as a Supply Chain Coordinator, where you will manage end-to-end material and shipment coordination, ensuring drug substance, raw materials, and customer-supplied components are delivered, received, released, and available in SAP on time to support seamless manufacturing operations. Acting as the central interface between customers, suppliers, logistics, QA, QC, planning, and production teams, you will drive supply chain excellence through proactive coordination, process optimization, and flawless execution of inbound and outbound shipments. Check out your Career at Lonza!
This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Coordinate end-to-end material and shipment activities, ensuring customer-supplied materials, drug substance, and finished products are available, received, released, and delivered on time to support uninterrupted manufacturing operations.

• Manage demand planning and SAP master data, maintaining independent demand, material records, purchase orders, and shipment-related transactions to enable accurate planning and seamless supply chain execution.

• Partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders including Logistics, QA, QC, Production Planning, and Supply Chain teams to align material availability, shipping schedules, quality releases, and customer requirements.

• Oversee inbound and outbound shipments, tracking delivery performance, coordinating goods receipt and storage readiness, confirming shipment milestones, and ensuring all documentation and processes are completed accurately and on schedule.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by optimizing supply chain processes, supporting shipping agreements, coordinating material disposition activities, and identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

What we are looking for:

• Proven experience in Supply Chain, Material Coordination, or a related field is required, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and ensure timely material availability in a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong organizational and planning skills, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to coordinating shipments, materials, master data, and stakeholder activities from end to end.

• Collaborative team player with excellent communication skills, able to build effective partnerships across customers, logistics, quality, planning, and manufacturing teams to achieve shared objectives.

• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated manufacturing industry is highly preferred, with a good understanding of GMP requirements and quality-driven supply chain processes.

• Proactive and solution-oriented mindset, comfortable working in a dynamic and sometimes challenging environment, with a willingness to drive process improvements, implement new ways of working, and continuously enhance operational efficiency.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.title: Lab Technician (m/w/d) - Advanced Synthesis (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung: Verfügbar für berechtigte Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten sowie deren Familien.

Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir einen engagierten Lab Technician (m/w/d) im Bereich Advanced Synthesis. In dieser abwechslungsreichen Rolle unterstützt du die verfahrenstechnische Entwicklung von Produktionsprozessen durch die Durchführung und Auswertung analytischer Untersuchungen. Als wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen analytischer und verfahrenstechnischer Entwicklung trägst du dazu bei, Experimente effizient auszuwerten und die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Projekten sowie die Entwicklung innovativer pharmazeutischer Wirkstoffe voranzutreiben.

Was auf Dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Dich zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits findest Du unten:

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Was dich erwartet:

• Du führst Analysen mittels (U)HPLC, LC-MS und GC-HS zur Untersuchung von Proben aus der Prozessentwicklung durch.

• Du unterstützt bei der Einführung und Etablierung neuer analytischer Methoden.

• Du planst und führst Experimente im Standard- und Containment-Labor durch.

• Du koordinierst und überwachst Arbeitspakete in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Prozess- und Analytikentwicklung.

• Du dokumentierst Analyse- und Laborergebnisse, wertest Daten aus und erstellst analytische Berichte.

• Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Laborgeräte in deinem Arbeitsbereich, inklusive Pflege, Wartung und Ordnung.

• Du fungierst als zentrale Ansprechperson für analytische Themen innerhalb der Prozessentwicklung.

Was du mitbringst:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Chemie- oder Biologielaborant/in oder eine vergleichbare naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung mit erster relevanter Berufserfahrung.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit HPLC- oder UPLC-Analysen ist Voraussetzung.

• Kenntnisse weiterer analytischer Techniken wie LC-MS, GC oder NMR sind von Vorteil.

• Selbstständige, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.

• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Denkweise.

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundkenntnisse in Englisch.

• Teamfähigkeit und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke.

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben

In this varied role, you support the process engineering development of production processes by carrying out and evaluating analytical investigations. As an important interface between analytical and process engineering development, you will help to efficiently evaluate experiments and advance the successful implementation of projects as well as the development of innovative pharmaceutical active ingredients.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• You perform analyses using (U)HPLC, LC-MS and GC-HS to examine samples from process development.

• You support the introduction and establishment of new analytical methods.

Apply now

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

We are looking to recruit a Manufacturing Lead (Director) to build up the operations organization for the Payload-Linker capacity expansion in Visp.  Leads a team of  production leaders, supervisors and specialists You will manage the operational readiness and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up within the investment / Capex Project. After becoming operational, you will oversee the operational activities of the manufacturing unit with overall responsibility of manufacturing execution regarding safety, quality and on-time-in full delivery, as well as for the performance and results of the assigned area including cost control.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Lead a team of production managers (chemists/chemical engineers), supervisors, and specialists, with full responsibility for all aspects of people management, including qualification, development, coaching, hiring, compensation decisions, and performance or conduct issues.

• Manage the operational readiness within the CAPEX project and provide leadership to the CQ-project team incl. the post OQ Start-up

• Accountable for executing all production campaigns in the manufacturing unit, ensuring compliance with safety, quality, and environmental requirements.

• Maintain oversight of production costs and provide POV forecasts for all campaigns within the area of responsibility. Contribute to budgeting and the preparation of product cost calculations for standard pricing.

• As a member of the Functional Leadership Team, support overall production management, including housekeeping, team conduct, training activities, and general operational controls.

• Serve as an operational specialist and regular point of contact for BU team members on production planning (S&OP), technical assessments, and feasibility requests.

• Responsible for routine performance monitoring, including weekly reports, dashboards, Hoshin boards, and other reporting tools.

What we are looking for:

• Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or equivalent) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related field.

• Demonstrated leadership skills with strong self-motivation, integrity, perseverance, and results orientation.

• Extensive experience in chemical manufacturing in the pharmaceutical industry, in leadership roles.

• Strong knowledge of GMP and EHS requirements.

• Fluency in English, German is an advantage

• Experience with Operational Excellence / LEAN principles is an advantage.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

• Come membro del Functional Leadership Team, supporta la gestione generale della produzione, tra cui la pulizia, la conduzione di team, le attività di formazione e i controlli operativi generali.

• Servire come specialista operativo e punto di contatto regolare per i membri del team BU sulla pianificazione della produzione (S&OP), valutazioni tecniche e richieste di fattibilità.

• Responsabile per il monitoraggio delle prestazioni di routine, compresi i rapporti settimanali, dashboard, schede Hoshin e altri strumenti di reporting.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea avanzata (Master’s, PhD, o equivalente) in Chimica, Ingegneria Chimica, o un campo relativo.

• Competenze di leadership dimostrate con forte auto-motivazione, integrità, perseveranza e orientamento dei risultati.

• Ampia esperienza nella produzione chimica nell'industria farmaceutica, in ruoli di leadership.

• Forte conoscenza dei requisiti GMP e EHS.

• Fluency in inglese, il tedesco è un vantaggio

• L'esperienza con l'eccellenza operativa / principi LEAN è un vantaggio.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland.

To be a intern in our Basel legal team, reporting to the Associate General Counsel, Corporate. We are looking for an intern with interest in corporate matters, contracting and contract and AI technology tools. We offer an excellent work environment where you can develop your skills and knowledge, the opportunity to work in a team of highly collaborative experts in a fun and dynamic atmosphere, a competitive salary and benefits. At Lonza we invest in great people. We encourage our employees to challenge themselves, and we offer an environment that fosters creativity and success. With headquarters in Basel, Switzerland, we operate production, R&D and business sites around the world, including Europe, North America and Asia.

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What you'll do:

• Supporting role in a global role out of a Contract Life Cycle Management Tool

• Support with drafting and harmonizing a full suite of contracts.

• Support with respect to all other legal aspects of work on M&A, transactions and strategic projects, as required.

• Act as a business legal partner with internal clients of the company.

• Perform other related duties as assigned by General Counsel, Corporate and Associate General Counsel, Corporate.

• A proactive member of the team who is keen to learn and work in a fast paced environment.

• Team player who is comfortable working with all levels of management.

What we are looking for:
You are someone who is a team player, with a can-do mentality, proactive, self-starter, challenges status quo, able to work seamlessly and with agility across businesses and functions. You are someone who likes working in a multicultural environment with people on different education levels. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your aspirations, where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point. Furthermore you have the following skills, experience and qualifications:

• Legal studies – currently completing or completed.

• Keen interest in contract drafting in plain English.

• Keen interest in M&A and corporate or commercial projects.

• Experience or understanding of contract law (civil law and common law) and corporate matters.

• At ease in drafting legal documents and communicating in English (German, French, Spanish or other languages also helpful).

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

The Lead Production Supply & Material Management team is responsible for the technical and personnel management as well as the continuous development of the team within central logistics. In this key role, the function ensures a stable, efficient and compliant material supply for production and ensures the smooth control of the relevant operational processes.

The area of responsibility includes in particular the picking, material provision, inventory and inventory management processes, the coordination and control of inventory activities as well as the management of external logistics service providers (3PL). In addition, the position ensures the quality of logistical master data and supports robust data governance.
Through close cooperation with production, warehouses, quality, finance, external financial audit offices and other interfaces, the function contributes significantly to process stability, transparency and compliance.

In addition, Team Lead initiates and drives continuous improvements, standardizations and future-oriented logistics solutions in order to sustainably develop the performance of central logistics.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your tasks:

• Leadership, motivation and further development of the Production Supply & Material Management team

• Ensuring a reliable and timely material supply for production

• Responsibility for the operational processes in the areas of picking, material provision, inventory management and material handling

• Responsibility for inventory management, including planning, coordination, implementation and control of the inventory activities of Visp central warehouse and external logistics service providers (3PL)

• Ensuring close and professional cooperation with Finance and external financial auditors in the context of inventory and inventory processes

• Ensuring compliance with quality, compliance and safety requirements

• Control, monitoring and further development of external logistics service providers (3PL)

• Analysis, optimization and standardization of logistics processes as well as implementation of continuous improvement measures

• Responsibility for the maintenance and quality of logistical master data and support for data governance

• Participation in the development and implementation of efficient and future-oriented logistics solutions

• Promoting cross-sectoral cooperation between logistics, warehouses, production and other interfaces

Your profile:

• Commercial, logistical (preferably logistics specialist EFZ) or comparable vocational training

• Ideally, 2–3 years of professional experience in a pharmaceutical or life science company

• Good practical knowledge of SAP EWM and ideally SAP WM and MM

• Experience in commissioning, warehouse logistics and materials management

• 3PL Logistics Services

• Structured, reliable and independent working method

• Teamwork, flexibility and responsibility

• Good knowledge of German and English for everyday work

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s exactly what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our team as a Senior Strategic Buyer, where you will play a vital role in ensuring our sites have the supplies needed to manufacture life-saving medicines. This is an exciting opportunity to manage diverse portfolios and drive efficiency in a fast-paced, global environment.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week), and with collaboration and occasional travel within the sites network and HQ.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What you will do:

• Collaborate with the Central Procurement team to deliver significant value and support to our site stakeholders.

• Manage an approximate annual delegated spend of 50m CHF within given categories.

• Partner with key stakeholders across multiple sites to ensure business continuity and meet evolving site requirements.

• Provide purchasing expertise in tendering, negotiation, and contracting while utilizing modern purchasing systems.

• Drive supplier performance by managing local relationships and executing savings projects alongside Global Category Managers.

• Support the execution of procurement strategies by gathering local business needs and monitoring supply market risks.

• Mentor and supervise junior colleagues and new joiners to foster a culture of continuous professional growth.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business or Supply Chain; a Master’s degree or equivalent transferable experience is a plus.

• Proven experience in procurement or supply chain management, ideally within a regulated industry environment.

• Track record in Facilities Management category, implementation and management of managed programs are a plus

• Strong technical proficiency with SAP and e-catalogue systems such as Ariba.

• A proactive, strategic mindset with the ability to work independently within established procedures and ability to influence stakeholders.

• High attention to detail when validating complex sourcing requirements.

• Professional fluency in English is essential, and proficiency in German is advantageous.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our team as a Senior Strategic Buyer, where you will play a vital role in ensuring our sites have the supplies needed to manufacture life-saving medicines. This is an exciting opportunity to manage diverse portfolios and drive efficiency in a fast-paced, global environment.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week), and with collaboration and occasional travel within the sites network and HQ.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

What you will do:

• Collaborate with the Central Procurement team to deliver significant value and support to our site stakeholders.

• Manage an approximate annual delegated spend of 50m CHF within given categories.

• Partner with key stakeholders across multiple sites to ensure business continuity and meet evolving site requirements.

• Provide purchasing expertise in tendering, negotiation, and contracting while utilizing modern purchasing systems.

• Drive supplier performance by managing local relationships and executing savings projects alongside Global Category Managers.

• Support the execution of procurement strategies by gathering local business needs and monitoring supply market risks.

• Mentor and supervise junior colleagues and new joiners to foster a culture of continuous professional growth.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business or Supply Chain; a Master’s degree or equivalent transferable experience is a plus.

• Proven experience in procurement or supply chain management, ideally within a regulated industry environment.

• Track record in Facilities Management category, implementation and management of managed programs are a plus

• Strong technical proficiency with SAP and e-catalogue systems such as Ariba.

• A proactive, strategic mindset with the ability to work independently within established procedures and ability to influence stakeholders.

• High attention to detail when validating complex sourcing requirements.

• Professional fluency in English is essential, and proficiency in German is advantageous.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'une qualification de spécialiste de l'AQ (Aîné) (f/m/j), qui soutiendra notre équipe Qualification de l'AQ.

Ce que vous obtiendrez :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.

• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. Notre liste complète des prestations locales sur mesure se trouve ci-dessous.
Avantages dans le Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Ce que vous ferez :

• Représentant de l'AQ Qualification dans l'organisation du projet pour de nouvelles installations ou d'autres projets concernant la qualification des installations, des services publics, du matériel et des systèmes

• Coordination des différents intérêts de l'AQ au cours de la phase du projet, p. ex. processus, nettoyage ou autres objectifs pertinents de l'AQ

• Conduire la mise en œuvre de la nouvelle stratégie de qualification et être un décideur fort au besoin

• Compiler, examiner et publier des documents de qualification (URS, plan de qualification et rapport, rapports DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ et plus) afin d'appuyer et d'approuver l'analyse des risques de qualité (p. ex.

• Effectuer des évaluations et des approbations des demandes de modifications techniques au cours des différentes phases d'un projet et du cycle de vie et leur pertinence pour la qualification des installations, équipements, services publics et systèmes

• Représentation de sujets de qualification lors des audits des clients et des inspections réglementaires

• Être responsable de conduire l'ACAP et l'efficacité Vérifier les éléments jusqu'à leur achèvement et leur fermeture en temps opportun, et s'assurer que les écarts sont adéquatement étudiés et consignés dans les rapports de déviation

Ce que nous cherchons :

• Diplôme universitaire en génie/chimie/biotechnologie ou dans tout domaine connexe

• Expérience significative dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, idéalement dans un rôle d'AQ

• Une bonne compréhension des règlements applicables sur les BPFc serait un avantage

• Connaissance générale des procédés d'ingénierie et de fabrication

• Aptitude à superviser l'exécution des projets afin de déceler le non-respect des normes de qualité

• L'allemand (écrit et verbal) est requis; de bonnes compétences en anglais sont un avantage

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites répartis sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et ça, c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous avons hâte de vous accueillir à bord.
Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland. This is a one year temporary contract.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

As a Scope Change Coordinator (Drug Product Services), you will work in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment, partnering with technical teams, program management, commercial development, finance, legal    , and supply chain functions. In this role, you will coordinate project scope changes, support commercial and operational processes, and help ensure successful project execution while maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

What you will do:

• Coordinate amendments and scope changes for ongoing projects in accordance with established processes and governance requirements.

• Collaborate proactively with stakeholders across multiple functions to support project delivery and customer expectations.

• Monitor project performance, including profitability, cost control, pricing, purchase order management, and production forecast updates.

• Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to program execution and project performance.

• Support the maintenance and improvement of processes, contract templates, resource planning tools, and stakeholder information flows.

• Contribute to effective communication and collaboration between customers, project teams, and business functions.

• Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

What we are looking for:

• Experience working in a project coordination, commercial, operational, or business support environment with life sciences background.

• Commercial and financial awareness, with an understanding of project costs, risks, and business impact.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with Power BI, Microsoft Lists, and Power Automate is an advantage.

• English fluent

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at different levels.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple activities while meeting deadlines.

• Ability to understand complex processes, identify improvement opportunities, and support simplification initiatives.

• A proactive, detail-oriented, and results-focused approach, with a strong sense of accountability and urgency.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Basilea, Svizzera. Questo è un contratto temporaneo di un anno.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

Questo è un primo ruolo da ufficio. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e un allineamento del team, consentendoci di fornire il nostro lavoro migliore. Potrai lavorare principalmente in ufficio, con la flessibilità di lavorare da remoto per il 20% del tuo tempo (un giorno alla settimana).

In qualità di Coordinatore del Cambiamento di Scope (Drug Product Services), lavorerai in un ambiente altamente collaborativo e interfunzionale, collaborando con team tecnici, gestione del programma, sviluppo commerciale, finanza, funzioni legali e supply chain. In questo ruolo, coordinare i cambiamenti di portata del progetto, sostenere i processi commerciali e operativi, e contribuire a garantire l'esecuzione del progetto di successo, mantenendo forti relazioni con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

Cosa farai:

• Coordinare modifiche e cambiamenti di portata per i progetti in corso in conformità con i processi stabiliti e i requisiti di governance.

• Collabora in modo proattivo con le parti interessate attraverso molteplici funzioni per supportare la consegna del progetto e le aspettative dei clienti.

• Monitorare le prestazioni del progetto, tra cui redditività, controllo dei costi, prezzi, gestione degli ordini di acquisto e aggiornamenti delle previsioni di produzione.

• Traccia e segnala gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) relativi all'esecuzione del programma e alle prestazioni del progetto.

• Sostenere la manutenzione e il miglioramento dei processi, modelli di contratto, strumenti di pianificazione delle risorse e flussi di informazioni degli stakeholder.

• Contribuisci alla comunicazione efficace e alla collaborazione tra clienti, team di progetto e funzioni aziendali.

• Costruire e mantenere forti rapporti di lavoro con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente di coordinamento del progetto, commerciale, operativo o di supporto aziendale con lo sfondo delle scienze della vita.

• Sensibilizzazione commerciale e finanziaria, con una comprensione dei costi del progetto, dei rischi e dell'impatto aziendale.

• La competenza con applicazioni Microsoft 365, tra cui Excel avanzato, PowerPoint e Word; l'esperienza con Power BI, Microsoft Lists e Power Automate è un vantaggio.

• fluente inglese

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder a diversi livelli.

• Forte capacità organizzative e la capacità di priorizzare più attività durante le scadenze di incontro.

• Capacità di comprendere processi complessi, identificare opportunità di miglioramento e sostenere iniziative di semplificazione.

• Un approccio proattivo, orientato al dettaglio e focalizzato sui risultati, con un forte senso di responsabilità e urgenza.

A Lonza, il nostro popolo è la nostra più grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica ora.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Der tatsächliche Standort dieses Jobs ist in Basel, Schweiz. Dies ist ein einjähriger befristeter Vertrag.

Was Sie bekommen:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung erkennen

Das ist eine Office-First-Rolle. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit unterstützt eine enge, Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit und Teamausrichtung, so dass wir unsere beste Arbeit leisten können. Sie werden hauptsächlich im Büro arbeiten, mit der Flexibilität, für 20% Ihrer Zeit aus der Ferne zu arbeiten (ein Tag pro Woche).

Als Scope Change Coordinator (Drug Product Services) arbeiten Sie in einem hochgradig kooperativen, funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld und arbeiten mit technischen Teams, Programmmanagement, kommerzieller Entwicklung, Finanzen, Recht und Lieferkettenfunktionen zusammen. In dieser Funktion koordinieren Sie Änderungen des Projektumfangs, unterstützen kommerzielle und operative Prozesse und tragen zur erfolgreichen Projektdurchführung bei, während Sie enge Beziehungen zu internen und externen Stakeholdern pflegen.

Was Sie tun werden:

• Koordinieren Sie Änderungen und Umfangsänderungen für laufende Projekte in Übereinstimmung mit festgelegten Prozessen und Governance-Anforderungen.

• Arbeiten Sie proaktiv mit Stakeholdern über mehrere Funktionen hinweg zusammen, um die Projektabwicklung und die Kundenerwartungen zu unterstützen.

• Überwachen Sie die Projektleistung, einschließlich Rentabilität, Kostenkontrolle, Preisgestaltung, Bestellverwaltung und Aktualisierungen der Produktionsprognose.

• Verfolgen und Berichten von Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) in Bezug auf Programmausführung und Projektleistung.

• Unterstützung der Wartung und Verbesserung von Prozessen, Vertragsvorlagen, Ressourcenplanungstools und Stakeholder-Informationsflüssen.

• Tragen Sie zu einer effektiven Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Geschäftsfunktionen bei.

• Aufbau und Pflege starker Arbeitsbeziehungen zu internen und externen Stakeholdern.

Was wir suchen:

• Erfahrung in einer Projektkoordinations-, Geschäfts-, Betriebs- oder Geschäftsunterstützungsumgebung mit Life Sciences-Hintergrund.

• Kommerzielles und finanzielles Bewusstsein, mit einem Verständnis der Projektkosten, Risiken und Geschäftsauswirkungen.

• Kenntnisse mit Microsoft 365-Anwendungen, einschließlich erweiterter Excel, PowerPoint und Word; Erfahrung mit Power BI, Microsoft Lists und Power Automate ist ein Vorteil.

• Englisch fließend

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf verschiedenen Ebenen zu interagieren.

• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aktivitäten zu priorisieren, während die Fristen eingehalten werden.

• Fähigkeit, komplexe Prozesse zu verstehen, Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und Vereinfachungsinitiativen zu unterstützen.

• Ein proaktiver, detailorientierter und ergebnisorientierter Ansatz mit einem starken Gefühl der Rechenschaftspflicht und Dringlichkeit.

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. Mit mehr als 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere weltweit vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Alle Ideen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der Sie teilnehmen sollen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen mit allen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven auf den Tisch bringen. Bei Lonza legen wir Wert auf Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter zu schaffen. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist QC HPLC (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a Scientist to join our QC HPLC Mammalian and mRNA team in Visp. Become part of our energetic and growing international team and take the opportunity to work on interesting projects in the rapidly developing field of Biologics.

Key responsibilities:

• Investigation and management of deviations, as Lead Investigator

• Root cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA implementation for project topics, and general lab topic.

• Coaching and mentoring of junior QC colleagues.

• QC analytical review and evaluation of results.

• Technical writing and document review (test methods, APs, protocols, reports).

• Quality oversight and audit readiness in GMP-regulated labs (participation in audits for assigned projects).

• Support optimization of laboratory processes and workflows

• Continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, 5S, Six Sigma, etc.)

• Implementation, optimization, transfer and validation of analytical methods, with focus on HPLC, CE and icIEF.

• Responsibility for all HPLC project related tasks and representation of HPLC team in the project team for the assigned projects.

• Processing of investigations, change requests and deviations under cGMP.

• Extraction and evaluation of analytical data, preparation of reports and presentations.

• Preparation, review and approval of documents to ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines.

• Expertise in analytical and technical issues for the assigned projects.

Key requirements:

• Master or PhD in chemistry, biochemistry, biology or related field.

• Minimum 5-10 years of proven experience in pharma industry.

• Good understanding of GMP required.

• Experience with HPLC, CE or icIEF desirable.

• Ideally experience with IT systems like LIMS and CDS.

• Proficient in English, German is a plus.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as meaningful as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è un leader globale nelle scienze della vita che opera in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è dedicata alle persone che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda la propria carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Stiamo cercando uno scienziato per unirsi al nostro team QC HPLC Mammalian e mRNA a Visp. Entra a far parte del nostro team internazionale energico e in crescita e approfitta dell'opportunità di lavorare su progetti interessanti nel settore in rapida evoluzione della Biologics.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Investigazione e gestione delle deviazioni, come Lead Investigator

• Analisi delle cause di radice (RCA) e implementazione CAPA per gli argomenti di progetto, e argomento di laboratorio generale.

• Allenamento e mentoring dei colleghi del QC junior.

• Controllo analitico e valutazione dei risultati.

• Scrittura tecnica e revisione dei documenti (metodo di prova, AP, protocolli, relazioni).

• La supervisione di qualità e la disponibilità di audit nei laboratori regolamentati da GMP (partecipazione agli audit per i progetti assegnati).

• Supporta l'ottimizzazione dei processi di laboratorio e dei flussi di lavoro

• Iniziative di miglioramento continuo (Lean, 5S, Six Sigma, ecc.)

• Attuazione, ottimizzazione, trasferimento e convalida dei metodi analitici, con focus su HPLC, CE e icIEF.

• Responsabilità per tutti i compiti e la rappresentanza del team HPLC nel team di progetto per i progetti assegnati.

• Elaborazione di indagini, modifiche richieste e deviazioni in cGMP.

• Estrazione e valutazione dei dati analitici, preparazione di report e presentazioni.

• Preparazione, revisione e approvazione dei documenti per garantire il rispetto degli orientamenti normativi.

• Competenza in questioni analitiche e tecniche per i progetti assegnati.

Requisiti chiave:

• Master o dottorato in chimica, biochimica, biologia o campo correlato.

• Minimo 5-10 anni di comprovata esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica.

• Buona comprensione di GMP richiesto.

• Esperienza con HPLC, CE o icIEF desiderabile.

• Esperienza ideale con sistemi IT come LIMS e CDS.

• Proficiente in inglese, il tedesco è un plus.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto significativo come i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a Scientist to join our QC HPLC Mammalian and mRNA team in Visp. Become part of our energetic and growing international team and take the opportunity to work on interesting projects in the rapidly developing field of Biologics.

Key responsibilities:

• Investigation and management of deviations, as Lead Investigator

• Root cause analysis (RCA) and CAPA implementation for project topics, and general lab topic.

• Coaching and mentoring of junior QC colleagues.

• QC analytical review and evaluation of results.

• Technical writing and document review (test methods, APs, protocols, reports).

• Quality oversight and audit readiness in GMP-regulated labs (participation in audits for assigned projects).

• Support optimization of laboratory processes and workflows

• Continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, 5S, Six Sigma, etc.)

• Implementation, optimization, transfer and validation of analytical methods, with focus on HPLC, CE and icIEF.

• Responsibility for all HPLC project related tasks and representation of HPLC team in the project team for the assigned projects.

• Processing of investigations, change requests and deviations under cGMP.

• Extraction and evaluation of analytical data, preparation of reports and presentations.

• Preparation, review and approval of documents to ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines.

• Expertise in analytical and technical issues for the assigned projects.

Key requirements:

• Master or PhD in chemistry, biochemistry, biology or related field.

• Minimum 5-10 years of proven experience in pharma industry.

• Good understanding of GMP required.

• Experience with HPLC, CE or icIEF desirable.

• Ideally experience with IT systems like LIMS and CDS.

• Proficient in English, German is a plus.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as meaningful as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a significant difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine Zauberformel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung besteht darin, dass engagierte Menschen zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Wir suchen einen Wissenschaftler, der unserem QC HPLC Mammalian und mRNA Team in Visp beitritt. Werden Sie Teil unseres dynamischen und wachsenden internationalen Teams und nutzen Sie die Gelegenheit, an interessanten Projekten im sich schnell entwickelnden Bereich Biologics zu arbeiten.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Untersuchung und Management von Abweichungen, als Lead Investigator

• Root Cause Analysis (RCA) und CAPA-Implementierung für Projektthemen und allgemeines Laborthema.

• Coaching und Mentoring von Junior QC Kollegen.

• QC analytische Überprüfung und Auswertung der Ergebnisse.

• Technisches Schreiben und Dokumentenüberprüfung (Testmethoden, APs, Protokolle, Berichte).

• Qualitätskontrolle und Auditbereitschaft in GMP-regulierten Labors (Teilnahme an Audits für zugewiesene Projekte).

• Unterstützung der Optimierung von Laborprozessen und Workflows

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen (Lean, 5S, Six Sigma usw.)

• Implementierung, Optimierung, Transfer und Validierung von Analysemethoden mit Fokus auf HPLC, CE und icIEF.

• Verantwortung für alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit HPLC-Projekten und Vertretung des HPLC-Teams im Projektteam für die zugewiesenen Projekte.

• Bearbeitung von Untersuchungen, Änderungswünschen und Abweichungen unter cGMP.

• Extraktion und Auswertung von Analysedaten, Erstellung von Berichten und Präsentationen.

• Erstellung, Überprüfung und Genehmigung von Dokumenten, um die Einhaltung der regulatorischen Richtlinien sicherzustellen.

• Expertise in analytischen und technischen Fragen für die zugewiesenen Projekte.

Wichtigste Anforderungen:

• Master oder PhD in Chemie, Biochemie, Biologie oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Mindestens 5-10 Jahre nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Pharmaindustrie.

• Ein gutes Verständnis von GMP ist erforderlich.

• Erfahrungen mit HPLC, CE oder icIEF wünschenswert.

• Idealerweise Erfahrung mit IT-Systemen wie LIMS und CDS.

• Englischkenntnisse, Deutsch ist ein Plus.

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso sinnvoll wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem signifikanten Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre meilleure solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des personnes dévouées, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique qui se joindra à notre équipe de Mammali et d'ARNm du CQHP à Viège. Faites partie de notre équipe internationale dynamique et en pleine croissance et profitez de l'occasion pour travailler sur des projets intéressants dans le domaine en développement rapide des produits biologiques.

Principales responsabilités :

• Enquête et gestion des écarts, en tant que chercheur principal

• Analyse des causes profondes (ARC) et mise en oeuvre de l'ACAP pour les sujets de projet et les sujets généraux de laboratoire.

• Coaching et mentorat de collègues subalternes du QC.

• Examen analytique et évaluation des résultats.

• Rédaction technique et examen des documents (méthodes d'essai, AP, protocoles, rapports).

• Surveillance de la qualité et préparation à la vérification dans les laboratoires réglementés par les BPF (participation à la vérification des projets assignés).

• Soutenir l'optimisation des processus de laboratoire et des flux de travail

• Initiatives d'amélioration continue (Lean, 5S, Six Sigma, etc.)

• Mise en œuvre, optimisation, transfert et validation des méthodes d'analyse, l'accent étant mis sur la CLHP, le CE et l'icIEF.

• Responsabilité pour toutes les tâches liées au projet HPLC et représentation de l'équipe HPLC dans l'équipe de projet pour les projets assignés.

• Traitement des enquêtes, des demandes de changement et des écarts en vertu du PSGc.

• Extraction et évaluation des données analytiques, préparation des rapports et présentations.

• Préparation, examen et approbation de documents pour assurer la conformité aux lignes directrices réglementaires.

• Expertise en questions analytiques et techniques pour les projets assignés.

Principales exigences:

• Maîtrise ou doctorat en chimie, biochimie, biologie ou domaine connexe.

• Au moins 5 à 10 ans d'expérience prouvée dans l'industrie pharmaceutique.

• Une bonne compréhension des BPF est requise.

• Expérience avec HPLC, CE ou icIEF souhaitable.

• Expérience idéale avec des systèmes informatiques comme LIMS et CDS.

• Compétence en anglais, l'allemand est un plus.

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi significative que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès, sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence importante.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Werde Teil unseres Teams als Mitarbeiter - Administration Logistik.

Als Mitarbeiter Administration Logistik unterstützt du unsere Logistikleitung und Team Leads im administrativen Tagesgeschäft. Mit deinem Organisationstalent, deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise und deinem Blick fürs Detail sorgst du für reibungslose Abläufe, eine hohe Datenqualität und die professionelle Koordination administrativer Prozesse.

Was wir dir bieten

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben

• Unterstützung der Team Leads und der Logistikleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft inklusive Koordination, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung administrativer Aufgaben.

• Erstellung, Pflege und Qualitätssicherung von Dokumentationen, Reports, Präsentationen und Management-Unterlagen sowie Aufbereitung von Kennzahlen und Dashboards (z. B. Power BI).

• Durchführung von SAP-Kontrollen, Datenprüfungen und Bearbeitung logistischer Stammdaten in SAP EWM / WM zur Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität.

• Koordination administrativer Themen in den Bereichen Schulungen, Berechtigungen, Dokumentenmanagement, SOPs und Compliance.

• Unterstützung bei Audits, Inspektionen, Deviations, CAPAs und Change Controls durch Bereitstellung und Nachverfolgung relevanter Unterlagen und Massnahmen.

• Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen in administrativen Abläufen, Reporting-Strukturen und logistischen Schnittstellenprozessen.

Dein Profil

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische, logistische oder vergleichbare Ausbildung; zusätzliche Qualifikationen im administrativen, logistischen oder betriebswirtschaftlichen Bereich von Vorteil.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer anspruchsvollen administrativen Rolle, idealerweise in Logistik, Supply Chain oder einem regulierten Pharma-/Life-Science-Umfeld.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Führungskräften sowie in der selbstständigen Koordination und Priorisierung komplexer Aufgaben.

• Sehr gute SAP-Kenntnisse (idealerweise EWM, WM oder MM) sowie Erfahrung mit Datenpflege, Reporting und logistischen Systemen.

• Sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint; Kenntnisse in Power BI oder vergleichbaren Reporting-Tools von Vorteil.

• Erfahrung im Dokumentenmanagement sowie gutes Verständnis für GMP-, Qualitäts- und Compliance-Anforderungen.

• Strukturierte, zuverlässige und qualitätsbewusste Arbeitsweise mit hoher Organisations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit.

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Umfeld.

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben!

Se necessario, i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie saranno assistiti in movimento.

Diventa parte del nostro team come dipendente - Administration Logistics.

Come dipendente Amministrazione Logistica, supporti la nostra gestione logistica e il team conduce nel business amministrativo quotidiano. Con il vostro talento organizzativo, il vostro metodo di lavoro strutturato e la vostra attenzione ai dettagli, assicurate processi lisci, alta qualità dei dati e coordinamento professionale dei processi amministrativi.

Cosa ti offriamo

• Una cura Agile e la cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi benefici nelle aree di stile di vita, famiglia e tempo libero. L'elenco completo dei nostri servizi globali è disponibile anche su: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

I tuoi compiti

• Supporto di team conduce e gestione logistica nelle operazioni quotidiane, tra cui coordinamento, priorità e monitoraggio dei compiti amministrativi.

• Creazione, manutenzione e garanzia di qualità di documentazione, report, presentazioni e documenti di gestione, nonché preparazione di figure chiave e dashboard (ad esempio Power BI).

• Attuazione dei controlli SAP, dei controlli dei dati e del trattamento dei dati master logistici in SAP EWM / WM per garantire un'elevata qualità dei dati.

• Coordinamento degli argomenti amministrativi nei settori della formazione, autorizzazioni, gestione dei documenti, SOP e conformità.

• Supporto per audit, ispezioni, deviazioni, CAPAs e controlli di cambiamento fornendo e tracciando documentazione e azioni pertinenti.

• Identificazione e implementazione di miglioramenti nei processi amministrativi, strutture di reporting e processi di interfaccia logistica.

Il tuo profilo

• Formazione commerciale, logistica o simile; qualifiche aggiuntive nel settore amministrativo, logistico o commerciale.

• Diversi anni di esperienza in un ruolo amministrativo impegnativo, idealmente nella logistica, nella supply chain o in un ambiente regolamentato farmaceutico/life science.

• Esperienza nel sostenere i manager e nel coordinamento indipendente e la priorità di compiti complessi.

• Conoscenza SAP molto buona (di solito EWM, WM o MM) nonché esperienza con sistemi di manutenzione, reporting e logistica dei dati.

• Competenze di MS Office molto buone, specialmente Excel e PowerPoint; La conoscenza di Power BI o strumenti di report comparabili è vantaggiosa.

• Esperienza nella gestione dei documenti e una buona comprensione dei requisiti GMP, qualità e conformità.

• Metodi di lavoro strutturati, affidabili e di qualità-coscienti con un alto livello di capacità organizzative e comunicative.

• Ottima conoscenza della lingua tedesca e buona conoscenza dell'inglese per la cooperazione in un ambiente internazionale.

A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è esattamente ciò che vogliamo che tu condivida.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applica subito!

descriptionByLocale.en:
Where necessary, eligible candidates and their families will be assisted in moving.

Become part of our team as an employee - Administration Logistics.

As an employee Administration Logistics, you support our logistics management and team leads in day-to-day administrative business. With your organizational talent, your structured working method and your attention to detail, you ensure smooth processes, high data quality and professional coordination of administrative processes.

What we offer you

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Your tasks

• Support of team leads and logistics management in day-to-day operations, including coordination, prioritization and tracking of administrative tasks.

• Creation, maintenance and quality assurance of documentation, reports, presentations and management documents as well as preparation of key figures and dashboards (e.g. Power BI).

• Implementation of SAP controls, data checks and processing of logistical master data in SAP EWM / WM to ensure high data quality.

• Coordination of administrative topics in the areas of training, permissions, document management, SOPs and compliance.

• Support for audits, inspections, deviations, CAPAs and change controls by providing and tracking relevant documentation and actions.

• Identification and implementation of improvements in administrative processes, reporting structures and logistical interface processes.

Your profile

• Completed commercial, logistical or similar training; additional qualifications in the administrative, logistical or business sector.

• Several years of experience in a demanding administrative role, ideally in logistics, supply chain or a regulated pharmaceutical/life science environment.

• Experience in supporting managers as well as in the independent coordination and prioritization of complex tasks.

• Very good SAP knowledge (ideally EWM, WM or MM) as well as experience with data maintenance, reporting and logistics systems.

• Very good MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint; Knowledge of Power BI or comparable reporting tools is advantageous.

• Experience in document management and a good understanding of GMP, quality and compliance requirements.

• Structured, reliable and quality-conscious working methods with a high level of organizational and communication skills.

• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English for cooperation in an international environment.

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s exactly what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now!

jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The QA Infrastructure and Logistics group provides key QA oversight and support for the Switzerland-VISP site. This group supports the site utilities, warehousing, and movement of raw materials and products in and out of facilities.

This position will focus on implementing and managing robust cross-functional support of legacy and new facilities. You will be responsible for assuring Quality Assurance of Lonza’s sites and facilities, whilst ensuring shared utility systems and logistics areas are carried out by Lonza's standards, industry best practices, and the requirements of national and international regulatory agencies.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Provide QA support for Project and Operations internal customers in the following areas: GMP & Compliance, Cold-chain, supply chain, good warehousing practice, and Clean utilities.

• Provide Quality Assurance oversight to the site and facilities focusing on shared utility systems and logistics areas.

• Organize and lead Deviation Review Boards for Utilities & Logistics related deviations.

• Review and assess Change Requests and Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA).

• Review and approve standard operation procedures for shared utility systems and logistics.

• Review and assess GMP impact of utility and cold-chain alarms and incidents.

• Assist with operational readiness activities and assess their risks in the relevant areas.

• Support internal and external audits, and inspections and represent the Quality function at relevant meetings.

• Leads or supports local implementation of global Quality policies and standards in his/her area of responsibility.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences/ Biochemistry or Supply Chain/Logistics or related field.

• Relevant work experience in Quality Assurance and/or Production/Supply Chain/Logistics and/or Quality Control in pharmaceutical industries and cGMP-controlled environments.

• Knowledge of Swiss, EU, and US GMP regulations relevant to audit/inspections and compliance systems.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills (English required, German is an advantage).

• Ability to communicate quality and compliance requirements to varying levels and functions of the organization.

• Strong collaborative mindset and the ability to build relationships quickly.

• Strong organizational skills, and ability to balance multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Ability to solve problems, understand details and strategic picture, providing practical solutions.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.
