jobs.description:
MSAT Material Management & Single-Use Systems Expert

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
Join Lonza's MSAT team in Visp and play a critical role in shaping the future of biopharmaceutical manufacturing through innovative material management strategies and advanced single-use technologies. This role offers the opportunity to influence global manufacturing operations, improve supply chain resilience, and support the delivery of life-changing therapies to patients worldwide.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• The opportunity to work on cutting-edge biopharmaceutical manufacturing technologies.

• Exposure to global manufacturing networks and cross-functional collaboration.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• A comprehensive range of benefits tailored to Switzerland and your role.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: Employee Benefits | Lonza

What you will do:

• Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Raw Materials and Single-Use Systems within MSAT Microbial.

• Lead risk assessments and evaluate material impact on process performance, product quality, and supply continuity.

• Drive material-related investigations, deviations, CAPAs, and change controls in compliance with GMP requirements.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, QA, QC, Supply Chain, Engineering, Process Development, and external suppliers to resolve technical challenges.

• Support material lifecycle management, supplier management, and implementation of mitigation strategies to ensure manufacturing reliability.

• Provide technical leadership for material qualification, optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Drive standardization and harmonization of material management and single-use system practices in alignment with local and global teams, ensuring consistent application of best practices across the organization.

• Support regulatory inspections, customer audits, and GMP compliance activities.

What we are looking for:

• Master's degree or PhD in Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.

• Extensive experience in biopharmaceutical manufacturing, process support, material management, or related GMP-regulated environments.

• Strong expertise in Raw Materials, Single-Use Systems, supplier management, and lifecycle management.

• Profound understanding of GMP requirements, risk management methodologies, deviations, CAPAs, and change control processes.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving complex technical investigations.

• Ability to lead and influence cross-functional stakeholders without formal line authority, driving alignment, standardization, and execution of material management and single-use system initiatives.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with internal and external partners.

• Ability to balance scientific, operational, quality, and business requirements in decision making.

• Structured, solution-oriented, and proactive working style.

• Fluency in English; German is considered an advantage.

• Open-minded, collaborative, and passionate about driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
MSAT Gestione dei materiali e esperto di sistemi a singolo utilizzo

Ubicazione: Visp, Svizzera

La posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, in Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario.
Unisciti al team MSAT di Lonza a Visp e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione del futuro della produzione biofarmaceutica attraverso strategie di gestione dei materiali innovative e tecnologie di single-use avanzate. Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di influenzare le operazioni di produzione globali, migliorare la resilienza della supply chain e sostenere la consegna di terapie che cambiano la vita ai pazienti in tutto il mondo.

Questo ruolo si basa principalmente sul sito. Lavorare insieme in persona supporta una stretta collaborazione in tempo reale e la precisione tecnica necessaria per la fabbricazione di farmaci ai più elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza.

Cosa otterrai:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.

• L'opportunità di lavorare sulle tecnologie di produzione biofarmaceutica all'avanguardia.

• Esposizione a reti di produzione globali e collaborazione interfunzionale.

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.

• Una gamma completa di vantaggi su misura per la Svizzera e il tuo ruolo.

L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi globali si trova qui: Vantaggi del dipendente | Lonza

Cosa farai:

• Agire come soggetto esperto di materia (SME) per materie prime e sistemi mono-uso all'interno di MSAT Microbial.

• Analisi del rischio di piombo e valutazione dell'impatto materiale sulle prestazioni del processo, sulla qualità del prodotto e sulla continuità dell'offerta.

• Guidare indagini, deviazioni, CAPAs e modificare i controlli in conformità ai requisiti GMP.

• Collaborare interfunzionalmente con Manufacturing, QA, QC, Supply Chain, Engineering, Process Development e fornitori esterni per risolvere le sfide tecniche.

• Supporta la gestione del ciclo di vita materiale, la gestione dei fornitori e l'implementazione di strategie di mitigazione per garantire affidabilità di produzione.

• Fornire leadership tecnica per le iniziative di qualificazione, ottimizzazione e miglioramento continuo.

• Guidare la standardizzazione e l'armonizzazione delle pratiche di gestione dei materiali e del sistema di uso singolo in allineamento con i team locali e globali, garantendo un'applicazione coerente delle migliori pratiche in tutta l'organizzazione.

• Sostenere le ispezioni regolamentari, le verifiche dei clienti e le attività di conformità GMP.

Cosa stiamo cercando:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Biotecnologia, Biochimica, Ingegneria Chimica, Scienze della Vita, o una disciplina correlata.

• Ampia esperienza nella produzione biofarmaceutica, nel supporto di processo, nella gestione dei materiali o negli ambienti regolamentati GMP.

• Forte competenza in materia di materie prime, sistemi a singolo utilizzo, gestione dei fornitori e gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Compresa comprensione dei requisiti GMP, metodologie di gestione dei rischi, deviazioni, CAPAs e processi di controllo dei cambiamenti.

• Sperimenta i principali team interfunzionali e guida complesse indagini tecniche.

• Capacità di guidare e influenzare gli stakeholder interfunzionali senza autorità di linea formale, allineamento di guida, standardizzazione, e l'esecuzione delle iniziative di gestione dei materiali e di sistema di uso singolo.

• Forte capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder con partner interni ed esterni.

• Capacità di bilanciare i requisiti scientifici, operativi, di qualità e aziendali nel processo decisionale.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientato alla soluzione e proattivo.

• Fluenza in inglese; il tedesco è considerato un vantaggio.

• Open-minded, collaborativo e appassionato di guidare l'eccellenza operativa e il miglioramento continuo.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Umfassendes Verständnis der GMP-Anforderungen, Risikomanagementmethoden, Abweichungen, CAPAs und Änderungskontrollprozesse.

• Erleben Sie die Leitung funktionsübergreifender Teams und die Durchführung komplexer technischer Untersuchungen.

• Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder ohne formale Leitungsautorität zu führen und zu beeinflussen, Ausrichtung, Standardisierung und Durchführung von Materialmanagement- und Single-Use-Systeminitiativen voranzutreiben.

• Starke Stakeholder-Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit internen und externen Partnern.

• Fähigkeit, wissenschaftliche, betriebliche, Qualitäts- und Geschäftsanforderungen bei der Entscheidungsfindung auszugleichen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The place of work of this office is in Visp, Switzerland. Eligible applicants and their families will be assisted in moving if needed.

The site in Visp, Switzerland is growing continuously and for our Biologics organization we are currently looking for several bioprocess engineers/biotechnologists/chemists (m/f/d) for pharmaceutical production. In this role, you are responsible for handling production campaigns in the production plant for the production of bioconjugate PCP (Potent Compound Production).

This body requires a continuous presence on site. Personal collaboration enables close, timely cooperation and the technical precision required for the production of medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What we offer:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of advantages, depending on function and location

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Our full list of local benefits can be found below:

• Benefits in Visp

Their tasks:

• As a bioprocess engineer/biotechnologist/chemist (f/m/d), you are responsible for the correct implementation of production campaigns according to cGMP guidelines

• Review of the risk analysis and implementation of the resulting measures

• Ensuring batch execution, evaluating test results, fixing problems, troubleshooting manufacturing plants, as well as proposing solutions

• Complete documentation of processes and process know-how, as well as complete GMP documentation

• Preparation of campaign reports and participation in Annual Product Review’s

• Continuous improvement possibilities of the processes, plants and processes, in cooperation with various project teams such as R&D, MSAT to increase process efficiency and economic use of the plants

• Responsible for the training of employees in the assigned products (campaign training), as well as co-responsibility for the training of employees, in cross-project topics (quarterly training, special topics) and in daily operations

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor's / Master's degree (uni / FH) or doctorate - preferably in biotechnology, biochemistry, chemistry or the like.

• First professional experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnological or industrial production desirable

• Flowing knowledge of German and English

• Good GMP understanding

• Team and leadership skills, as well as very good communication skills

• Cross-functional, structured and focused way of working

• Talent for organization, proactivity and openness to new ideas and suggestions

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza and help shape the future of bioconjugation through digital innovation.  As a key partner to scientific teams, you will connect science, data, AI, and technology to accelerate development, improve decision-making, and deliver measurable business value across Advanced Synthesis.

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• Opportunities to shape the digital transformation of bioconjugation and development services.

• Flexible benefits and development opportunities dependent on role and location (Visp, Basel, or Oss). The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Drive digital innovation within bioconjugation by  identifying  opportunities where data, AI, and computational technologies can enhance scientific outcomes.

• Partner closely with scientists and business stakeholders to understand challenges and translate them into impactful digital solutions.

• Define digital use cases, success criteria, user stories, and high-level functional requirements.

• Lead cross-functional agile teams including subject matter experts, data scientists, data engineers, and IT partners.

• Manage solution delivery from concept to deployment, ensuring adoption, value realization, and stakeholder alignment.

• Monitor emerging scientific and digital trends and recommend future capabilities that strengthen R&D performance.

• Act as a thought leader and mentor, helping grow digital capabilities across the organization.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Chemistry, Bioconjugation, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Computational Sciences, or  a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Solid experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CDMO, CRO, or related scientific environments.

• Experience applying digital, data science, computational, or AI-driven approaches to research and development challenges.

• Proven ability to translate scientific needs into scalable digital products, capabilities, or solutions.

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Experience with digital transformation, scientific workflow digitalization, analytics, AI/ML, or innovation strategy is  advantageous.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Become part of our team as a Manufacturing Specialist 4-layer 80-100% (m/f/d) and actively support our microbial production campaigns with your expertise.
In this versatile role, you accompany fermentation and purification campaigns organizationally and technically, ensure a safe and efficient production process and work closely with different specialist areas.

What we offer you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits in the areas of lifestyle, family and leisure. The full list of our global services can also be found at: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Their tasks:

• Ensuring smooth processes through organisational and technical support of fermentation and purification campaigns – with a focus on quality, efficiency and safety

• Monitoring and controlling planned process steps during upstream (fermentation) and downstream phases

• Active participation in microbial production processes (e.g. fermentation, cell harvesting, purification) in compliance with the applicable cGMP guidelines – including troubleshooting, root cause analysis and continuous process optimization

• Contribute to risk assessments and implement defined safety and quality measures

• Professional support and knowledge transfer of operators on plants and standardized processes

• Ensuring, reviewing and continuous optimization of manufacturing regulations, SOPs and batch documentation

Your requirement profile:

• Completed degree (Bachelor/Master) in Biotechnology, Microbiology or Bio-/Chemical Engineering

• Experience in microbial production processes (especially fermentation and/or purification) is advantageous

• GMP knowledge is desirable – or the willingness to acquire it

• Readiness to work in the flexible 4-shift system

• Very good knowledge of German is required; English skills are beneficial

• Teamwork, communication strength and a structured, solution-oriented way of working – They actively contribute their ideas

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.

Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Engineering team in Visp as an EI&C MES Application Manager 80-100% (m/f/d) and drive the evolution of our MES landscape across its full lifecycle. In this role, you’ll shape digital manufacturing by leading MES projects, strengthening system standards, and ensuring GMP‑compliant, high‑impact system performance.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What you’ll do:

• Execute and lead MES projects across all lifecycle phases, including requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.

• Maintain, optimize, and further develop MES standards, ensuring consistency, compliance, and alignment with site and global guidelines.

• Ensure reliable operation, enhancement, and updating of MES systems, recognizing their direct impact on production processes and GMP‑compliant documentation.

• Collaborate closely with Operations, QA, Automation, and IT/OT teams to ensure seamless system integration and high system availability.

• Analyze and improve MES‑related workflows, identifying opportunities for digitalization, efficiency gains, and data integrity improvements.

• Coordinate and manage external partners and vendors involved in MES or OT‑related project and support activities.

• Ensure GMP‑compliant execution of all MES and OT activities, including documentation, change control, and validation readiness.

What we are looking for:

• Completed university degree in Computer Science, Industrial IT/OT, Automation Engineering, or a related field (Bachelor level or higher).

• Significant professional experience in IT/OT, MES, or automation‑related engineering roles within a regulated environment.

• Solid understanding of GMP requirements and experience working with validated production or automation systems.

• Responsibility for the MES lifecycle, including system operation, enhancements, release management, and interface coordination.

• Strong knowledge of OT networks, virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware), system architectures, and basic cybersecurity principles.

• Fluent German or English (minimum B2 level) for effective collaboration with local and global stakeholders.

• Structured, independent working style with strong communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Willingness to participate in on‑call duty (Pikettdienst) 2-3 times per year.

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Join Lonza and help shape the future of Advanced Synthesis through AI, machine learning, and data science. This strategic role combines scientific expertise, advanced analytics, and digital innovation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, and deliver business impact across the organization.

This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 20% of your time (one day per week).

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• The opportunity to shape and scale AI/ML and Data Science capabilities within a global organization.

• Leadership opportunities through mentoring, capability building, and strategic influence.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location (Visp, Basel, or Oss). The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead the application of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and data science solutions to address high-value scientific and operational challenges.

• Partner with R&D scientists and Advanced Synthesis stakeholders to translate complex business needs into scalable digital solutions.

• Design and implement predictive models, optimization tools, and decision-support systems that improve scientific outcomes and operational efficiency.

• Collaborate with data engineering, digital, and technical teams to deliver robust end-to-end solutions from concept through deployment.

• Drive innovation by evaluating and introducing emerging AI/ML methodologies, technologies, and best practices.

• Influence strategic priorities and establish scalable standards, frameworks, and ways of working across Data Science & Modelling initiatives.

• Mentor colleagues and contribute to the growth of digital capabilities and future team development.

What we are looking for:

• PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, AI/ML, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Bioconjugation, or a related scientific discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Solid industry experience in data science, AI/ML, computational sciences, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, or related fields within pharma, biotech, CDMO, or similar environments.

• Advanced expertise in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data science with a track record of delivering business impact.

• Strong programming skills in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.

• Experience developing end-to-end data science solutions from exploration and modelling through deployment and adoption.

• Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills with the ability to influence senior leaders.

• Experience in bioconjugation, MLOps, digital transformation, or scientific workflow optimization is highly desirable.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Cosa stiamo cercando:

• PhD in Scienza dei dati, Scienza informatica, AI/ML, Chimica, Ingegneria chimica, Bioconjugation, o una disciplina scientifica correlata, o esperienza equivalente.

• Solida esperienza nel settore della scienza dei dati, AI/ML, scienze computazionali, cheminformatica, bioinformatica o campi correlati all'interno di ambienti farmaceutici, biotecnologie, CDMO o simili.

• Competenze avanzate nell'apprendimento automatico, nell'intelligenza artificiale e nella scienza dei dati con un track record di fornitura di impatto aziendale.

• L'esperienza nella bioconjugation, MLOps, trasformazione digitale o ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro scientifico è altamente auspicabile.

Informazioni su Lonza

A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:

This strategic role combines scientific expertise, advanced analytics, and digital innovation to accelerate research, improve decision-making, and deliver business impact across the organization.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

titleByLocale.it: Executive Direttore, Quality Site Head Stein

jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for an Executive Director, Quality Site Head, Stein.

Role Purpose:

The Quality Site Head is a key member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading, developing, and continuously improving all quality-related activities across the site. As the organization expands its Drug Product (DP) manufacturing capabilities and scales operations, this role will provide strategic and operational quality leadership to ensure the highest standards of product quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and business performance.

The Quality Site Head will drive the site's quality culture, strengthen organizational capabilities, and ensure alignment with global quality strategies while supporting the successful growth of a world-class Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). The role will play a critical part in preparing the site for future expansion, regulatory inspections, customer audits, and increasing manufacturing complexity.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Leadership & Site Governance

• Serve as the senior quality leader for the site and a trusted advisor to the Site Head and leadership team.

• Define and execute the site's quality strategy in alignment with global quality objectives and business priorities.

• Lead all Quality functions, including Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Compliance, Validation, and Quality Systems.

• Foster a proactive quality culture that promotes accountability, continuous improvement, and patient-centric decision-making.

• Build and develop a high-performing quality organization capable of supporting significant site growth and increasing operational complexity.

Drug Product Quality Leadership

• Lead and strengthen all quality activities related to Drug Product manufacturing, packaging, testing, release, and lifecycle management.

• Ensure compliance with current GxP requirements, FDA, EMA, Swissmedic, and other applicable global regulatory standards.

• Provide expert guidance on quality aspects of aseptic processing, sterile manufacturing, biologics, and advanced Drug Product technologies, as applicable.

• Partner closely with Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Technical Services to ensure robust quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle.

• Spend time on the shopfloor in Gemba's acting as a coach.

Organizational Growth & Capability Development

• Develop the quality organization to support the site's growth from approximately 500 to 1,000 employees.

• Assess organizational capabilities and identify competency gaps across quality functions.

• Implement talent development, succession planning, coaching, and training programs to build future leadership capabilities.

• Attract, retain, and develop top-quality talent while fostering a culture of engagement, collaboration, and innovation.

• Work shoulder to shoulder with the site head championing quality culture.

Regulatory Compliance, Audits & Inspections

• Ensure inspection readiness at all times and maintain a robust quality management system.

• Lead and oversee regulatory inspections, customer audits, and corporate quality assessments.

• Act as the primary quality representative during interactions with regulatory authorities and key customers.

• Ensure timely and effective investigation, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across all quality processes and systems.

• Promote the use of modern quality methodologies and digital quality tools, including Six Sigma, Lean principles, FMEA, SPC, and advanced analytics.

• Ensure effective management of deviations, change controls, complaints, CAPAs, risk assessments, and product quality reviews.

• Establish and monitor meaningful quality performance indicators to drive operational excellence and business performance.

Risk Management & Decision Making

• Apply science- and risk-based approaches to quality oversight and decision-making.

• Anticipate and proactively mitigate quality and compliance risks associated with site growth, new technologies, and customer programs.

• Ensure effective escalation and resolution of critical quality issues while balancing patient safety, compliance, and business objectives.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong partnerships with customers, serving as a key quality representative for strategic client relationships.

• Collaborate closely with other site quality leaders and global quality teams to harmonize standards, processes, and best practices.

• Support business development activities, customer visits, due diligence assessments, and new product introductions.

• Represent the site within global quality networks and industry forums.

Industry & Regulatory Leadership

• Monitor emerging regulatory requirements, industry trends, and technological advancements impacting Drug Product manufacturing.

• Translate industry developments into practical quality strategies and operational improvements.

• Champion innovation and modernization initiatives that strengthen the site's competitive position within the CDMO market.

• Act as a visible leader internally and externally, representing Lonza at industry, regulatory, and community levels.

Key Requirements and Qualifications

• Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Quality Management, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced qualifications in quality, regulatory affairs, or business leadership are considered advantageous.

• Several years’ of progressive leadership experience within pharmaceutical quality organizations.

• Many years’ in a senior quality leadership role with direct responsibility for site-wide quality operations.

• Demonstrated expertise in Drug Product manufacturing within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CDMO environment.

• Proven track record of successfully leading regulatory inspections by FDA, EMA, Swissmedic, and other global health authorities.

• Experience supporting large-scale site expansions, organizational transformation, or significant operational growth is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of biologics, sterile manufacturing, aseptic processing, and modern pharmaceutical quality systems.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte.

Stiamo cercando un direttore esecutivo, responsabile del sito di qualità, Stein.

Scopo del ruolo:

Il Quality Site Head è un membro chiave del team di leadership del sito ed è responsabile di leader, sviluppo e miglioramento continuo di tutte le attività legate alla qualità in tutto il sito. Man mano che l'organizzazione amplia le proprie capacità di produzione e le sue operazioni di scala e di produzione di prodotti farmaceutici, questo ruolo fornirà leadership strategica e operativa di qualità per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità del prodotto, sicurezza del paziente, conformità normativa e prestazioni aziendali.

La Quality Site Head guiderà la cultura della qualità del sito, rafforzerà le capacità organizzative e garantirà l'allineamento con le strategie di qualità globali, supportando al contempo la crescita di un'Organizzazione mondiale per lo sviluppo e la produzione dei contratti (CDMO). Il ruolo svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella preparazione del sito per future espansioni, ispezioni normative, audit dei clienti e crescente complessità di produzione.

Responsabilità chiave:

Leadership della qualità & Governance del sito

• Servire come leader di qualità senior per il sito e un consulente affidabile per il team di Site Head e leadership.

• Definire ed eseguire la strategia di qualità del sito in linea con gli obiettivi di qualità globali e le priorità aziendali.

• Condurre tutte le funzioni di qualità, tra cui garanzia di qualità, controllo di qualità, conformità, convalida e sistemi di qualità.

• Promuovere una cultura di qualità proattiva che promuove la responsabilità, il miglioramento continuo e il processo decisionale paziente-centrico.

• Costruire e sviluppare un'organizzazione di alta qualità in grado di supportare una crescita significativa del sito e una maggiore complessità operativa.

Leadership della qualità del prodotto

• Guidare e rafforzare tutte le attività di qualità relative alla produzione, imballaggio, test, rilascio e gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti GxP attuali, FDA, EMA, Swissmedic e altri standard normativi globali applicabili.

• Fornire una guida esperta sugli aspetti di qualità della lavorazione asettica, della produzione sterile, della biologia e delle tecnologie avanzate del prodotto della droga, come applicabile.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain e Servizi Tecnici per garantire una robusta supervisione della qualità durante il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

• Trascorrete il tempo sul pavimento del negozio a Gemba che si comporta da allenatore.

Sviluppo organizzativo della crescita e della capacità

• Sviluppare l'organizzazione di qualità per sostenere la crescita del sito da circa 500 a 1.000 dipendenti.

• Valutare le capacità organizzative e identificare le lacune di competenze tra le funzioni di qualità.

• Attuazione dello sviluppo del talento, pianificazione della successione, coaching e programmi di formazione per costruire le capacità di leadership future.

• Attrarre, conservare e sviluppare talenti di alta qualità, promuovendo una cultura di impegno, collaborazione e innovazione.

• Lavoro spalla a spalla con la testa del sito che sostiene la cultura di qualità.

Compliance regolamentare, Audits & Ispezioni

• Assicurare la disponibilità di ispezione in ogni momento e mantenere un sistema di gestione della qualità robusto.

• Guida e supervisiona le ispezioni normative, le verifiche dei clienti e le valutazioni di qualità aziendale.

• Agire come rappresentante di qualità primaria durante le interazioni con le autorità di regolamentazione e i clienti chiave.

• Assicurare un'indagine tempestiva ed efficace, l'analisi delle cause radice e l'attuazione di azioni correttive e preventive (CAPA).

Sistemi di qualità e miglioramento continuo

• Promuovere iniziative di miglioramento continuo in tutti i processi e sistemi di qualità.

• Promuovere l'uso di metodologie di qualità moderne e strumenti di qualità digitale, tra cui Six Sigma, principi Lean, FMEA, SPC e analisi avanzate.

• Assicurare una gestione efficace di deviazioni, controlli di cambiamento, reclami, CAPAs, valutazioni di rischio e recensioni di qualità del prodotto.

• Stabilire e monitorare indicatori di qualità significativi per guidare l'eccellenza operativa e le prestazioni aziendali.

Gestione del rischio e decisione

• Applicare approcci basati sulla scienza e sul rischio alla supervisione della qualità e al processo decisionale.

• Anticipare e mitigare proattivamente i rischi di qualità e conformità associati alla crescita del sito, alle nuove tecnologie e ai programmi del cliente.

• Assicurare un'escalation efficace e una risoluzione di problemi di qualità critici, mentre bilanciare la sicurezza del paziente, la conformità e gli obiettivi aziendali.

Cliente & Stakeholder Impegno

• Costruire partnership forti con i clienti, servendo come rappresentante di qualità chiave per le relazioni strategiche dei clienti.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con altri leader di qualità del sito e team di qualità globale per armonizzare standard, processi e best practice.

• Sostenere le attività di sviluppo aziendale, le visite dei clienti, le valutazioni di due diligence e le nuove introduzioni dei prodotti.

• Rappresentare il sito all'interno di reti di qualità globali e forum del settore.

Leadership industriale e regolamentare

• Monitorare i requisiti normativi emergenti, le tendenze del settore e i progressi tecnologici che influiscono sulla produzione di prodotti farmaceutici.

• Tradurre gli sviluppi del settore in pratiche strategie di qualità e miglioramenti operativi.

• Campione di innovazione e modernizzazione iniziative che rafforzano la posizione competitiva del sito all'interno del mercato CDMO.

• Agire come leader visibile internamente ed esternamente, rappresentando Lonza a livello industriale, normativo e comunitario.

Requisiti chiave e qualifiche

• Laurea magistrale in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Gestione della Qualità, Scienze della Vita, Ingegneria, o una disciplina relativa. Le qualifiche avanzate in qualità, affari normativi o leadership aziendale sono considerate vantaggiose.

• Diversi anni di esperienza progressiva di leadership all'interno di organizzazioni di qualità farmaceutica.

• Molti anni in un ruolo di leadership di qualità superiore con responsabilità diretta per le operazioni di qualità su scala del sito.

• Competenze dimostrate nella produzione di prodotti farmaceutici, biotecnologici o CDMO.

• Provato il record di controllo delle normative con successo da FDA, EMA, Swissmedic e altre autorità sanitarie globali.

• L'esperienza che supporta espansioni di siti su larga scala, la trasformazione organizzativa, o la crescita operativa significativa è altamente auspicabile.

• Forte comprensione di biologici, produzione sterile, elaborazione asettica e moderni sistemi di qualità farmaceutica.

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for an Executive Director, Quality Site Head, Stein.

Role Purpose:

The Quality Site Head is a key member of the site leadership team and is responsible for leading, developing, and continuously improving all quality-related activities across the site. As the organization expands its Drug Product (DP) manufacturing capabilities and scales operations, this role will provide strategic and operational quality leadership to ensure the highest standards of product quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, and business performance.

The Quality Site Head will drive the site's quality culture, strengthen organizational capabilities, and ensure alignment with global quality strategies while supporting the successful growth of a world-class Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO). The role will play a critical part in preparing the site for future expansion, regulatory inspections, customer audits, and increasing manufacturing complexity.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Leadership & Site Governance

• Serve as the senior quality leader for the site and a trusted advisor to the Site Head and leadership team.

• Define and execute the site's quality strategy in alignment with global quality objectives and business priorities.

• Lead all Quality functions, including Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Compliance, Validation, and Quality Systems.

• Foster a proactive quality culture that promotes accountability, continuous improvement, and patient-centric decision-making.

• Build and develop a high-performing quality organization capable of supporting significant site growth and increasing operational complexity.

Drug Product Quality Leadership

• Lead and strengthen all quality activities related to Drug Product manufacturing, packaging, testing, release, and lifecycle management.

• Ensure compliance with current GxP requirements, FDA, EMA, Swissmedic, and other applicable global regulatory standards.

• Provide expert guidance on quality aspects of aseptic processing, sterile manufacturing, biologics, and advanced Drug Product technologies, as applicable.

• Partner closely with Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Technical Services to ensure robust quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle.

• Spend time on the shopfloor in Gemba's acting as a coach.

Organizational Growth & Capability Development

• Develop the quality organization to support the site's growth from approximately 500 to 1,000 employees.

• Assess organizational capabilities and identify competency gaps across quality functions.

• Implement talent development, succession planning, coaching, and training programs to build future leadership capabilities.

• Attract, retain, and develop top-quality talent while fostering a culture of engagement, collaboration, and innovation.

• Work shoulder to shoulder with the site head championing quality culture.

Regulatory Compliance, Audits & Inspections

• Ensure inspection readiness at all times and maintain a robust quality management system.

• Lead and oversee regulatory inspections, customer audits, and corporate quality assessments.

• Act as the primary quality representative during interactions with regulatory authorities and key customers.

• Ensure timely and effective investigation, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

Quality Systems & Continuous Improvement

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across all quality processes and systems.

• Promote the use of modern quality methodologies and digital quality tools, including Six Sigma, Lean principles, FMEA, SPC, and advanced analytics.

• Ensure effective management of deviations, change controls, complaints, CAPAs, risk assessments, and product quality reviews.

• Establish and monitor meaningful quality performance indicators to drive operational excellence and business performance.

Risk Management & Decision Making

• Apply science- and risk-based approaches to quality oversight and decision-making.

• Anticipate and proactively mitigate quality and compliance risks associated with site growth, new technologies, and customer programs.

• Ensure effective escalation and resolution of critical quality issues while balancing patient safety, compliance, and business objectives.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

• Build strong partnerships with customers, serving as a key quality representative for strategic client relationships.

• Collaborate closely with other site quality leaders and global quality teams to harmonize standards, processes, and best practices.

• Support business development activities, customer visits, due diligence assessments, and new product introductions.

• Represent the site within global quality networks and industry forums.

Industry & Regulatory Leadership

• Monitor emerging regulatory requirements, industry trends, and technological advancements impacting Drug Product manufacturing.

• Translate industry developments into practical quality strategies and operational improvements.

• Champion innovation and modernization initiatives that strengthen the site's competitive position within the CDMO market.

• Act as a visible leader internally and externally, representing Lonza at industry, regulatory, and community levels.

Key Requirements and Qualifications

• Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Quality Management, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced qualifications in quality, regulatory affairs, or business leadership are considered advantageous.

• Several years’ of progressive leadership experience within pharmaceutical quality organizations.

• Many years’ in a senior quality leadership role with direct responsibility for site-wide quality operations.

• Demonstrated expertise in Drug Product manufacturing within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CDMO environment.

• Proven track record of successfully leading regulatory inspections by FDA, EMA, Swissmedic, and other global health authorities.

• Experience supporting large-scale site expansions, organizational transformation, or significant operational growth is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of biologics, sterile manufacturing, aseptic processing, and modern pharmaceutical quality systems.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.

People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf fünf Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Wir suchen einen Executive Director, Quality Site Head, Stein.

Zweck:

Der Quality Site Head ist ein wichtiges Mitglied des Site-Führungsteams und verantwortlich für die Leitung, Entwicklung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung aller qualitätsbezogenen Aktivitäten auf der gesamten Site. Da das Unternehmen seine Produktionskapazitäten für Arzneimittel (DP) erweitert und den Betrieb skaliert, wird diese Rolle eine strategische und operative Qualitätsführerschaft darstellen, um die höchsten Standards für Produktqualität, Patientensicherheit, Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften und Geschäftsleistung zu gewährleisten.

Der Quality Site Head wird die Qualitätskultur des Standorts vorantreiben, die organisatorischen Fähigkeiten stärken und die Ausrichtung auf globale Qualitätsstrategien sicherstellen und gleichzeitig das erfolgreiche Wachstum einer erstklassigen Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) unterstützen. Die Rolle wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Vorbereitung des Standorts auf zukünftige Erweiterungen, behördliche Inspektionen, Kundenaudits und die zunehmende Komplexität der Fertigung spielen.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

Qualitätsführerschaft und Site Governance

• Dienen Sie als Senior Quality Leader für die Website und als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für den Site Head und das Führungsteam.

• Definieren und implementieren Sie die Qualitätsstrategie der Website in Übereinstimmung mit globalen Qualitätszielen und Geschäftsprioritäten.

• Führen Sie alle Qualitätsfunktionen, einschließlich Qualitätssicherung, Qualitätskontrolle, Compliance, Validierung und Qualitätssysteme.

• Förderung einer proaktiven Qualitätskultur, die Rechenschaftspflicht, kontinuierliche Verbesserung und patientenzentrierte Entscheidungsfindung fördert.

• Aufbau und Entwicklung einer leistungsstarken Qualitätsorganisation, die in der Lage ist, ein signifikantes Standortwachstum und eine steigende betriebliche Komplexität zu unterstützen.

Drug Product Quality Leadership

• Führen und stärken Sie alle Qualitätsaktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Arzneimittelherstellung, Verpackung, Prüfung, Freisetzung und Lebenszyklusmanagement.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der aktuellen GxP-Anforderungen, FDA, EMA, Swissmedic und anderer geltender globaler Regulierungsstandards.

• Geben Sie eine fachkundige Anleitung zu Qualitätsaspekten der aseptischen Verarbeitung, der sterilen Herstellung, der Biologika und der fortschrittlichen Arzneimittelprodukttechnologien, soweit anwendbar.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain und Technical Services, um eine robuste Qualitätskontrolle während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus zu gewährleisten.

• Verbringen Sie Zeit auf dem Shopfloor in Gemba als Trainer handeln.

Organisationswachstum & Capability Development

• Entwicklung der Qualitätsorganisation, um das Wachstum des Standortes von etwa 500 auf 1.000 Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen.

• Bewerten Sie die organisatorischen Fähigkeiten und identifizieren Sie Kompetenzlücken zwischen den Qualitätsfunktionen.

• Implementieren Sie Talententwicklung, Nachfolgeplanung, Coaching und Trainingsprogramme, um zukünftige Führungsfähigkeiten aufzubauen.

• Gewinnen, halten und entwickeln Sie erstklassige Talente und fördern Sie eine Kultur des Engagements, der Zusammenarbeit und der Innovation.

• Arbeiten Sie Schulter an Schulter mit dem Leiter der Website, der sich für Qualitätskultur einsetzt.

Regulatory Compliance, Audits & Inspektionen

• Gewährleistung der jederzeitigen Inspektionsbereitschaft und Aufrechterhaltung eines robusten Qualitätsmanagementsystems.

• Leiten und beaufsichtigen Sie regulatorische Inspektionen, Kundenaudits und Qualitätsbewertungen von Unternehmen.

• Handeln Sie als primärer Qualitätsvertreter bei Interaktionen mit Regulierungsbehörden und Schlüsselkunden.

• Gewährleistung einer rechtzeitigen und wirksamen Untersuchung, Ursachenanalyse und Durchführung von Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen (CAPAs).

Qualitätssysteme & Kontinuierliche Verbesserung

• Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsinitiativen in allen Qualitätsprozessen und -systemen.

• Förderung des Einsatzes moderner Qualitätsmethoden und digitaler Qualitätstools, einschließlich Six Sigma, Lean-Prinzipien, FMEA, SPC und Advanced Analytics.

• Gewährleistung eines wirksamen Managements von Abweichungen, Änderungskontrollen, Beschwerden, CAPAs, Risikobewertungen und Produktqualitätsprüfungen.

• Etablieren und überwachen Sie aussagekräftige Qualitätskennzahlen, um operative Exzellenz und Geschäftsleistung zu fördern.

Risikomanagement und Entscheidungsfindung

• Anwendung wissenschafts- und risikobasierter Ansätze zur Qualitätsaufsicht und Entscheidungsfindung.

• Antizipieren und proaktiv mindern Sie Qualitäts- und Compliance-Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Standortwachstum, neuen Technologien und Kundenprogrammen.

• Gewährleistung einer wirksamen Eskalation und Lösung kritischer Qualitätsprobleme bei gleichzeitiger Abwägung von Patientensicherheit, Compliance und Geschäftszielen.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

• Bauen Sie starke Partnerschaften mit Kunden auf und dienen Sie als wichtiger Qualitätsvertreter für strategische Kundenbeziehungen.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen Qualitätsführern und globalen Qualitätsteams zusammen, um Standards, Prozesse und Best Practices zu harmonisieren.

• Unterstützung von Geschäftsentwicklungsaktivitäten, Kundenbesuchen, Due-Diligence-Bewertungen und Einführungen neuer Produkte.

• Repräsentieren Sie die Website in globalen Qualitätsnetzwerken und Branchenforen.

Branchen- und Regulierungsführerschaft

• Überwachen Sie aufkommende regulatorische Anforderungen, Branchentrends und technologische Fortschritte, die sich auf die Herstellung von Arzneimitteln auswirken.

• Übersetzen Sie Branchenentwicklungen in praktische Qualitätsstrategien und operative Verbesserungen.

• Champion Innovations- und Modernisierungsinitiativen, die die Wettbewerbsposition der Website auf dem CDMO-Markt stärken.

• Handeln Sie intern und extern als sichtbare Führungskraft und vertreten Sie Lonza auf Branchen-, Regulierungs- und Gemeindeebene.

Wichtige Anforderungen und Qualifikationen

• Master-Abschluss in Pharmazeutischen Wissenschaften, Qualitätsmanagement, Life Sciences, Engineering oder einer verwandten Disziplin. Fortgeschrittene Qualifikationen in Qualität, regulatorischen Angelegenheiten oder Unternehmensführung gelten als vorteilhaft.

• Mehrjährige fortschrittliche Führungserfahrung in pharmazeutischen Qualitätsorganisationen.

• Viele Jahre in einer leitenden Qualitätsführungsrolle mit direkter Verantwortung für standortweite Qualitätsoperationen.

• Demonstrierte Expertise in der Herstellung von Arzneimitteln in einer pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen oder CDMO-Umgebung.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei erfolgreich führenden regulatorischen Inspektionen durch FDA, EMA, Swissmedic und andere globale Gesundheitsbehörden.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung groß angelegter Standorterweiterungen, organisatorischer Transformationen oder eines signifikanten operativen Wachstums ist sehr wünschenswert.

• Starkes Verständnis von Biologika, steriler Herstellung, aseptischer Verarbeitung und modernen pharmazeutischen Qualitätssystemen.

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.

Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur cinq continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un directeur exécutif, responsable du site qualité, Stein.

Rôle But :

Le responsable du site Qualité est un membre clé de l'équipe de direction du site et est chargé de diriger, de développer et d'améliorer continuellement toutes les activités liées à la qualité dans l'ensemble du site. À mesure que l'organisation étendra ses capacités de fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques (PD) et qu'elle évaluera ses activités, ce rôle assurera un leadership stratégique et opérationnel de qualité afin d'assurer les normes les plus élevées en matière de qualité des produits, de sécurité des patients, de conformité réglementaire et de rendement opérationnel.

Le responsable du site de la qualité dirigera la culture de la qualité du site, renforcera les capacités organisationnelles et assurera l'harmonisation avec les stratégies de qualité mondiales tout en appuyant la croissance réussie d'une organisation de développement et de fabrication de classe mondiale. Le rôle jouera un rôle crucial dans la préparation du site en vue d'une expansion future, des inspections réglementaires, des vérifications des clients et une complexité accrue de la fabrication.

Principales responsabilités :

Leadership de qualité et gouvernance du site

• Servir de chef principal de la qualité du site et de conseiller de confiance auprès du chef de site et de l'équipe de direction.

• Définir et exécuter la stratégie de qualité du site en fonction des objectifs de qualité globaux et des priorités opérationnelles.

• Diriger toutes les fonctions de qualité, y compris l'assurance de la qualité, le contrôle de la qualité, la conformité, la validation et les systèmes de qualité.

• Favoriser une culture de qualité proactive qui favorise la responsabilisation, l'amélioration continue et la prise de décisions centrées sur le patient.

• Créer et développer une organisation de qualité hautement performante capable de soutenir la croissance importante du site et la complexité opérationnelle croissante.

Leadership en matière de qualité des produits pharmaceutiques

• Diriger et renforcer toutes les activités de qualité liées à la fabrication, à l'emballage, aux essais, aux rejets et à la gestion du cycle de vie des produits pharmaceutiques.

• Assurer la conformité avec les exigences actuelles du GxP, la FDA, l'EMA, Swissmedic et les autres normes réglementaires mondiales applicables.

• Fournir des conseils d'experts sur les aspects qualitatifs du traitement aseptique, de la fabrication stérile, des produits biologiques et des technologies avancées des produits pharmaceutiques, selon le cas.

• Collaborez étroitement avec Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain et Technical Services afin d'assurer une surveillance de qualité robuste tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.

• Passez du temps sur l'atelier de Gemba comme entraîneur.

Croissance organisationnelle et développement des capacités

• Développer l'organisation de qualité pour soutenir la croissance du site, qui passe d'environ 500 à 1 000 employés.

• Évaluer les capacités organisationnelles et cerner les lacunes en matière de compétences entre les fonctions de qualité.

• Mettre en oeuvre des programmes de perfectionnement des talents, de planification de la relève, d'encadrement et de formation pour renforcer les capacités de leadership futures.

• Attirer, retenir et développer des talents de qualité tout en favorisant une culture d'engagement, de collaboration et d'innovation.

• Travailler épaule à épaule avec la tête du site champion de culture de qualité.

Conformité réglementaire, vérifications et inspections

• Assurer la préparation à l'inspection en tout temps et maintenir un solide système de gestion de la qualité.

• Diriger et superviser les inspections réglementaires, les vérifications des clients et les évaluations de la qualité de l'entreprise.

• Agir en tant que principal représentant de la qualité lors des interactions avec les autorités réglementaires et les principaux clients.

• Veiller à ce que les enquêtes, l'analyse des causes profondes et la mise en oeuvre des mesures correctives et préventives soient menées en temps opportun et efficacement.

Systèmes de qualité et amélioration continue

• Mener des initiatives d'amélioration continue dans tous les processus et systèmes de qualité.

• Promouvoir l'utilisation de méthodologies de qualité modernes et d'outils de qualité numérique, y compris Six Sigma, principes Lean, FMEA, SPC, et l'analyse avancée.

• Assurer une gestion efficace des écarts, des contrôles du changement, des plaintes, des APC, des évaluations des risques et des examens de la qualité des produits.

• Établir et surveiller des indicateurs de rendement de qualité significatifs pour stimuler l'excellence opérationnelle et le rendement opérationnel.

Gestion des risques et prise de décisions

• Appliquer des approches fondées sur la science et le risque à la surveillance de la qualité et à la prise de décisions.

• Anticiper et atténuer proactivement les risques de qualité et de conformité associés à la croissance du site, aux nouvelles technologies et aux programmes à la clientèle.

• Assurer une escalade et une résolution efficaces des problèmes de qualité critiques tout en conciliant la sécurité des patients, la conformité et les objectifs opérationnels.

Engagement des clients et des intervenants

• Établir des partenariats solides avec les clients, en servant de représentant de qualité clé pour les relations stratégiques avec les clients.

• Collaborer étroitement avec d'autres responsables de la qualité des sites et des équipes de la qualité mondiale pour harmoniser les normes, les processus et les pratiques exemplaires.

• Appuyer les activités de développement des entreprises, les visites des clients, les évaluations de diligence raisonnable et les introductions de nouveaux produits.

• Représenter le site dans les réseaux mondiaux de qualité et les forums industriels.

Leadership de l'industrie et de la réglementation

• Surveiller les nouvelles exigences réglementaires, les tendances de l'industrie et les progrès technologiques qui influent sur la fabrication des produits pharmaceutiques.

• Traduire les développements de l'industrie en stratégies pratiques de qualité et en améliorations opérationnelles.

• Combattre les initiatives d'innovation et de modernisation qui renforcent la position concurrentielle du site sur le marché des CDMO.

• Agir en tant que leader visible à l'interne et à l'externe, représentant Lonza au niveau de l'industrie, de la réglementation et de la collectivité.

Principales exigences et qualités

• Maîtrise en sciences pharmaceutiques, gestion de la qualité, sciences de la vie, génie ou discipline connexe. Les qualifications avancées en matière de qualité, de réglementation ou de leadership commercial sont considérées comme avantageuses.

• Plusieurs années d'expérience de leadership progressif au sein des organisations de qualité pharmaceutique.

• Plusieurs années dans un rôle de leadership de haute qualité avec responsabilité directe pour les opérations de qualité à l'échelle du site.

• Expertise démontrée dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques dans un environnement pharmaceutique, biotechnologiques ou CDMO.

• La FDA, l'EMA, Swissmedic et d'autres autorités sanitaires mondiales ont fait preuve de succès dans leurs inspections réglementaires.

• Il est hautement souhaitable d'acquérir de l'expérience pour appuyer l'expansion à grande échelle des sites, la transformation organisationnelle ou la croissance opérationnelle importante.

• Une bonne compréhension des produits biologiques, de la fabrication stérile, du traitement aseptique et des systèmes modernes de qualité pharmaceutique.

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.

Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.title: Internship IBEX MSAT 80-100% (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Our unique biological manufacturing and development concept in Visp, Switzerland, offers a complete product lifecycle of a biopharmaceutical – from preclinical to commercial stages, from drug substance to drug product, all in one location. The three offerings Ibex™ Design, Ibex™ Develop, and Ibex™ Dedicate have been developed as a response to a dynamic market and evolving needs. The environment is constantly changing and the spirit is truly comparable to a start-up organization with high energy, and where we all learn from each other, and have fun at the same time.

We have an opening for students who would like to do an internship in the pharmaceutical industry. Become part of this exciting opportunity and join our team by applying for (this) internship.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

As a CSV Engineer (m/f/d) you will be responsible for the generation and execution of the validation of the computerized systems on process engineering equipment and facilities, including MES. You are responsible to follow the planning and implementation of CSV activities resulting from projects and plant adaptations during the system life cycle of the plants, as well as make a contribution to the ongoing optimization of processes, facilities and internal procedures.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

What you will do:

• Prepare commissioning and validation documents for new systems, and supervise conversion, expansion, and new construction projects. This includes CSV activities for critical systems in new construction projects and SLC support for all systems post debut.

• Supervise deviations, changes (GEP and GMP), and CAPAs, ensuring strict adherence to protocols.

• Coordinate CSV executions with internal groups, as well as external service providers and suppliers, to strictly ensure seamless integration.

• Present CSV documents during audits and inspections, showcasing our world-class standards.

• Schedule and report CSV activities, maintaining a flawless record of progress and outcomes.

• Align CSV strategy with QA CSV for all Biologics scope, showcasing our dedication to high standards.

• Contribute to the review and continuous amelioration of all CSV documents, ensuring ongoing optimization and success.

What we are looking for:

• Bachelor / Master / Diploma from a technical school (HF) / university of applied sciences (FH) or university in a technical field or equivalent experience, showcasing your solid educational foundation.

• Significant experience in a regulated environment with regard to Computerized System Validation (CSV), demonstrating your proven expertise.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and Delta-V, essential for your successful implementation of tasks.

• Knowledge of KNEAT, COMOS (plant engineering software solution), DMS, TrackWise, and SAP is an advantage, improving your ability to compete in our ambitious environment.

• Proficient in English, with German language skills being advantageous, enabling you to collaborate effectively in our diverse team.

• Préparer des documents de mise en service et de validation pour les nouveaux systèmes et superviser les projets de conversion, d'expansion et de construction. Cela inclut les activités du CSV pour les systèmes critiques dans les nouveaux projets de construction et le soutien SLC pour tous les systèmes après les débuts.

• Superviser les déviations, les changements (GEP et GMP) et les APC, en veillant au strict respect des protocoles.

• Coordonner les exécutions du CSV avec les groupes internes, ainsi qu'avec les fournisseurs et fournisseurs de services externes, afin d'assurer strictement une intégration transparente.

• Présentez les documents du CSV lors des vérifications et des inspections, en mettant en valeur nos normes de calibre mondial.

• Planifier et rapporter les activités du CSV, en tenant un registre impeccable des progrès et des résultats.

• Aligner la stratégie CSV avec le CSV de l'AQ pour tous les produits biologiques, en montrant notre dévouement à des normes élevées.

• Contribuer à l'examen et à l'amélioration continue de tous les documents du CSV, en assurant l'optimisation continue et le succès.

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Baccalauréat / Master / Diplôme d'une école technique (HF) / université des sciences appliquées (FH) ou université dans un domaine technique ou une expérience équivalente, mettant en valeur votre solide fondation éducative.

• Expérience significative dans un environnement réglementé en ce qui concerne la validation des systèmes informatisés (CSV), démontrant votre expertise éprouvée.

• Bonne connaissance de Microsoft Office et Delta-V, essentielle à votre mise en œuvre réussie des tâches.

• Connaissance de KNEAT, COMOS (solution logicielle d'ingénierie végétale), DMS, TrackWise et SAP est un avantage, améliorant votre capacité à rivaliser dans notre environnement ambitieux.

• Compétence en anglais, avec des compétences linguistiques en allemand étant avantageuses, vous permettant de collaborer efficacement dans notre équipe diversifiée.

À propos de Lonza :

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Répartis sur plus de 30 sites et cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité façonnent ce que nous accomplissons et comment nous le faisons. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. À Lonza, nous offrons des possibilités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats qualifiés indépendamment de la race, de la religion, de la couleur, de l'origine nationale, du sexe, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'identité de genre, de l'âge, du handicap, du statut de vétéran ou de toute autre caractéristique protégée par la loi. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.
