jobs.title: E2E Process Engineer
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. The full list of our local tailored benefits can also be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

As an E2E Process Engineer, you will support strategic capital projects across the ADS Platform, collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop and implement engineering and operational solutions that ensure successful project delivery and operational readiness.

What you will do:

• Support delivery of strategic capital investment programs across the ADS Platform.

• Develop project charters, business requirements, scopes, and execution strategies.

• Coordinate cross-functional teams to integrate project deliverables effectively.

• Maintain project schedules, governance frameworks, and progress reporting.

• Prepare business cases, funding approvals, and portfolio decision materials.

• Lead technical evaluations, process engineering activities, and operational readiness initiatives.

• Support risk, change, cost, schedule, and stakeholder management to ensure successful project delivery.

What we are looking for:

• Master’s degree in Chemical, Process, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a related field.

• Fluent in English and German.

• Experience in pharmaceutical, chemical, or other GMP-regulated manufacturing environments.

• Strong knowledge of process engineering, facility design, GMP operations, and capital project execution.

• Understanding of the full project lifecycle, from design through start-up and operational readiness.

• Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.

• Proactive problem-solver with the ability to translate strategic objectives into practical engineering solutions.

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist QC, Biochemistry 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

For our site, surrounded by the Swiss Alps, in the beautiful town of Visp, we are looking for Senior Scientist (f/m/d)  Quality Control for our Biochemistry Team. In this role, you will validate new analytical Methods and coordinate the routine Quality Control Analytics according to GMP with the Lab Technicians. The analytical techniques we use are various types of ELISA, qPCR and Biacore. Are you looking for a job where you truly have an impact in the world and help patients? Then apply today!

What you will get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

What you will do:

• Validation of new analytical Biochemistry methods (ELISA, qPCR, Biacore)

• Creation and release of technical documentation, creation of verification plans and reports

• Collection, investigation and evaluation of verification data, weak points as well as implementation and monitoring of corrective measures

• Coordinate the routine Quality Control analytics with Lab Technicians and manage GMP deviations and OOS/OOE results as needed

• You are in contact with various Lonza internal stakeholders (e.g. Quality Control, Quality Assurance, Project Leaders)

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree in Biology/ Biochemistry or any related field

• Sufficient work experience in Quality Control is required

• Hands-on experience with analytical techniques like ELISA and qPCR is a must

• Work experience in the pharmaceutical industry (especially in Quality Control) as well as GMP knowledge is a plus

• Fluency in English is required; good German language skills are an advantage.

Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The QA Logistics group provides key QA oversight and support for the Visp site. This group supports facility utilities, warehousing, and the movement of raw materials and products into, out of, and within facilities. As a Functional Lead, you are expected to provide strategic direction, ensure compliance with GMP and quality requirements, prioritize team activities, and act as the primary escalation point for quality-related risks and operational challenges within the logistics and infrastructure areas. The role requires strong cross-functional collaboration, leadership, and decision-making to ensure reliable and compliant site operations.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Provide functional leadership for the QA Logistics team, including workload prioritization, coaching, mentoring, and escalation support for team members

• Lead QA oversight for site logistics, warehousing, cold chain, utilities, and infrastructure activities, ensuring compliance with GMP and regulatory requirements

• Serve as the primary Quality representative and escalation point for quality, compliance, and operational risks within the area of responsibility

• Oversee the management of deviations, CAPAs, change controls, investigations, and risk assessments, ensuring timely and compliant execution

• Foster a strong quality culture and support the professional development of team members while building effective partnerships with internal stakeholders.

What we are looking for:

• Academic degree or equivalent experience in Pharma/ Supply Chain/ Quality or related field

• Significant QA background combined with experience in logistics, warehousing, supply chain, or cold chain operations is required

• Proven ability to lead, coach, and support team members while driving accountability and collaboration

• Solid understanding of GMP requirements, quality systems, and risk-based decision making

• Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build relationships across functions

• Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with confidence to represent Quality in complex discussions

jobs.description:
Senior Bioprocess Engineer, Downstream Processing (DSP)

Location: Visp, Switzerland

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
Join Lonza's world-class biomanufacturing site in Visp and play a critical role in delivering life-changing therapies to patients worldwide. As a Senior Bioprocess Engineer (DSP), you will provide technical leadership for downstream processing operations, combining hands-on manufacturing support with engineering expertise to ensure safe, compliant, and reliable GMP production.

This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture within a global leader in life sciences.

• The opportunity to work on commercial and late-stage biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes that impact patients worldwide.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace built on collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance and technical expertise.

• Opportunities to lead cross-functional initiatives, mentor colleagues, and drive operational excellence.

• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location.

The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Serve as the senior technical expert for downstream processing manufacturing campaigns, ensuring safe, compliant, and reliable execution of purification operations in a GMP environment.

• Provide hands-on shop floor support during campaign preparation, execution, and close-out activities, acting as the escalation point for complex operational challenges.

• Lead technical investigations, root cause analyses, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments to resolve process deviations and support manufacturing excellence.

• Analyze process performance data to identify trends and implement solutions that improve plant throughput, process robustness, equipment reliability, yields, and cycle times.

• Provide subject matter expertise in chromatography, resin management, column packing, tangential flow filtration (TFF), UF/DF operations, bulk drug substance handling, and final processing activities.

• Partner closely with Manufacturing, MSAT, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Validation, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to support technology transfers, process validation, and operational readiness activities.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and mentor junior engineers and manufacturing personnel to strengthen technical capability, operational performance, and right-first-time execution.

What we are looking for

• Significant experience supporting GMP downstream processing operations within commercial or late-stage biopharmaceutical manufacturing environments, with a strong presence on the manufacturing floor.

• Proven expertise in chromatography systems, purification processes, TFF/UFDF operations, and DSP process optimization.

• Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex process, equipment, and operational issues and implement sustainable solutions in a GMP environment.

• Strong experience with deviation investigations, root cause analysis, CAPA management, change controls, risk assessments, and GMP documentation requirements.

• Ability to use process and operational data to drive decision-making, performance improvements, and manufacturing excellence.

• Degree in Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

• Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading cross-functional initiatives and mentoring technical teams.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're ready to help turn our customers' breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Engineering-&-Maintenance-Teams am Standort Visp suchen wir eine/n Elektro-, Mess- und Regeltechnik (EMR)-Ingenieur/in. Du bist verantwortlich für die Instandhaltung sowie für Projekte in Mono- oder Mehrprodukteanlagen.

Das bieten wir dir:

• Eine agile Karriere und dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Benefits für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Alle globalen Leistungen findest du hier: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

Deine Aufgaben:

• Technische Projektleitung oder Mitarbeit bei Kleinprojekten und Investitionsvorhaben

• Fachgerechte Planung, Vorbereitung und Koordination der EMR-Instandhaltung, inklusive interner und externen Partnern

• Auftragserteilung, Kapazitätsplanung, Pflege des Meldewesens in SAP und Sicherstellung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit

• Zusammenarbeit im fachübergreifenden Engineering-Team, Unterstützung der Betriebsleitung

• Einhaltung von Sicherheit, Qualität, Hygiene und Umweltstandards

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Anlagen, Prozessen und Instandhaltungsabläufen, Mitarbeit bei Risikoanalysen

• Pflege der Anlagendokumentation in SAP/COMOS, Fließbildpflege

• Budgetüberwachung für Projekte, Investitionen und Unterhalt

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung Technikerschule (HF), Bachelor (FH) oder Master (ETH) in Elektro-, Automations- oder Systemtechnik

• Erfahrung in EMR-Instandhaltung/Projekten in der Industrie von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse in SAP/COMOS/DeltaV/Modicon/Cimplicity von Vorteil, gute Office-Kenntnisse

• Deutsch fließend, Englisch von Vorteil

• Selbstständig, flexibel, teamfähig, strukturiert und organisiert

• Zuverlässig, belastbar, lösungsorientiert, offen für neue Ideen und hoch motiviert

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Lonza è oggi leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita, operante in tre continenti. Lavoriamo nella scienza, ma non c'è formula magica per come ci avviciniamo al lavoro. La nostra soluzione scientifica più importante è dipendenti di talento che collaborano e sviluppano idee che aiutano altre aziende ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, i nostri dipendenti guidano la loro carriera in modo indipendente. Perché le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano il mondo. E questo e' il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Per rafforzare il nostro team di progettazione e manutenzione presso il sito Visp, stiamo cercando un ingegnere elettrico, misura e controllo (EMR). Sei responsabile della manutenzione e dei progetti in impianti mono o multi-prodotto.

Questo è ciò che vi offriamo:

• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono le prestazioni

• Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. Tutti i servizi globali possono essere trovati qui: 9cd58bc563c44174b5a4f5fedd506597

I vostri compiti:

• Gestione del progetto tecnico o partecipazione a piccoli progetti e progetti di investimento

• Progettazione professionale, preparazione e coordinamento della manutenzione EMR, compresi i partner interni ed esterni

• Allocazione degli ordini, pianificazione delle capacità, manutenzione dei report in SAP e garanzia della disponibilità degli impianti

• Collaborazione nel team di ingegneria interdisciplinare, supporto alla gestione delle operazioni

• Rispetto degli standard di sicurezza, qualità, igiene e ambiente

• Ottimizzazione continua di impianti, processi e processi di manutenzione, partecipazione alle analisi dei rischi

• Manutenzione della documentazione dell'impianto in SAP/COMOS, manutenzione del diagramma di flusso

• Monitoraggio del bilancio per progetti, investimenti e manutenzione

Il tuo profilo:

• Scuola Tecnica Completata (HF), Laurea (FH) o Master (ETH) in Ingegneria Elettrica, Automazione o Sistemi

• L'esperienza nella manutenzione/progetti EMR nell'industria è vantaggioso

• Conoscenza di SAP/COMOS/DeltaV/Modicon/Cimplicity benefica, buona conoscenza dell'ufficio

• tedesco fluente, inglese benefico

• Indipendente, flessibile, capace di lavoro di squadra, strutturato e organizzato

• Affidabile, resistente, orientata alla soluzione, aperto a nuove idee e altamente motivato

I prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone ogni giorno. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande onore, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante per noi come i nostri successi stessi. A Lonza, il rispetto è una priorità e proteggiamo sia i nostri dipendenti che il nostro ambiente. Il successo per noi significa progresso moralmente accettabile.

Lonza è unito da persone che assumono sfide e usano la loro creatività per sviluppare nuove idee per problemi complessi. Insieme diamo un contributo che può migliorare la vita di molte persone in tutto il mondo. Questo offre loro la certezza e la soddisfazione di fare davvero la differenza con il proprio lavoro.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Quindi applicare ora!

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Then apply now!

titleByLocale.it: Controllo di qualità commerciale associato del laboratorio 80-100%

jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland.

What you will get

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Perform basic operational tasks in the lab (e.g mobile phase preparations, calibration of pH meter, balance check).

• Ensuring cleanliness and tidiness in the laboratory. This includes adherence to 6S principles and to cGMP standards for audit readiness

• Perform analytical testing within DPS Commercial QC (cGMP) for batch release and stability studies of drug products under cGMP according to existing method SOPs

• Document assay performance following Good Documentation Practices (GDocP) and flag relevant observations to the supervisor for further assessment

• Following applicable EHS regulations

What we are looking for:

• Training as lab technician (e.g. EFZ, CTA) or BSc in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry or related field

• Willingness to learn and grow

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated QC laboratory is a plus

• Experience with HPLC, CE-SDS, icIEF, or ELISA is a plus

• Understanding of cGMP, GDocP, and Data Integrity principles

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is dedicated people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

As the global manufacturing partner for many different customers, we are increasing manufacturing capacity. As other businesses face growing economic uncertainty, we are fortunate to have opportunities for expansion. Through this new collaboration, our work will have a significant, direct and long-term impact on the management of this global pandemic.

Designazione delle merci

Oggi Lonza è leader mondiale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è alcuna formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra soluzione scientifica più grande è dedicata persone che lavorano insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possiede la loro carriera. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, veramente migliorare il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Come partner mondiale per la produzione di molti clienti diversi, stiamo aumentando la capacità produttiva. Poiché altre aziende devono affrontare una crescente incertezza economica, siamo fortunati ad avere opportunità di espansione. Attraverso questa nuova collaborazione, il nostro lavoro avrà un impatto significativo, diretto e a lungo termine sulla gestione di questa pandemia globale.

Per sostenere la nostra crescita continua, Lonza sta cercando ingegneri Bioprocess con un background rilevante in Scienze della Vita e la passione per la biotecnologia per entrare a far parte della nostra comunità di talenti a Visp, Svizzera. Entra a far parte di questa grande opportunità e unisciti al nostro team facendo domanda per la posizione di ingegnere Bioprocess all'interno della nostra divisione commerciale Mammalian sia nella lavorazione a monte o nella lavorazione a valle.

guadagno, lucidatura o riempimento) per la depurazione delle proteine terapeutiche da entrambi i mammiferi (Ingegnere del bioprocesso DSP)

Ogni giorno, prodotti e servizi Lonza ha un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Qualsiasi successo che raggiungiamo non è un successo se non raggiunto eticamente.

La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi sofisticati e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con il miglioramento delle vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

Lonza è leader mondiale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti impianti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea, e Stein (Argovia), Svizzera.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Life Sciences auf drei Kontinenten. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung ist engagierte Menschen, die zusammen arbeiten, Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Austausch, wir lassen unsere Leute ihre Karriere. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, wirklich verbessern die Welt. Und das, die Art von Arbeit, die wir wollen, um Teil zu sein.

Als globaler Produktionspartner für viele verschiedene Kunden steigern wir die Produktionskapazität. Da andere Unternehmen mit wachsender wirtschaftlicher Unsicherheit konfrontiert sind, haben wir das Glück, Expansionsmöglichkeiten zu haben. Durch diese neue Zusammenarbeit wird unsere Arbeit einen erheblichen, direkten und langfristigen Einfluss auf das Management dieser globalen Pandemie haben.

Um unser weiteres Wachstum zu unterstützen, sucht Lonza Bioprozessingenieure mit einem relevanten Hintergrund in Life Sciences und einer Leidenschaft für Biotechnologie, um sich unserer Talent-Community in Visp, Schweiz, anzuschließen. Werden Sie Teil dieser großartigen Gelegenheit und schließen Sie sich unserem Team an, indem Sie sich für die Position als Bioprozessingenieur in unserem Geschäftsbereich Mammalias entweder in Upstream Processing oder Downstream Processing bewerben.

Wichtige Aufgaben

- Gewährleistung der termingerechten und in den Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards festgelegten operativen Tätigkeiten für die klinische und/oder kommerzielle Herstellung - Gesetz als funktionelles Blei für die Vorbereitung, Herstellung, Reinigung und Umstellung in dem zugewiesenen Bereich - Blei eines oder mehrerer definierter USP-Bereiche (z.B. Saatgutzug, Hauptanbau oder Ernte) für die Herstellung therapeutischer Proteine mit Säugetier- oder mikrobiellen Expressionssystemen (Bioprocess Engineer USP) - Verantwortlich für einen oder mehrere definierte DSP-Bereiche (z.B.

Verstärkung, Polieren oder Füllen) für die Reinigung von therapeutischen Proteinen aus Säugetieren (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

Schlüsselanforderungen

- Master, s Abschluss oder gleichwertige Erfahrung in Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Biochemie oder verwandten Life Science Fächern oder Bachelor, Inhaber mit Erfahrung in der Pharmaproduktion - Kenntnisse in entweder USP (wie Bioreaktoren) oder DSP Einheiten (wie chromatographie) - Ein paar Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Biomanufaktur erforderlich - GMP Erfahrung und Verständnis der Bioprozesstechnologie - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, gute deutsche Fähigkeiten von Vorteil

Jeden Tag haben Lonza, seine Produkte und Dienstleistungen einen positiven Einfluss auf Millionen von Menschen. Für uns ist dies nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Die Menschen kommen nach Lonza für die Herausforderung und Kreativität, anspruchsvolle Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Lebenswissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt kommt.

gain, polissage ou remplissage) pour la purification des protéines thérapeutiques de l'un ou l'autre mammifère (Ingénieur Bioprocess DSP)

Chaque jour, Lonza, ses produits et services ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. jobs.title: Senior Trademark Paralegal Specialist
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza's global Intellectual Property team and play a vital role in protecting and advancing one of the company's most valuable assets: its intellectual property portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity to work across global markets, collaborating with legal, brand, and business stakeholders to manage trademarks, copyrights, and brand protection initiatives that support Lonza's continued growth and innovation.

What you will get

• An agile career and dynamic working culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
• Opportunities to collaborate with global teams and legal experts.
• Exposure to a diverse international intellectual property portfolio.
• A variety of benefits dependent on role and location. The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do

• Manage and support Lonza's global trademark and copyright portfolio.
• Partner with the Head of Trademarks, Brand Teams, SGRM, Legal colleagues and external counsel.
• Coordinate trademark and copyright filings, renewals and prosecution activities.
• Administer IP budgets, invoices, systems and reporting.
• Finalize trademark and copyright license agreements and support brand usage reviews.
• Coordinate brand protection activities including domains, UDRP, Amazon Brand Registry and customs filings.
• Drive continuous improvement and proactive management of IP processes.

What we are looking for

• Significant intellectual property portfolio management experience.
• Strong expertise in US and international trademark practice, including Madrid Protocol filings.
• Experience working with external counsel and global IP matters.
• Ability to independently manage a large global trademark portfolio.
• Excellent organizational, project management and communication skills.
• Experience with IP management systems, budgeting and reporting.
• High school diploma or equivalent required; additional legal/paralegal qualifications are advantageous.

About Lonza

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Miglioramento continuo e gestione proattiva dei processi IP.

• Esperienza di gestione del portafoglio di proprietà intellettuale significativa.
• Forte competenza negli Stati Uniti e nella pratica del marchio internazionale, tra cui i depositi del Protocollo di Madrid.

Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte.

L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito.

• Starke Expertise in der US-amerikanischen und internationalen Markenpraxis, einschließlich der Anmeldungen des Madrider Protokolls.

Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzuwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Biowissenschaften zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben.

L'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Bâle, en Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin.

Rejoignez l'équipe mondiale de la propriété intellectuelle de Lonza et jouez un rôle essentiel dans la protection et la promotion de l'un des atouts les plus précieux de l'entreprise : son portefeuille de propriété intellectuelle. C'est une occasion passionnante de travailler sur les marchés mondiaux, en collaborant avec les intervenants juridiques, commerciaux et de marque pour gérer les marques, les droits d'auteur et les initiatives de protection des marques qui soutiennent la croissance et l'innovation continues de Lonza.

Ce que vous aurez

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.
• Un milieu de travail inclusif et éthique.
• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé.
• Possibilités de collaboration avec des équipes mondiales et des experts juridiques.
• Exposition à un portefeuille international de propriété intellectuelle diversifié.
• Divers avantages dépendent du rôle et de l'emplacement. La liste complète de nos avantages globaux peut être consultée ici: https://www.lonza.com/careers/bénéfices

Ce que vous ferez

• Gérer et soutenir le portefeuille mondial de marques et de droits d'auteur de Lonza.
• Partenaire avec le chef des marques, des équipes de marques, SGRM, des collègues juridiques et des conseillers externes.
• Coordonner les dépôts de marques et de droits d'auteur, les renouvellements et les poursuites.
• Administrer les budgets, les factures, les systèmes et les rapports de PI.
• Finaliser les accords de licence de marque et de droit d'auteur et appuyer les examens d'utilisation de la marque.
• Coordonner les activités de protection de la marque, y compris les domaines, UDRP, Amazon Brand Registry et les dépôts en douane.
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue et la gestion proactive des processus de propriété intellectuelle.

Ce que nous cherchons

• Expérience importante en gestion de portefeuille de propriété intellectuelle.
• Forte expertise dans les pratiques américaines et internationales en matière de marques, y compris les dépôts au titre du Protocole de Madrid.
• Expérience de travail avec des conseils externes et des questions de propriété intellectuelle à l'échelle mondiale.
• Capacité de gérer de manière indépendante un vaste portefeuille mondial de marques.
• Excellentes compétences en matière d'organisation, de gestion de projet et de communication.
• Expérience des systèmes de gestion de la propriété intellectuelle, de la budgétisation et de l'établissement de rapports.
• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent requis; qualifications juridiques/parajuridiques supplémentaires sont avantageuses.

À propos de Lonza

À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez.

L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant.
